datasets.name: Head to Head Scoring
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  i.primary_competitor AS competitor_name,
  'TM' AS score_type,
  ROUND(AVG(s.tm_score), 2) AS score_value,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM
  prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.voc_wonloss_category_scores s
    JOIN prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.voc_wonloss_interviews i
      ON s.interview_id = i.interview_id
    LEFT JOIN prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.voc_vw_sf_opportunities sf ON i.opportunity_id_18 = sf.opportunity_id_18
WHERE
  i.primary_competitor RLIKE '[A-Za-z]'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(i.primary_competitor)) NOT IN ('none', 'other', 'n/a', 'unknown')
  AND (
    :outcome_filter IS NULL
    OR size(:outcome_filter) = 0
    OR array_contains(:outcome_filter, i.outcome)
  )
  AND (
    :competitor_filter IS NULL
    OR size(:competitor_filter) = 0
    OR array_contains(:competitor_filter, i.primary_competitor)
  )
  AND (
    :interview_date.min IS NULL
    OR i.interview_date >= :interview_date.min
  )
  AND (
    :interview_date.max IS NULL
    OR i.interview_date <= :interview_date.max
  )
  AND (:interview_type_filter IS NULL OR size(:interview_type_filter) = 0 OR array_contains(:interview_type_filter, i.interview_type))
  AND (:region_filter IS NULL OR size(:region_filter) = 0 OR array_contains(:region_filter, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sf.billing_country,'United States') IN ('United States','US','Canada','CA') THEN 'NA' WHEN sf.billing_country IN ('United Kingdom','UK','Ireland','Isle of Man','Germany','Austria','Switzerland','Liechtenstein','Czechia','Czech Republic','Hungary','Poland','Romania','Sweden','Finland','Norway','Estonia','Lithuania','Luxembourg','Belgium','Denmark','Netherlands','Spain','France','Italy','Portugal','Andorra','Malta','Turkey','South Africa','United Arab Emirates','Israel','Saudi Arabia','Kenya','Uganda','Tanzania','Zambia','Zimbabwe','Mozambique','Mauritius','Botswana','Lesotho','Eswatini','Malawi','Rwanda','Gambia','Namibia','Afghanistan','Pakistan','South Sudan') THEN 'EMEA' WHEN sf.billing_country IN ('Australia','New Zealand','Hong Kong','Philippines','Indonesia','Singapore','Japan','Taiwan','Chinese Taipei','Malaysia','Thailand','South Korea','India') THEN 'APAC' WHEN sf.billing_country IN ('Mexico','Brazil','Argentina','Chile','Colombia','Peru','Uruguay','Bahamas') THEN 'LATAM' ELSE 'Other' END))
  AND (:segment_filter IS NULL OR size(:segment_filter) = 0 OR array_contains(:segment_filter, sf.segment__c))
GROUP BY
  i.primary_competitor
HAVING
  COUNT(*) >= 8
UNION ALL
SELECT
  i.primary_competitor AS competitor_name,
  'Competitor' AS score_type,
  ROUND(AVG(s.competitor_score), 2) AS score_value,

FROM

WHERE

  AND (
    :outcome_filter IS NULL

  )
  AND (
    :competitor_filter IS NULL
    OR size(:competitor_filter) = 0
    OR array_contains(:competitor_filter, i.primary_competitor)
  )
  AND (
    :interview_date.min IS NULL
    OR i.interview_date >= :interview_date.min
  )
  AND (
    :interview_date.max IS NULL
    OR i.interview_date <= :interview_date.max

  AND (:interview_type_filter IS NULL OR size(:interview_type_filter) = 0 OR array_contains(:interview_type_filter, i.interview_type))

  AND (:segment_filter IS NULL OR size(:segment_filter) = 0 OR array_contains(:segment_filter, sf.segment__c))
GROUP BY
  i.primary_competitor
HAVING
  COUNT(*) >= 8
ORDER BY

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.primary_competitor), ''), 'Unknown') AS competitor,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM
    prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.voc_wonloss_interviews i
      LEFT JOIN prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.voc_vw_sf_opportunities sf
        ON i.opportunity_id_18 = sf.opportunity_id_18
  WHERE
    i.outcome IN ('Win', 'Loss')
    AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(i.primary_competitor, ''))) NOT IN (
      'other', 'competitor unknown', 'n/a', 'ticketmaster', 'none', 'unknown', ''
    )
    AND (
      :outcome_filter IS NULL
      OR size(:outcome_filter) = 0
      OR array_contains(:outcome_filter, i.outcome)
    )
    AND (
      :competitor_filter IS NULL
      OR size(:competitor_filter) = 0
      OR array_contains(:competitor_filter, i.primary_competitor)
    )
    AND (
      :interview_date.min IS NULL
      OR i.interview_date >= :interview_date.min
    )
    AND (
      :interview_date.max IS NULL
      OR i.interview_date <= :interview_date.max
    )
    AND (
      :interview_type_filter IS NULL
      OR size(:interview_type_filter) = 0
      OR array_contains(:interview_type_filter, i.interview_type)
    )
    AND (
      :region_filter IS NULL
      OR size(:region_filter) = 0

          WHEN
            COALESCE(sf.billing_country, 'United States') IN ('United States', 'US', 'Canada', 'CA')
          THEN
            'NA'

            sf.billing_country IN (
              'United Kingdom',

              'Isle of Man',
              'Germany',
              'Austria',
              'Switzerland',
              'Liechtenstein',
              'Czechia',

              'Sweden',
              'Finland',
              'Norway',
              'Estonia',

              'Belgium',
              'Denmark',
              'Netherlands',
              'Spain',
              'France',
              'Italy',
              'Portugal',
              'Andorra',
              'Malta',
              'Turkey',
              'South Africa',
              'United Arab Emirates',
              'Israel',
              'Saudi Arabia',
              'Kenya',
              'Uganda',
              'Tanzania',
              'Zambia',
              'Zimbabwe',
              'Mozambique',
              'Mauritius',
              'Botswana',
              'Lesotho',
              'Eswatini',
              'Malawi',
              'Rwanda',
              'Gambia',
              'Namibia',
              'Afghanistan',
              'Pakistan',
              'South Sudan'
            )
          THEN
            'EMEA'
          WHEN
            sf.billing_country IN (
              'Australia',
              'New Zealand',
              'Hong Kong',
              'Philippines',
              'Indonesia',
              'Singapore',
              'Japan',
              'Taiwan',
              'Chinese Taipei',

              'Thailand',

            'APAC'

            sf.billing_country IN (
              'Mexico', 'Brazil', 'Argentina', 'Chile', 'Colombia', 'Peru', 'Uruguay', 'Bahamas'
            )
          THEN
            'LATAM'
          ELSE 'Other'
        END
      )
    )
    AND (
      :segment_filter IS NULL
      OR size(:segment_filter) = 0
      OR array_contains(:segment_filter, sf.segment__c)
    )
  GROUP BY
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.primary_competitor), ''), 'Unknown')

datasets.sql:
SELECT
  w.wonloss_total AS wonloss_interviews,
  d.discovery_count AS discovery_interviews,
  w.wonloss_total + d.discovery_count AS all_interviews,
  ROUND(100.0 * w.win_count / NULLIF(w.win_loss_count, 0), 1) AS win_rate_pct
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      COUNT(*) AS wonloss_total,
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN i.outcome = 'Win' THEN 1
          ELSE 0

              'Netherlands',
              'Spain',
              'France',
              'Italy',
              'Portugal',

              'Israel',

            )
          THEN
            'EMEA'
          WHEN
            sf.billing_country IN (
              'Australia',
              'New Zealand',

              'Philippines',
              'Indonesia',
              'Singapore',
              'Japan',

    )

  SELECT
    b.competitor,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.close_date >= add_months(a.current_end, -3) AND b.close_date < a.current_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS latest_quarter_losses,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.close_date >= add_months(a.current_end, -6) AND b.close_date < add_months(a.current_end, -3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prior_quarter_losses
  FROM base b CROSS JOIN anchor a
  WHERE b.competitor IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.competitor
),
themed_reasons AS (
  SELECT
    competitor,
    loss_reason_theme,
    COUNT(*) AS reason_losses,
    SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY competitor) AS themed_losses,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY competitor
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, loss_reason_theme
      ) AS reason_rank
  FROM
    base
  WHERE
    competitor IS NOT NULL
    AND loss_reason_theme IS NOT NULL
    AND loss_reason_theme <> 'Unmapped'
  GROUP BY
    competitor,
    loss_reason_theme
)
SELECT
  t.competitor,
  t.lost_deals,
  t.tickets_lost,
  COALESCE(q.latest_quarter_losses, 0) AS latest_quarter_losses,
  COALESCE(q.prior_quarter_losses, 0) AS prior_quarter_losses,
  CONCAT(CASE WHEN COALESCE(q.latest_quarter_losses, 0) > COALESCE(q.prior_quarter_losses, 0) THEN '+' ELSE '' END, CAST(COALESCE(q.latest_quarter_losses, 0) - COALESCE(q.prior_quarter_losses, 0) AS STRING)) AS change_vs_prior_quarter,
  COALESCE(r.loss_reason_theme, 'No themed reason') AS top_loss_reason,
  COALESCE(
    CONCAT(
      CAST(ROUND(100.0 * r.reason_losses / r.themed_losses) AS INT),
      '% of ',
      CAST(r.themed_losses AS STRING),
      ' themed losses'
    ),
    ''
  ) AS top_reason_share
FROM
  competitor_totals t
    LEFT JOIN themed_reasons r
      ON t.competitor = r.competitor
      AND r.reason_rank = 1
    LEFT JOIN quarter_losses q
      ON t.competitor = q.competitor
ORDER BY
  t.lost_deals DESC,
  t.tickets_lost DESC
LIMIT 15

        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS has_interview_flag,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN has_qualtrics_survey THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS has_survey_flag
  FROM
    base
  GROUP BY
    account_id
)
SELECT
  r.account_name,
  r.segment,
  r.client_size,
  ROUND(r.annual_tickets) AS annual_tickets_latest_deal,
  a.deals,
  a.wins,
  a.losses,
  CASE
    WHEN r.is_won THEN 'Won'
    ELSE 'Lost'
  END AS latest_outcome,
  CAST(r.close_date AS DATE) AS latest_close_date,
  COALESCE(a.latest_competitor, 'None recorded') AS latest_competitor,
  CASE
    WHEN a.has_interview_flag = 1 THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS interview_available,
  CASE
    WHEN a.has_survey_flag = 1 THEN 'Y'
    ELSE 'N'
  END AS survey_available
FROM
  ranked r
    JOIN account_rollup a
      ON r.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE
  r.deal_recency = 1
ORDER BY
  annual_tickets_latest_deal DESC,
  r.account_name

anchor AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(
      date_trunc(
        'QUARTER',
        LEAST(date_add(COALESCE(:close_date_range.max, current_date()), 1), current_date())
      ) AS DATE
    ) AS current_end
),
windows AS (
  SELECT
    'current' AS period,
    add_months(current_end, -3) AS period_start,
    current_end AS period_end
  FROM
    anchor
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'prior',
    add_months(current_end, -6),
    add_months(current_end, -3)
  FROM
    anchor
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'last_year',
    add_months(current_end, -15),
    add_months(current_end, -12)
  FROM
    anchor
),
deals_in_window AS (
  SELECT
    w.period,
    w.period_start,
    b.*
  FROM
    base b
      JOIN windows w
        ON b.close_date >= w.period_start
        AND b.close_date < w.period_end
),
top_competitor AS (
  SELECT
    competitor
  FROM
    deals_in_window
  WHERE
    period = 'current'
    AND NOT is_won
    AND competitor IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    competitor
  ORDER BY
    COUNT(*) DESC,
    competitor
  LIMIT 1
),
period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    w.period,
    CONCAT(
      CAST(YEAR(w.period_start) AS STRING),
      '-Q',
      CAST(QUARTER(w.period_start) AS STRING)
    ) AS quarter_label,
    COUNT(d.opportunity_id_18) AS closed_deals,
    100.0
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN d.is_won THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
      / NULLIF(COUNT(d.opportunity_id_18), 0) AS win_rate,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN d.is_won THEN d.annual_tickets
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS tickets_won,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN NOT d.is_won THEN d.annual_tickets
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS tickets_lost,
    100.0
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN
            d.is_won
            AND d.deal_type = 'Renewal'
          THEN
            1
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
      / NULLIF(
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN d.deal_type = 'Renewal' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ),
        0
      ) AS renewal_win_rate,
    100.0
      * SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN
            d.is_won
            AND d.deal_type = 'New Client'
          THEN
            1
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
      / NULLIF(
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN d.deal_type = 'New Client' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ),
        0
      ) AS new_client_win_rate,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN
          NOT d.is_won
          AND d.competitor = tc.competitor
        THEN
          1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS top_competitor_losses,
    MAX(tc.competitor) AS top_competitor_name
  FROM
    windows w
      LEFT JOIN deals_in_window d
        ON w.period = d.period
      LEFT JOIN top_competitor tc
        ON true
  GROUP BY
    w.period,
    w.period_start
),
long_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    period,
    quarter_label,
    metric_order,
    metric,
    metric_kind,
    metric_value
  FROM
    period_metrics
    LATERAL VIEW
      stack(
        7,
        1,
        'Closed deals',
        'count',
        CAST(closed_deals AS DOUBLE),
        2,
        'Win rate (deal count)',
        'pct',
        CAST(win_rate AS DOUBLE),
        3,
        'Tickets won',
        'count',
        CAST(tickets_won AS DOUBLE),
        4,
        'Tickets lost',
        'count',
        CAST(tickets_lost AS DOUBLE),
        5,
        'Renewal win rate',
        'pct',
        CAST(renewal_win_rate AS DOUBLE),
        6,
        'New-client win rate',
        'pct',
        CAST(new_client_win_rate AS DOUBLE),
        7,
        CONCAT(
          'Losses to ',
          COALESCE(top_competitor_name, 'top competitor'),
          ' (top competitor this quarter)'
        ),
        'count',
        CAST(top_competitor_losses AS DOUBLE)
      ) s
      AS metric_order, metric, metric_kind, metric_value
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    metric_order,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'current' THEN metric
      END
    ) AS metric,
    MAX(metric_kind) AS metric_kind,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'current' THEN metric_value
      END
    ) AS current_value,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'prior' THEN metric_value
      END
    ) AS prior_value,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'last_year' THEN metric_value
      END
    ) AS last_year_value
  FROM
    long_metrics
  GROUP BY
    metric_order
),
labels AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'current' THEN quarter_label
      END
    ) AS current_label,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'prior' THEN quarter_label
      END
    ) AS prior_label,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN period = 'last_year' THEN quarter_label
      END
    ) AS last_year_label
  FROM
    period_metrics
)
SELECT
  0 AS metric_order,
  'Quarter' AS metric,
  current_label AS latest_quarter,
  prior_label AS prior_quarter,
  '' AS change_vs_prior_quarter,
  last_year_label AS same_quarter_last_year,
  '' AS change_vs_last_year
FROM
  labels
UNION ALL
SELECT
  metric_order,
  metric,
  CASE
    WHEN current_value IS NULL THEN 'n/a'
    WHEN metric_kind = 'pct' THEN CONCAT(format_number(current_value, 1), '%')
    ELSE format_number(current_value, 0)
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN prior_value IS NULL THEN 'n/a'
    WHEN metric_kind = 'pct' THEN CONCAT(format_number(prior_value, 1), '%')
    ELSE format_number(prior_value, 0)
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN
      current_value IS NULL
      OR prior_value IS NULL
    THEN
      'n/a'
    WHEN
      metric_kind = 'pct'
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        CASE
          WHEN current_value >= prior_value THEN '+'
          ELSE ''
        END,
        format_number(current_value - prior_value, 1),
        ' pts'
      )
    ELSE
      CONCAT(
        CASE
          WHEN current_value >= prior_value THEN '+'
          ELSE ''
        END,
        format_number(current_value - prior_value, 0),
        CASE
          WHEN prior_value = 0 THEN ''
          ELSE
            CONCAT(
              ' (',
              CASE
                WHEN current_value >= prior_value THEN '+'
                ELSE ''
              END,
              format_number(100.0 * (current_value - prior_value) / prior_value, 1),
              '%)'
            )
        END
      )
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN last_year_value IS NULL THEN 'n/a'
    WHEN metric_kind = 'pct' THEN CONCAT(format_number(last_year_value, 1), '%')
    ELSE format_number(last_year_value, 0)
  END,
  CASE
    WHEN
      current_value IS NULL
      OR last_year_value IS NULL
    THEN
      'n/a'
    WHEN
      metric_kind = 'pct'
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        CASE
          WHEN current_value >= last_year_value THEN '+'
          ELSE ''
        END,
        format_number(current_value - last_year_value, 1),
        ' pts'
      )
    ELSE
      CONCAT(
        CASE
          WHEN current_value >= last_year_value THEN '+'
          ELSE ''
        END,
        format_number(current_value - last_year_value, 0),
        CASE
          WHEN last_year_value = 0 THEN ''
          ELSE
            CONCAT(
              ' (',
              CASE
                WHEN current_value >= last_year_value THEN '+'
                ELSE ''
              END,
              format_number(100.0 * (current_value - last_year_value) / last_year_value, 1),
              '%)'
            )
        END
      )
  END
FROM
  pivoted
ORDER BY
  metric_order

SELECT DISTINCT
  /* Step 22 C23: the tour is named by its picker label (artist . main onsale date), the value :tour_name carries */
  tour_display_label AS tour_name,
  event_label AS event_id_hex,
  artist_name,
  event_name,
  venue_name,
  onsale_dt,
  event_dt,
  venue_type,
  genre_group,
  market,
  region,
  platform,
  promoter_group
FROM
  `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
WHERE
  event_kind = 'Main'
  AND (
    has_queue
    OR venue_capacity >= 5000
  )
  AND (
    :market IS NULL
    OR :market = 'All'
    OR market = :market
  )
  AND (
    :region IS NULL
    OR :region = 'All'
    OR region = :region
  )
  /* Step 22 (Dan 2026-11-10): only the picked tour's dates; every event when no tour is picked */
  AND (
    NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
    OR tour_picker_label = :tour_name
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): the Event list shows the period's dates */
    OR (
      COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
      AND tour_in_picker
      AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
      AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
      AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
      AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  artist_name,
  event_name,
  event_dt

datasets.name: Tab1 Tour Context
datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the picker label resolves to the tour's dates through the shared tour block */
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    /* Step 22 C1: Venue Type and the queued-events filter also narrow the tour's dates (Region and Market already did) */
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
sellout_per_event AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    /* Step 22 (C16): the build's one sellout date (04 sellout_anchor: first day total sold reaches 95% of the STR card's
       capacity, show day included), read instead of recounting str_pct >= 95 */
    MAX(sellout_dt) AS sellout_dt
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND sellout_dt IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
queue_at_sellout AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 (C16): the build's queue_at_sellout (04: fans still in a queue on the sellout date), the per-event value
       the benchmark's queue_at_sellout family averages (09 event_sellout) */
    p.event_id_hex,
    MAX(p.queue_at_sellout) AS fans_in_queue
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
  WHERE
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        sellout_per_event
    )
    AND p.queue_at_sellout IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    p.event_id_hex
)
SELECT
  a.venue_name AS `Venue`,
  a.platform AS `Platform`,
  DATE_FORMAT(a.event_dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS `Event Date`,
  ROUND(ps.net_sold * 100.0 / NULLIF(ps.net_cap, 0), 2) AS `STR (%)`,
  ps.gross_revenue AS `Revenue`,
  ps.net_sold AS `Tickets`,
  ps.avg_ticket_price AS `ATP ($)`,
  COALESCE(
    CAST(ROUND(ps.mfx_tickets_vs_inventory_pct, 1) AS STRING),
    ''
  ) AS `Rev. tickets vs inventory (%)`,
  ps.queue_joins AS `Queue`
FROM
  `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` a
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        MAX(net_cap) AS net_cap,
        MAX(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
        MAX(revenue_ticket_qty) AS revenue_ticket_qty,
        MAX(avg_ticket_price) AS avg_ticket_price,
        /* Batch 14 (C3): the Queue Demand count (fans who joined before the flush) */
        MAX(event_queue_joins_active) AS queue_joins,
        MAX(mfx_tickets_vs_inventory_pct) AS mfx_tickets_vs_inventory_pct,
        MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) ps
      ON a.event_id_hex = ps.event_id_hex
    LEFT JOIN queue_at_sellout qs
      ON a.event_id_hex = qs.event_id_hex
WHERE
  a.event_id_hex IN (
    SELECT
      event_id_hex
    FROM
      active_events
  )
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Total',
  '',
  '',
  ROUND(
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN ps.inv_broken = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE ps.net_sold
      END
    )
      * 100.0
      / NULLIF(
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN ps.inv_broken = 1 THEN NULL
            ELSE ps.net_cap
          END
        ),
        0
      ),
    2
  ),
  SUM(ps.gross_revenue),
  /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 1): the Total row's Tickets leave out Microflex dates with an untrusted seat
     count, as its STR does; each date's own row still shows its value */
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN ps.inv_broken = 1 THEN NULL
      ELSE ps.net_sold
    END
  ),
  /* Batch 15 (item 3): the average of the dates' ticket prices, as the Avg Ticket Price card */
  ROUND(AVG(ps.avg_ticket_price), 2),
  '',
  SUM(ps.queue_joins)
FROM
  `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` a
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        MAX(net_cap) AS net_cap,
        MAX(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
        MAX(revenue_ticket_qty) AS revenue_ticket_qty,
        MAX(avg_ticket_price) AS avg_ticket_price,
        /* Batch 14 (C3): the Queue Demand count (fans who joined before the flush) */
        MAX(event_queue_joins_active) AS queue_joins,
        MAX(mfx_tickets_vs_inventory_pct) AS mfx_tickets_vs_inventory_pct,
        MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) ps
      ON a.event_id_hex = ps.event_id_hex
    LEFT JOIN queue_at_sellout qs
      ON a.event_id_hex = qs.event_id_hex
WHERE
  a.event_id_hex IN (
    SELECT
      event_id_hex
    FROM
      active_events
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN `Venue` = 'Total' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END,
  `Event Date` ASC

        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-F0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the picker label resolves to the tour's dates through the shared tour block (Region All =
         the 40-day global tour; Region picked = the per-region tours of its dates there) */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): Region, Market, Venue Type and Benchmark Events narrow the tour dates; the picked-event branch is unchanged */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
/* Batch 16 (Dan 2026-11-18): STR Trajectory from each date's onsale to its show, ending on the STR card.
   Seats: each date's seats on sale the night before the show (the STR card's seats, phase summary net_cap), fixed for
   every day. Sold: the daily count so far (music_str_daily), carried forward on days with no snapshot; from the date's
   last snapshot on it reads the STR card's own sold count, capped at the seats (the card caps each date at 100%). Every
   date counts on every day, so the line only falls if tickets are returned, and its last day equals the STR card.
   Untrusted Microflex dates stay out, as on STR. */
traj_dates AS (
  SELECT
    p.event_id_hex,
    MAX(p.net_cap) AS seats_on_sale,
    LEAST(MAX(p.net_sold), MAX(p.net_cap)) AS card_sold
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
  WHERE
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
  GROUP BY
    p.event_id_hex
  HAVING
    COALESCE(MAX(CAST(p.mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)), 0) = 0
    AND MAX(p.net_cap) > 0
),
traj_daily AS (
  SELECT
    s.event_id_hex,
    s.days_since_onsale,
    MAX(s.net_sold) AS net_sold
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_str_daily` s
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
        ON l.event_id_hex = s.event_id_hex
  WHERE
    s.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        traj_dates
    )
    AND s.collection_dt <= l.event_dt
    AND s.days_since_onsale >= 0
  GROUP BY
    s.event_id_hex,
    s.days_since_onsale
),
traj_last AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MAX(days_since_onsale) AS last_day
  FROM
    traj_daily
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
traj_grid AS (
  SELECT
    d.event_id_hex,
    d.seats_on_sale,
    d.card_sold,
    t.last_day,
    EXPLODE(SEQUENCE(0, (SELECT MAX(last_day) FROM traj_last))) AS days_since_onsale
  FROM
    traj_dates d
      INNER JOIN traj_last t
        ON t.event_id_hex = d.event_id_hex
),
traj_filled AS (
  SELECT
    g.event_id_hex,
    g.seats_on_sale,
    g.days_since_onsale,
    CASE
      WHEN g.days_since_onsale >= g.last_day THEN g.card_sold
      ELSE LEAST(
        COALESCE(
          LAST_VALUE(t.net_sold, TRUE) OVER (
            PARTITION BY g.event_id_hex
            ORDER BY g.days_since_onsale
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
          ),
          0
        ),
        g.seats_on_sale
      )
    END AS sold_to_date
  FROM
    traj_grid g
      LEFT JOIN traj_daily t
        ON t.event_id_hex = g.event_id_hex
        AND t.days_since_onsale = g.days_since_onsale
)
SELECT
  days_since_onsale,
  ROUND(SUM(sold_to_date) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(seats_on_sale), 0), 2) AS str_pct,
  SUM(sold_to_date) AS cumulative_sold,
  SUM(seats_on_sale) AS capacity
FROM
  traj_filled
GROUP BY
  days_since_onsale
ORDER BY
  days_since_onsale

WITH resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
/* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when the Region filter is active). */
picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name

picked_tour_regions AS (

  FROM

  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'

    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (

      FROM

    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    ) /* Step 22 S6/C23: shared tour block */
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): Region, Market, Venue Type and Benchmark Events narrow the tour dates; the picked-event branch is unchanged */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type

  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM

    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
/* Step 22 F21, S1, C8: fans, tiers and net tickets come from the member fact (F21: it carries MFX purchases, so MFX
   tiers are real). The tier is the ARM score on the queue row, at queue join by default or today's score when
   arm_basis = 'Today' (C8). Only queues in an eligible config slot and rows with a linked account count (SOT-D1:
   unlinked rows out, their count is the Unlinked Queue Rows footnote field); No score is its own tier (build 09
   arm_rows, lines 516-535, the same population the ARM benchmarks use). The provider map, account-link and
   latest-score joins left this dataset: the member fact carries the link and both scores (S1). Grain: one row
   per fan visit (fan, date, queue), the grain the member fact keeps and the tie to Sean Poole's sample was graded on
   (step22-part2 STATE.md, stage 2 outside checks). Every tour date in view counts (a table, no benchmark), so before
   the first ARM run (2026-01-01 in the data) a visit at queue join can only be No score. */
arm_rows AS (
  SELECT
    q.member_id,
    q.event_id_hex,
    q.queue_id,
    COALESCE(
      CASE
        WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN q.arm_risk_score_today
        ELSE q.arm_risk_score_pit
      END,
      'No score'
    ) AS arm_tier,
    q.purchased,
    CASE
      WHEN q.purchased THEN q.tickets_net
      ELSE 0
    END AS tickets_net
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
  WHERE
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND q.arm_queue_eligible
    AND q.arm_linked
),
unlinked AS (
  /* SOT-D1 footnote: eligible-slot queue rows dropped because the account has no link in its market's system */
  SELECT
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN NOT q.arm_linked THEN 1
      END
    ) AS unlinked_rows,
    /* Batch 14 (C13): every eligible-slot queue row, so the card can show the share left out */
    COUNT(*) AS eligible_rows,
    /* Batch 15 (item 14): rows with an ARM score on the ARM score setting (at queue join or Today) */
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          q.arm_linked
          AND COALESCE(
            CASE
              WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN q.arm_risk_score_today
              ELSE q.arm_risk_score_pit
            END,
            'No score'
          ) <> 'No score'
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS scored_rows
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
  WHERE
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND q.arm_queue_eligible
),
tier_rows AS (
  SELECT
    arm_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS queue_rows,
    /* Step 22 D (Dan 2026-11-06): a visit whose tickets were all cancelled (net 0) is not a buyer */
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN
          purchased
          AND tickets_net > 0
        THEN
          1
      END
    ) AS buyer_rows,
    SUM(tickets_net) AS tickets
  FROM
    arm_rows
  GROUP BY
    arm_tier
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(queue_rows) AS grand_total_rows,
    SUM(tickets) AS grand_total_tickets
  FROM
    tier_rows
),
tier_shares AS (
  /* C9: queue share and ticket share over every tier (hidden tiers included), unrounded for the ratio */
  SELECT
    r.arm_tier,
    r.queue_rows,
    r.buyer_rows,
    r.tickets,
    r.queue_rows * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.grand_total_rows, 0) AS queue_share,
    r.tickets * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.grand_total_tickets, 0) AS ticket_share
  FROM
    tier_rows r CROSS JOIN totals t
)
SELECT
  /* C7: tier labels ARM 1 to ARM 5 and No score, with OMT's descriptions */
  CASE
    s.arm_tier
    WHEN '1' THEN 'ARM 1: Low behavioral risk'
    WHEN '2' THEN 'ARM 2: Slightly elevated'
    WHEN '3' THEN 'ARM 3: Moderate'
    WHEN '4' THEN 'ARM 4: Elevated'
    WHEN '5' THEN 'ARM 5: High behavioral risk'
    WHEN 'No score' THEN 'No score: No ARM score available'
    ELSE CONCAT('ARM ', s.arm_tier)
  END AS `Risk Tier`,
  /* C9: placed first after the tier label. Ratio above 1 means the tier got more than its share of tickets */
  ROUND(s.queue_share, 1) AS `% of Queue`,
  ROUND(s.ticket_share / NULLIF(s.queue_share, 0), 2) AS `Ratio`,
  s.queue_rows AS `Queue Members`,
  s.buyer_rows AS `Buyers`,
  s.tickets AS `Tickets`,
  ROUND(s.tickets * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.buyer_rows, 0), 2) AS `Avg Tickets per Buyer`,
  ROUND(s.ticket_share, 1) AS `% of Total Tickets`,
  CASE s.arm_tier
    WHEN 'No score' THEN 6
    ELSE CAST(s.arm_tier AS INT)
  END AS `Tier Order`,
  u.unlinked_rows AS `Unlinked Queue Rows`,
  /* Batch 14 (C13) */
  CONCAT(
    FORMAT_NUMBER(u.unlinked_rows, 0),
    ' of ',
    FORMAT_NUMBER(u.eligible_rows, 0),
    ' queue rows (',
    FORMAT_NUMBER(u.unlinked_rows * 100.0 / NULLIF(u.eligible_rows, 0), 2),
    '%)'
  ) AS `Unlinked Queue Rows Label`,
  /* Batch 15 (item 14): ARM coverage gauge */
  CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(u.scored_rows, 0), ' of ', FORMAT_NUMBER(u.eligible_rows, 0), ' queue rows (',
    FORMAT_NUMBER(u.scored_rows * 100.0 / NULLIF(u.eligible_rows, 0), 1), '%)') AS `ARM Coverage`,
  CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(u.unlinked_rows, 0), ' (',
    FORMAT_NUMBER(u.unlinked_rows * 100.0 / NULLIF(u.eligible_rows, 0), 1), '%)') AS `No Linked Account`,
  CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(u.eligible_rows - u.unlinked_rows - u.scored_rows, 0), ' (',
    FORMAT_NUMBER((u.eligible_rows - u.unlinked_rows - u.scored_rows) * 100.0 / NULLIF(u.eligible_rows, 0), 1),
    '%)') AS `Linked, No Score`
FROM
  tier_shares s CROSS JOIN unlinked u
WHERE
  /* SOT-D9: a tier under 1% of the queue is hidden */
  s.queue_share >= 1
ORDER BY
  `Tier Order`

    OR region = :region
  )
ORDER BY
  market

datasets.name: Sellthrough Cards
datasets.sql:
-- sellthrough_cards_v3 (materialized)
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_artist_lookup
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the picker label resolves to the tour's dates through the shared tour block (Region All =
         the 40-day global tour; Region picked = the per-region tours of its dates there) */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): Region, Market, Venue Type and Benchmark Events narrow the tour dates; the picked-event branch is unchanged */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
scope_counts AS (
  /* Step 22 (C2): Tour Dates Shown = dates left after the filters; Tour Dates Total = every Main date of the tour (in Event view, of the picked event's tour) */
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT event_id_hex)
      FROM
        active_events
    ) AS tour_dates_shown,
    (
      SELECT
        CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pd.event_id_hex) FROM tour_dates pd)
        /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): the period's dates; tour and event views unchanged */
        ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT t.event_id_hex) END
      FROM
        prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_artist_lookup t
      WHERE
        t.event_kind = 'Main'
        /* Step 22 (S6): every Main date of the 40-day global tour (the picked event's, else the picked label's) */
        AND t.tour_id_global
          = COALESCE(
            (
              SELECT
                MAX(e.tour_id_global)
              FROM
                prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_artist_lookup e
              WHERE
                e.event_id_hex
                  = (
                    SELECT
                      event_id_hex
                    FROM
                      resolved_event
                  )
            ),
            (
              SELECT
                MAX(tour_id_global)
              FROM
                picked_tour
            )
          )
    ) AS tour_dates_total
),
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_event), '')
    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_tour), '') END AS tour_label
),
comparison_anchor AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_key,
    /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the comparison tour is followed by its id; the picker label is kept for the benchmark label */
    l.tour_id_global,
    l.tour_display_label,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_label
  FROM
    prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_artist_lookup l CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (C23): :comparison_tour is a picker label (unique among picker tours); matched here once only */
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
benchmark_kind AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
-- STR from phase summary (pre-aggregated capacity)
/* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): STR is the average of the dates' STR, each date built as the benchmark builds an
   event (the same rule as Tab1 Topline date_values) */
date_values AS (
  SELECT
    ps.event_id_hex,
    ps.net_sold,
    ps.net_cap,
    /* STR per date: sold over seats on sale, capped at 100; broken MFX inventory and MFX dates with nothing sold are left out, as in the benchmark */
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.inv_broken = 1
        OR COALESCE(ps.net_cap, 0) <= 0
        OR (
          ps.platform = 'MFX'
          AND COALESCE(ps.net_sold, 0) <= 0
        )
      THEN
        NULL
      ELSE ps.net_sold * 100.0 / GREATEST(ps.net_cap, ps.net_sold)
    END AS date_str
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(platform) AS platform,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        MAX(net_cap) AS net_cap,
        MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken
      FROM
        prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_event_phase_summary
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) ps
),
overall_str AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(date_str), 2) AS overall_str_pct
  FROM
    date_values
),
-- Type breakdown from seat inventory (pre-aggregated in phase summary)
type_totals AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 (F15): Standard Sold from the cap feed, the same numerator as Standard STR (overall sold less VIP and Platinum), floored at 0 (call 4) */
    GREATEST(
      SUM(net_sold) - COALESCE(SUM(vip_sold), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(platinum_sold), 0),
      0
    ) AS standard_sold,
    SUM(vip_sold) AS vip_sold,
    SUM(platinum_sold) AS platinum_sold
  FROM
    (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        event_id_hex,
        net_sold,
        vip_sold,
        platinum_sold
      FROM
        prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_event_phase_summary
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
        AND seat_capacity > 0 /* Step 22 (F15): same events as Tier STR tier_data */
        AND NOT COALESCE(mfx_inventory_broken, false) /* Step 22 (F12) */
    )
),
-- Benchmarks
/* Step 22 Part 1b (C5, Q5 A): each tour date is compared with its own venue type and genre group (Auto), or the
   picked values; the tour's benchmark is the average of its dates' benchmarks, over the same dates the card uses */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
date_bench_rows AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    b.str_mean,
    b.str_event_count,
    /* Same ranking as before Part 1b: market, then region, then all markets; within each, venue and genre, then venue type, then genre, then all music */
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
        ON (
          (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    /* Q6 A: a filter the user picked is never widened; if its group has under 10 events the card says so instead */
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  /* One benchmark per date and metric: the best-ranked group that has a value (10 or more events) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(str_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS str_mean,
    /* The group each date used (for the header and the Q6 note) */
    MIN_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS str_group,
    MIN_BY(str_event_count, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS str_group_events,
    /* Q6 note: the widest group the date was allowed to try (one shared row under a picked filter) */
    MAX_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    ) AS unwidened_group,
    MAX_BY(str_event_count, fallback_rank) AS str_unwidened_events
  FROM
    date_bench_rows
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
bench_cohort AS (
  /* Average of the dates' benchmarks, over the dates where the card itself has a value */
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.str_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS str_mean,
    /* Step 22 (C2), Part 1b: the summed event counts of the distinct groups the dates used */
    (
      SELECT
        SUM(g.str_group_events)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            d2.str_group,
            d2.str_group_events
          FROM
            date_bench d2
              INNER JOIN date_values v2
                ON v2.event_id_hex = d2.event_id_hex
          WHERE
            v2.date_str IS NOT NULL
            AND d2.str_mean IS NOT NULL
        ) g
    ) AS str_event_count
  FROM
    date_values dv
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dv.event_id_hex
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_artist_lookup l
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 (S6): the comparison tour by its id, never its label text. Region All = its 40-day global tour; Region
       picked = the per-region tours that its dates in that region belong to (the tour block rule) */
    (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              tour_id_global
            FROM
              comparison_anchor
          )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            cr2.tour_id_region
          FROM
            prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_artist_lookup cr2
          WHERE
            cr2.event_kind = 'Main'
            AND cr2.region = :region
            AND cr2.tour_id_global
              = (
                SELECT
                  tour_id_global
                FROM
                  comparison_anchor
              )
        )
      )
    )
    AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): the same filters narrow the comparison tour dates, so the benchmark follows every filter */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): the comparison dates built per date exactly like the card, then averaged */
comparison_date_values AS (
  SELECT
    cps.event_id_hex,
    cps.net_sold,
    cps.net_cap,
    /* STR per date: sold over seats on sale, capped at 100; broken MFX inventory and MFX dates with nothing sold are left out, as in the benchmark */
    CASE
      WHEN
        cps.inv_broken = 1
        OR COALESCE(cps.net_cap, 0) <= 0
        OR (
          cps.platform = 'MFX'
          AND COALESCE(cps.net_sold, 0) <= 0
        )
      THEN
        NULL
      ELSE cps.net_sold * 100.0 / GREATEST(cps.net_cap, cps.net_sold)
    END AS date_str
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(platform) AS platform,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        MAX(net_cap) AS net_cap,
        MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken
      FROM
        prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_event_phase_summary
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) cps
),
bench_direct AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(date_str), 2) AS str_mean,
    /* Step 22 (C2): with a comparison set, the comparison dates the STR benchmark averages (capacity above 0, broken MFX inventory out) */
    COUNT(date_str) AS str_event_count
  FROM
    comparison_date_values
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Direct'
),
bench AS (
  SELECT
    str_mean,
    str_event_count
  FROM
    bench_cohort
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    str_mean,
    str_event_count
  FROM
    bench_direct
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Direct'
  LIMIT 1
),
-- Step 22 (C16): sellout date from the phase summary (was recomputed from music_str_daily)
sellout_per_event AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    /* Step 22 (C16): the build's one sellout date (04 sellout_anchor: first day total sold reaches 95% of the STR card's
       capacity, show day included), read instead of recounting str_pct >= 95 */
    MAX(sellout_dt) AS sellout_dt
  FROM
    prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_event_phase_summary
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND sellout_dt IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
  /* Batch 13 (Dan 2026-11-11): Last Phase Sellout and Avg Queue at Sellout leave out Microflex dates whose seat
     count is untrusted (mfx_inventory_broken), as STR and the benchmark (09 event_sellout) do */
  HAVING
    COALESCE(MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)), 0) = 0
),
sellout_time AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(sellout_dt) AS sellout_dt
  FROM
    sellout_per_event
),
phase_close AS (
  /* Batch 14 (C5, Dan 2026-11-17): Last Phase Close = the latest presale queue close (UTC day) */
  SELECT
    CAST(MAX(queue_close_ts) AS DATE) AS last_phase_close
  FROM
    prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_event_phase_summary
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    /* Batch 15 (item 4): presales and the general onsale; post-onsale re-queues stay out */
    AND sale_type IN ('Presale', 'Public Onsale window')
),
queue_at_sellout_per_event AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 (C16): the build's queue_at_sellout (04: fans still in a queue on the sellout date), the per-event value
       the benchmark's queue_at_sellout family averages (09 event_sellout) */
    p.event_id_hex,
    MAX(p.queue_at_sellout) AS fans_in_queue
  FROM
    prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_event_phase_summary p
  WHERE
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        sellout_per_event
    )
    AND p.queue_at_sellout IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    p.event_id_hex
),
queue_at_sellout AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(fans_in_queue), 0) AS fans_still_in_queue
  FROM
    queue_at_sellout_per_event
),
total_queue AS (
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (decision B): each fan counts once per event (event_queue_joins), not once per queue; the
     average is over the dates that had a queue */
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(event_total), 0) AS total_queue_joins
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        eps.event_id_hex,
        /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 2): joins before the queue emptied (event_queue_joins_active), the rule
           of Onsale at a Glance Queue Demand (Tab1 Topline date_queue_joins_active); same queued dates as before */
        CASE
          WHEN MAX(eps.event_queue_joins) > 0 THEN MAX(eps.event_queue_joins_active)
        END AS event_total
      FROM
        prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_event_phase_summary eps
      WHERE
        eps.event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        eps.event_id_hex
    )
),
onsale_start AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(MIN(eps.phase_start) AS DATE) AS onsale_start_date
  FROM
    prod_shared_gold.central_analytics_crd.music_event_phase_summary eps
  WHERE
    eps.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
)
SELECT
  os.overall_str_pct,
  tt.standard_sold,
  tt.vip_sold,
  tt.platinum_sold,
  (
    SELECT
      str_mean
    FROM
      bench
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS bench_str,
  ROUND(
    (
      os.overall_str_pct
        - (
          SELECT
            str_mean
          FROM
            bench
          LIMIT 1
        )
    )
      / NULLIF(
        (
          SELECT
            str_mean
          FROM
            bench
          LIMIT 1
        ),
        0
      )
      * 100,
    1
  ) AS str_pct_over_mean,
  qs.fans_still_in_queue,
  st.sellout_dt AS sellout_date,
  pc.last_phase_close,
  /* Batch 15 (item 4): First Phase Open to Last Phase Close, with the day count (both days included) */
  CASE
    WHEN osd.onsale_start_date IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN pc.last_phase_close IS NULL THEN CONCAT('From ', DATE_FORMAT(osd.onsale_start_date, 'MMM d, yyyy'))
    WHEN YEAR(osd.onsale_start_date) = YEAR(pc.last_phase_close) THEN CONCAT(
      DATE_FORMAT(osd.onsale_start_date, 'MMM d'), ' to ', DATE_FORMAT(pc.last_phase_close, 'MMM d, yyyy'),
      ' (', CAST(DATEDIFF(pc.last_phase_close, osd.onsale_start_date) + 1 AS STRING), ' days)')
    ELSE CONCAT(
      DATE_FORMAT(osd.onsale_start_date, 'MMM d, yyyy'), ' to ', DATE_FORMAT(pc.last_phase_close, 'MMM d, yyyy'),
      ' (', CAST(DATEDIFF(pc.last_phase_close, osd.onsale_start_date) + 1 AS STRING), ' days)')
  END AS onsale_window,
  tq.total_queue_joins,
  osd.onsale_start_date,
  /* Step 22 (C2): event counters for the page header */
  sc.tour_dates_shown AS `Tour Dates Shown`,
  sc.tour_dates_total AS `Tour Dates Total`,
  (
    SELECT
      str_event_count
    FROM
      bench
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS `Benchmark Events`
FROM
  overall_str os
    CROSS JOIN type_totals tt
    CROSS JOIN queue_at_sellout qs
    CROSS JOIN sellout_time st
    CROSS JOIN phase_close pc
    CROSS JOIN total_queue tq
    CROSS JOIN onsale_start osd
    CROSS JOIN scope_counts sc

datasets.name: Demand Cards
datasets.sql:
/* demand_cards: consolidated Tab 3 single-row dataset (v4) */
/* Merges: EDP top-of-funnel + demand funnel + checkout + collision + unsatisfied demand */
/* All from materialized tables + edp_aggr_event_daily (EDP visits) */
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): :tour_name is a picker label; the tour's dates come from the shared tour block */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): Region, Market, Venue Type and Benchmark Events narrow the tour dates; the picked-event branch is unchanged */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
scope_counts AS (
  /* Step 22 (C2): Tour Dates Shown = dates left after the filters; Tour Dates Total = every Main date of the tour (in Event view, of the picked event's tour) */
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT event_id_hex)
      FROM
        active_events
    ) AS tour_dates_shown,
    (
      SELECT
        CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pd.event_id_hex) FROM tour_dates pd)
        /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): the period's dates; tour and event views unchanged */
        ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT t.event_id_hex) END
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` t
      WHERE
        t.event_kind = 'Main'
        /* Step 22 (S6): Tour view = the picked tour's dates from the tour block (Region All the 40-day global tour,
           Region picked its per-region tours); Event view = the picked event's own tour on the same rule */
        AND (
          (
            (
              SELECT
                event_id_hex
              FROM
                resolved_event
            ) IS NULL
            AND t.event_id_hex IN (
              SELECT
                event_id_hex
              FROM
                tour_dates
            )
          )
          OR (
            (
              SELECT
                event_id_hex
              FROM
                resolved_event
            ) IS NOT NULL
            AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
            AND t.tour_id_global
              = (
                SELECT
                  MAX(e.tour_id_global)
                FROM
                  `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` e
                WHERE
                  e.event_id_hex
                    = (
                      SELECT
                        event_id_hex
                      FROM
                        resolved_event
                    )
              )
          )
          OR (
            (
              SELECT
                event_id_hex
              FROM
                resolved_event
            ) IS NOT NULL
            AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
            AND t.tour_id_region
              = (
                SELECT
                  MAX(e.tour_id_region)
                FROM
                  `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` e
                WHERE
                  e.event_id_hex
                    = (
                      SELECT
                        event_id_hex
                      FROM
                        resolved_event
                    )
              )
          )
        )
    ) AS tour_dates_total
),
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_event), '')
    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_tour), '') END AS tour_label
),
comparison_anchor AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_key,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_label,
    /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the comparison tour's ids and picker label */
    l.tour_id_global,
    l.tour_display_label
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (C23): :comparison_tour is a picker label (unique among tour_in_picker tours) */
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
benchmark_kind AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the comparison tour by id, read like the tour block: Region All = the anchor's 40-day global
       tour; Region picked = every Main date in that region of the per-region tours its dates there belong to */
    (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              tour_id_global
            FROM
              comparison_anchor
          )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.region = :region
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            r2.tour_id_region
          FROM
            `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` r2
          WHERE
            r2.event_kind = 'Main'
            AND r2.region = :region
            AND r2.tour_id_global
              = (
                SELECT
                  tour_id_global
                FROM
                  comparison_anchor
              )
        )
      )
    )
    AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): the same filters narrow the comparison tour dates, so the benchmark follows every filter */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): each card is the average of the tour's dates, built per date the same way the
   benchmark builds each event (sql/nightly/09_benchmark_stats.sql), so the card and its benchmark share one basis */
date_values AS (
  SELECT
    ps.*,
    /* Queue conversion per date: buyers over queue joins, queued dates only (09 all_metrics conversion_pct, line 548) */
    CASE
      /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): active buyers over active joins (09 conversion_pct) */
      WHEN
        ps.queue_joins > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(ps.purchasers_active * 100.0 / NULLIF(ps.queue_joins_active, 0), 2)
    END AS date_conv,
    /* Batch 13 (Dan 2026-11-11 D2): Conversion of Released = active buyers over active fans let through (09 conv_a_pct);
       Conversion Before Sellout = buyers over fans let through before seats ran out, blank when no queue ran out
       (09 conv_b_pct) */
    ROUND(ps.purchasers_active * 100.0 / NULLIF(ps.released_active, 0), 2) AS date_conv_a,
    ROUND(ps.purchasers_before_ran_out * 100.0 / NULLIF(ps.released_before_ran_out, 0), 2) AS date_conv_b,
