    /* Reserve collision rate per date, dates with more than 100 reserve attempts only (09 event_collision, lines 416-423) */
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.reserve_attempts > 100
      THEN
        ROUND(ps.reserve_collisions * 100.0 / ps.reserve_attempts, 2)
    END AS date_collision
  /* Step 22 (C10): the per-date unsatisfied estimate is on ARM 1 to 3 now, in date_arm */
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(event_queue_joins) AS queue_joins,
        /* Step 22 (C13, Q8 B): joins before the queue emptied, each fan once per event (build 04 line 197) */
        MAX(event_queue_joins_active) AS queue_joins_active,
        MAX(event_released) AS released,
        /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 3): fans let through among those who joined before the queue emptied, the
           basis of Queue Demand (NULL on exactly the same dates as event_released) */
        MAX(event_released_active) AS released_active,
        MAX(event_purchasers) AS purchasers,
        /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): buyers among fans with a join before the queue emptied (PS event_queue_active) */
        MAX(event_purchasers_active) AS purchasers_active,
        /* Batch 13 (Charlie item 3, Dan 2026-11-11 D2): Conversion Before Sellout inputs, pooled over the date's queues
           that have a seats-ran-out point, as the build's benchmark does (09 event_conv_b) */
        SUM(CASE WHEN seats_ran_out_ts IS NOT NULL THEN released_before_ran_out END) AS released_before_ran_out,
        SUM(CASE WHEN seats_ran_out_ts IS NOT NULL THEN purchasers_before_ran_out END) AS purchasers_before_ran_out,
        SUM(tickets_sold) AS tickets_sold,
        AVG(avg_checkout_min) AS avg_checkout_min,
        MAX(median_checkout_min) AS median_checkout_min,
        MAX(p95_checkout_min) AS p95_checkout_min,
        MAX(reserve_attempts) AS reserve_attempts,
        MAX(reserve_collisions) AS reserve_collisions
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) ps
),
-- Demand funnel from phase_summary
funnel AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 (C13, Q8 B): Queue Demand leaves out joins after the queue emptied; conversion, release rate and the
       demand multiple keep all joins (the build's own basis: 09 conv_* divides by all joins, SPEC known gap) */
    ROUND(AVG(ps.queue_joins_active), 0) AS queue_joins_active,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 3): Released and Release Rate on the same basis as Queue Demand (joins before the queue
       emptied); the demand multiple below keeps its own inputs */
    ROUND(AVG(ps.released_active), 0) AS released,
    ROUND(AVG(ps.purchasers), 0) AS purchasers,
    ROUND(AVG(ps.tickets_sold), 0) AS tickets_sold,
    /* Step 22 Part 1b (A): the average of the dates' conversion, as the benchmark */
    ROUND(AVG(ps.date_conv), 2) AS conversion_pct,
    /* Batch 13: the average of the dates' two new conversions, as the benchmark */
    ROUND(AVG(ps.date_conv_a), 2) AS conv_a_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(ps.date_conv_b), 2) AS conv_b_pct,
    ROUND(
      SUM(ps.released_active) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ps.queue_joins_active), 0),
      1
    ) AS release_rate_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(ps.avg_checkout_min), 2) AS avg_checkout_min,
    MAX(ps.median_checkout_min) AS median_checkout_min,
    MAX(ps.p95_checkout_min) AS p95_checkout_min,
    SUM(ps.reserve_attempts) AS reserve_attempts,
    SUM(ps.reserve_collisions) AS reserve_collisions,
    /* Step 22 Part 1b (A): the average of the dates' collision rate, dates with more than 100 attempts */
    ROUND(AVG(ps.date_collision), 2) AS collision_pct
  FROM
    date_values ps
),
-- Checkout from member-level data (not pre-aggregated phase_summary)
/* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A, averaging only): the median and P95 are taken per date, then averaged over the
   dates, as 09 event_checkout builds each event (lines 371-389); the buyer population is unchanged (F31, C28: Part 2) */
date_checkout AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE(checkout_minutes, 0.5), 2) AS date_median_checkout,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE(checkout_minutes, 0.95), 2) AS date_p95_checkout
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact`
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND purchased = true
    AND checkout_minutes > 0
    /* Step 22 (C28, C20): a queue purchase is within 2 hours of leaving the queue (build 02); a filter, not a cap */
    AND checkout_minutes <= 120
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
checkout AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(date_median_checkout), 1) AS median_checkout_min,
    ROUND(AVG(date_p95_checkout), 1) AS p95_checkout_min
  FROM
    date_checkout
),
-- EDP top-of-funnel (Host-only: US/CA/UK/AU/NZ/IE)
edp_top_funnel AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(page_loads), 0) AS page_loads,
    ROUND(AVG(page_sessions), 0) AS page_sessions,
    ROUND(AVG(unique_users), 0) AS unique_users
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id,
        SUM(total_page_loads) AS page_loads,
        SUM(unique_sessions_count) AS page_sessions,
        SUM(unique_users_count) AS unique_users
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`edp_aggr_event_daily`
      WHERE
        event_id IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id
    )
),
-- Step 22 (S1a, C8, C10): ARM at queue join, per event exactly as build 09 builds each event
/* Copied from build/09_benchmark_stats.sql: arm_first_run (498-502), arm_events (504-514), arm_rows (516-536),
   journey_member / orders_member (386-409), arm_member (555-575), event_arm_fans (577-591), and the all_metrics
   unsatisfied_*_arm13 formulas (751-760). The Low risk non-purchaser card follows :arm_basis (C8); unsatisfied demand
   has no Today version (Dan item 15), so it always reads the score at queue join. */
arm_first_run AS (
  /* the first ARM run, read from the data, never a literal (09 line 498) */
  SELECT
    MIN(run_ts) AS first_run_ts
  FROM
    `prod_marketplace_dse`.`gold`.`arm_risk_score`
),
arm_scope AS (
  /* the card's dates and the comparison dates, read in one pass */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    active_events
  UNION
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_events
),
arm_events AS (
  /* Dan 2026-11-09 (item 13 b): only events whose queue opened on or after the first ARM run (09 arm_events) */
  SELECT
    q.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
  WHERE
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_scope
    )
  GROUP BY
    q.event_id_hex
  HAVING
    /* Dan 2026-11-10: Today reads every date; at queue join only dates from the first ARM run */
    :arm_basis = 'Today'
    OR MIN(q.queue_message_ts)
      >= (
        SELECT
          first_run_ts
        FROM
          arm_first_run
      )
),
arm_journey_member AS (
  /* 09 journey_member: released = any exit at the event, over every queue row */
  SELECT
    q.event_id_hex,
    q.member_id,
    MAX(q.time_of_exit_ts) AS time_of_exit_ts,
    /* Batch 14 (Dan 2026-11-16 flush rule): 1 when the fan has a join before the queue was flushed (09 journey_member active_join) */
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN NOT q.joined_after_flush THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS active_join
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
  WHERE
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_events
    )
  GROUP BY
    q.event_id_hex,
    q.member_id
),
arm_orders_member AS (
  /* 09 orders_member: any purchased row, net queue tickets */
  SELECT
    q.event_id_hex,
    q.member_id,
    SUM(q.tickets_net) AS tickets_purchased
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
  WHERE
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_events
    )
    AND q.purchased = TRUE
  GROUP BY
    q.event_id_hex,
    q.member_id
),
arm_member AS (
  /* 09 arm_rows + arm_member: eligible queue slots, linked accounts only (No score stays a tier); one row per fan and
     event, scored by the fan's latest queue row */
  SELECT
    a.event_id_hex,
    a.member_id,
    MAX_BY(a.arm_risk_score_pit, a.queue_message_ts) AS tier_pit,
    /* C8: the card's basis; 'Today' reads the latest ARM run, anything else the score at queue join */
    MAX_BY(
      CASE
        WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN a.arm_risk_score_today
        ELSE a.arm_risk_score_pit
      END,
      a.queue_message_ts
    ) AS tier_basis,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN o.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS ever_bought,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN jm.time_of_exit_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS was_released,
    MAX(COALESCE(o.tickets_purchased, 0)) AS tickets_bought,
    MAX(COALESCE(jm.active_join, 0)) AS active_join
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` a
      LEFT JOIN arm_orders_member o
        ON o.event_id_hex = a.event_id_hex
        AND o.member_id = a.member_id
      LEFT JOIN arm_journey_member jm
        ON jm.event_id_hex = a.event_id_hex
        AND jm.member_id = a.member_id
  WHERE
    a.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_events
    )
    AND a.arm_queue_eligible
    AND a.arm_linked
  GROUP BY
    a.event_id_hex,
    a.member_id
),
arm_visit_nonpurch AS (
  /* Batch 14 (Dan 2026-11-17): Low-risk Non-Purchaser per queue visit (fan, date, queue), each visit with its
     own ARM tier and bought flag, as Sean Poole's dataset and build 09 event_arm_nonpurch_visit count it */
  SELECT
    a.event_id_hex,
    ROUND(
      COUNT(
        CASE
          WHEN
            NOT COALESCE(a.purchased, FALSE)
            AND (
              CASE
                WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN a.arm_risk_score_today
                ELSE a.arm_risk_score_pit
              END
            ) IN ('1', '2')
          THEN
            1
        END
      )
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN NOT COALESCE(a.purchased, FALSE) THEN 1
            END
          ),
          0
        ),
      2
    ) AS low_nonpurch_pct
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` a
  WHERE
    a.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_events
    )
    AND a.arm_queue_eligible
    AND a.arm_linked
  GROUP BY
    a.event_id_hex
),
date_arm AS (
  SELECT
    f.event_id_hex,
    v.low_nonpurch_pct,
    f.noscore_joins,
    /* C10 (Dan item 14 b): 09 all_metrics unsatisfied_fans_arm13 / unsatisfied_tix_arm13, every term on ARM 1 to 3 */
    CASE
      WHEN
        f.queue_joins_arm13 IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        GREATEST(
          ROUND(
            (
              CAST(f.purchasers_arm13 AS DOUBLE)
                / NULLIF(f.released_arm13, 0)
                * f.queue_joins_arm13
                * (CAST(f.tickets_arm13 AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(f.purchasers_arm13, 0))
                - f.tickets_arm13
            )
              / NULLIF(CAST(f.tickets_arm13 AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(f.purchasers_arm13, 0), 0),
            0
          ),
          0
        )
    END AS date_unsat_fans,
    CASE
      WHEN
        f.queue_joins_arm13 IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        GREATEST(
          ROUND(
            CAST(f.purchasers_arm13 AS DOUBLE)
              / NULLIF(f.released_arm13, 0)
              * f.queue_joins_arm13
              * (CAST(f.tickets_arm13 AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(f.purchasers_arm13, 0))
              - f.tickets_arm13,
            0
          ),
          0
        )
    END AS date_unsat_tix
  FROM
    (
      /* 09 event_arm_fans */
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        /* S1a 3.0b: Low risk (ARM 1 to 2) share of the fans who never bought */
        ROUND(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN
                ever_bought = 0
                AND tier_basis IN ('1', '2')
              THEN
                1
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(
              COUNT(
                CASE
                  WHEN ever_bought = 0 THEN 1
                END
              ),
              0
            ),
          2
        ) AS low_nonpurch_pct,
        /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): the ARM 1 to 3 unsatisfied terms on fans with a join before the queue emptied (09) */
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN
              tier_basis IN ('1', '2', '3')
              AND active_join = 1
            THEN
              1
          END
        ) AS queue_joins_arm13,
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN
              tier_basis IN ('1', '2', '3')
              AND active_join = 1
              AND was_released = 1
            THEN
              1
          END
        ) AS released_arm13,
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN
              tier_basis IN ('1', '2', '3')
              AND active_join = 1
              AND ever_bought = 1
            THEN
              1
          END
        ) AS purchasers_arm13,
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN
              tier_basis IN ('1', '2', '3')
              AND active_join = 1
            THEN
              tickets_bought
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) AS tickets_arm13,
        /* C10: No score joiners, shown as their own line beside the estimate */
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN tier_pit = 'No score' THEN 1
          END
        ) AS noscore_joins
      FROM
        arm_member
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) f
      LEFT JOIN arm_visit_nonpurch v
        ON v.event_id_hex = f.event_id_hex
),
date_trusted_nonpurch AS (
  /* S1a: the card's per-date share, now ARM Low risk (field names kept so the widgets still bind) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    low_nonpurch_pct AS trusted_nonpurch_pct
  FROM
    date_arm
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
-- Unsatisfied demand
unsatisfied AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 Part 1b (A): the average of the dates' estimates (each date estimated as 09 does) */
    /* Step 22 (C10): on ARM 1 to 3, the dates in arm_events (09 coverage rule) */
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(date_unsat_fans), 0)
      FROM
        date_arm
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
    ) AS unsatisfied_fans,
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(date_unsat_tix), 0)
      FROM
        date_arm
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
    ) AS unsatisfied_tickets,
    ROUND(
      (
        AVG(ps.purchasers)
          * 1.0
          / NULLIF(AVG(ps.released), 0)
          * AVG(ps.queue_joins)
          * (AVG(ps.tickets_sold) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(ps.purchasers), 0))
      )
        / NULLIF(AVG(ps.tickets_sold), 0),
      2
    ) AS demand_multiple
  FROM
    date_values ps
),
trusted_nonpurch AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(trusted_nonpurch_pct), 1) AS trusted_nonpurchaser_pct,
    /* Step 22 (C10): No score joiners per date, averaged over the dates the ARM estimate covers */
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(noscore_joins), 0)
      FROM
        date_arm
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
    ) AS noscore_joins
  FROM
    date_trusted_nonpurch
),
-- Benchmark (cascading fallback)
/* Step 22 Part 1b (C5, Q5 A): each tour date is compared with its own venue type and genre group (Auto), or the
   picked values; the tour's benchmark is the average of its dates' benchmarks, over the same dates the card uses */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
date_bench_rows AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    /* Step 22 (C13): the Queue Demand benchmark on the active join count (09 queue_active_*) */
    b.queue_active_mean AS queue_mean,
    b.queue_active_event_count AS queue_event_count,
    b.released_mean,
    b.released_event_count,
    b.purchasers_mean,
    b.purchasers_event_count,
    b.conv_mean,
    b.conv_event_count,
    /* Batch 13: the build's conv_a / conv_b families (09) */
    b.conv_a_mean,
    b.conv_a_event_count,
    b.conv_b_mean,
    b.conv_b_event_count,
    /* Step 22 (TB2): Tickets sold via queue compares with queue tickets per event (09 queue_tix_*), not all-channel tix_mean */
    b.queue_tix_mean AS tix_mean,
    b.queue_tix_event_count AS tix_event_count,
    b.checkout_mean,
    b.checkout_event_count,
    b.p95_checkout_mean,
    b.p95_checkout_event_count,
    b.collision_mean,
    b.collision_event_count,
    /* Step 22 (C10): unsatisfied demand on ARM 1 to 3 (09 unsat_*_arm13_*); Dan 2026-11-10 (item 15 b): Today reads
       the Today family (unsat_*_arm13_today_*) */
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.unsat_fans_arm13_today_mean
      ELSE b.unsat_fans_arm13_mean
    END AS unsatisfied_fans_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.unsat_fans_arm13_today_event_count
      ELSE b.unsat_fans_arm13_event_count
    END AS unsatisfied_fans_event_count,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.unsat_tix_arm13_today_mean
      ELSE b.unsat_tix_arm13_mean
    END AS unsatisfied_tix_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.unsat_tix_arm13_today_event_count
      ELSE b.unsat_tix_arm13_event_count
    END AS unsatisfied_tix_event_count,
    b.sessions_mean,
    b.sessions_event_count,
    /* Step 22 (S1a, C8): Low risk non-purchaser on ARM, at queue join or Today (09 arm_low_nonpurch_*, *_today_*) */
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_low_nonpurch_today_mean
      ELSE b.arm_low_nonpurch_mean
    END AS trusted_nonpurch_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_low_nonpurch_today_event_count
      ELSE b.arm_low_nonpurch_event_count
    END AS trusted_nonpurch_event_count,
    /* Same ranking as before Part 1b: market, then region, then all markets; within each, venue and genre, then venue type, then genre, then all music */
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
        ON (
          (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    /* Q6 A: a filter the user picked is never widened; if its group has under 10 events the card says so instead */
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  /* One benchmark per date and metric: the best-ranked group that has a value (10 or more events) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(queue_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE queue_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS queue_mean,
    MIN_BY(released_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE released_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS released_mean,
    MIN_BY(purchasers_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE purchasers_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS purchasers_mean,
    MIN_BY(conv_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE conv_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS conv_mean,
    MIN_BY(conv_a_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE conv_a_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS conv_a_mean,
    MIN_BY(conv_b_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE conv_b_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS conv_b_mean,
    MIN_BY(tix_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE tix_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS tix_mean,
    MIN_BY(checkout_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE checkout_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS checkout_mean,
    MIN_BY(p95_checkout_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE p95_checkout_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS p95_checkout_mean,
    MIN_BY(collision_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE collision_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS collision_mean,
    MIN_BY(unsatisfied_fans_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE unsatisfied_fans_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS unsatisfied_fans_mean,
    MIN_BY(unsatisfied_tix_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE unsatisfied_tix_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS unsatisfied_tix_mean,
    MIN_BY(sessions_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE sessions_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS sessions_mean,
    MIN_BY(trusted_nonpurch_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE trusted_nonpurch_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS trusted_nonpurch_mean,
    /* The group each date used (for the header and the Q6 note) */
    MIN_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE queue_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS queue_group,
    MIN_BY(queue_event_count, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE queue_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS queue_group_events,
    /* Q6 note: the widest group the date was allowed to try (one shared row under a picked filter) */
    MAX_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    ) AS unwidened_group,
    MAX_BY(queue_event_count, fallback_rank) AS queue_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(released_event_count, fallback_rank) AS released_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(purchasers_event_count, fallback_rank) AS purchasers_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(conv_event_count, fallback_rank) AS conv_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(conv_a_event_count, fallback_rank) AS conv_a_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(conv_b_event_count, fallback_rank) AS conv_b_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(tix_event_count, fallback_rank) AS tix_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(checkout_event_count, fallback_rank) AS checkout_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(p95_checkout_event_count, fallback_rank) AS p95_checkout_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(collision_event_count, fallback_rank) AS collision_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(unsatisfied_fans_event_count, fallback_rank) AS unsatisfied_fans_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(unsatisfied_tix_event_count, fallback_rank) AS unsatisfied_tix_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(sessions_event_count, fallback_rank) AS sessions_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(trusted_nonpurch_event_count, fallback_rank) AS trusted_nonpurch_unwidened_events
  FROM
    date_bench_rows
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
edp_dates AS (
  /* Dates with EDP rows (the dates the EDP Visits card averages) */
  SELECT
  DISTINCT
    event_id AS event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`edp_aggr_event_daily`
  WHERE
    event_id IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
date_card AS (
  /* One row per tour date: the card's per-date values beside that date's own benchmark */
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    dv.queue_joins,
    /* Step 22 (C13) */
    dv.queue_joins_active,
    dv.released,
    dv.purchasers,
    dv.tickets_sold,
    dv.date_conv,
    dv.date_conv_a,
    dv.date_conv_b,
    dv.date_collision,
    /* Step 22 (C10): ARM 1 to 3 estimate */
    da.date_unsat_fans,
    da.date_unsat_tix,
    dc.date_median_checkout,
    dc.date_p95_checkout,
    dt.trusted_nonpurch_pct,
    ed.event_id_hex AS edp_event_id_hex,
    db.queue_mean,
    db.released_mean,
    db.purchasers_mean,
    db.conv_mean,
    db.conv_a_mean,
    db.conv_b_mean,
    db.tix_mean,
    db.checkout_mean,
    db.p95_checkout_mean,
    db.collision_mean,
    db.unsatisfied_fans_mean,
    db.unsatisfied_tix_mean,
    db.sessions_mean,
    db.trusted_nonpurch_mean,
    db.queue_group,
    db.queue_group_events,
    db.unwidened_group,
    db.queue_unwidened_events,
    db.released_unwidened_events,
    db.purchasers_unwidened_events,
    db.conv_unwidened_events,
    db.conv_a_unwidened_events,
    db.conv_b_unwidened_events,
    db.tix_unwidened_events,
    db.checkout_unwidened_events,
    db.p95_checkout_unwidened_events,
    db.collision_unwidened_events,
    db.unsatisfied_fans_unwidened_events,
    db.unsatisfied_tix_unwidened_events,
    db.sessions_unwidened_events,
    db.trusted_nonpurch_unwidened_events
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      LEFT JOIN date_values dv
        ON dv.event_id_hex = dk.event_id_hex
      LEFT JOIN date_checkout dc
        ON dc.event_id_hex = dk.event_id_hex
      LEFT JOIN date_trusted_nonpurch dt
        ON dt.event_id_hex = dk.event_id_hex
      LEFT JOIN date_arm da
        ON da.event_id_hex = dk.event_id_hex
      LEFT JOIN edp_dates ed
        ON ed.event_id_hex = dk.event_id_hex
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dk.event_id_hex
),
bench_cohort AS (
  /* Average of the dates' benchmarks, over the dates where the card itself has a value */
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.queue_joins_active IS NOT NULL THEN c.queue_mean
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS queue_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.released IS NOT NULL THEN c.released_mean
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS released_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.purchasers IS NOT NULL THEN c.purchasers_mean
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS purchasers_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.date_conv IS NOT NULL THEN c.conv_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS conv_mean,
    /* Batch 13: over the dates where each new card has a value */
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.date_conv_a IS NOT NULL THEN c.conv_a_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS conv_a_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.date_conv_b IS NOT NULL THEN c.conv_b_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS conv_b_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.tickets_sold IS NOT NULL THEN c.tix_mean
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS tix_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.date_median_checkout IS NOT NULL THEN c.checkout_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS checkout_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.date_p95_checkout IS NOT NULL THEN c.p95_checkout_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS p95_checkout_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.date_collision IS NOT NULL THEN c.collision_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS collision_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.date_unsat_fans IS NOT NULL THEN c.unsatisfied_fans_mean
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS unsatisfied_fans_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.date_unsat_tix IS NOT NULL THEN c.unsatisfied_tix_mean
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS unsatisfied_tix_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.edp_event_id_hex IS NOT NULL THEN c.sessions_mean
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS sessions_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.trusted_nonpurch_pct IS NOT NULL THEN c.trusted_nonpurch_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS trusted_nonpurch_mean,
    /* Step 22 (C2), Part 1b: Queue Demand Volume benchmark events = the summed event counts of the distinct groups its dates used */
    (
      SELECT
        SUM(g.queue_group_events)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            queue_group,
            queue_group_events
          FROM
            date_card
          WHERE
            queue_joins_active IS NOT NULL
            AND queue_mean IS NOT NULL
        ) g
    ) AS queue_event_count
  FROM
    date_card c
),
comparison_date_values AS (
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): the comparison tour is built per date exactly like the card (date_values), then averaged */
  SELECT
    cps.*,
    /* Queue conversion per date: buyers over queue joins, queued dates only (09 all_metrics conversion_pct, line 548) */
    CASE
      /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): same as the card */
      WHEN
        cps.queue_joins > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(cps.purchasers_active * 100.0 / NULLIF(cps.queue_joins_active, 0), 2)
    END AS date_conv,
    /* Batch 13 (Dan 2026-11-11 D2): Conversion of Released = active buyers over active fans let through (09 conv_a_pct);
       Conversion Before Sellout = buyers over fans let through before seats ran out, blank when no queue ran out
       (09 conv_b_pct) */
    ROUND(cps.purchasers_active * 100.0 / NULLIF(cps.released_active, 0), 2) AS date_conv_a,
    ROUND(cps.purchasers_before_ran_out * 100.0 / NULLIF(cps.released_before_ran_out, 0), 2) AS date_conv_b,
    /* Reserve collision rate per date, dates with more than 100 reserve attempts only (09 event_collision, lines 416-423) */
    CASE
      WHEN
        cps.reserve_attempts > 100
      THEN
        ROUND(cps.reserve_collisions * 100.0 / cps.reserve_attempts, 2)
    END AS date_collision
  /* Step 22 (C10): the per-date unsatisfied estimate is on ARM 1 to 3 now, in date_arm */
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(event_queue_joins) AS queue_joins,
        /* Step 22 (C13, Q8 B): joins before the queue emptied, each fan once per event (build 04 line 197) */
        MAX(event_queue_joins_active) AS queue_joins_active,
        MAX(event_released) AS released,
        /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 3): same as date_values */
        MAX(event_released_active) AS released_active,
        MAX(event_purchasers) AS purchasers,
        /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): buyers among fans with a join before the queue emptied (PS event_queue_active) */
        MAX(event_purchasers_active) AS purchasers_active,
        /* Batch 13: same as date_values */
        SUM(CASE WHEN seats_ran_out_ts IS NOT NULL THEN released_before_ran_out END) AS released_before_ran_out,
        SUM(CASE WHEN seats_ran_out_ts IS NOT NULL THEN purchasers_before_ran_out END) AS purchasers_before_ran_out,
        SUM(tickets_sold) AS tickets_sold,
        MAX(reserve_attempts) AS reserve_attempts,
        MAX(reserve_collisions) AS reserve_collisions
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) cps
),
comparison_date_checkout AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE(checkout_minutes, 0.5), 2) AS date_median_checkout,
    ROUND(PERCENTILE(checkout_minutes, 0.95), 2) AS date_p95_checkout
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact`
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        comparison_events
    )
    AND purchased = true
    AND checkout_minutes > 0
    /* Step 22 (C28, C20): a queue purchase is within 2 hours of leaving the queue (build 02); a filter, not a cap */
    AND checkout_minutes <= 120
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
comparison_date_trusted_nonpurch AS (
  /* Step 22 (S1a, C8): the comparison dates' ARM Low risk share, built exactly like the card's (date_arm) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    low_nonpurch_pct AS trusted_nonpurch_pct
  FROM
    date_arm
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        comparison_events
    )
),
bench_direct AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 (C13) */
    ROUND(AVG(cps.queue_joins_active), 0) AS queue_mean,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 3): the comparison tour on the card's basis */
    ROUND(AVG(cps.released_active), 0) AS released_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(cps.purchasers), 0) AS purchasers_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(cps.date_conv), 2) AS conv_mean,
    /* Batch 13: the comparison tour's dates, built like the card */
    ROUND(AVG(cps.date_conv_a), 2) AS conv_a_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(cps.date_conv_b), 2) AS conv_b_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(cps.tickets_sold), 0) AS tix_mean,
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(date_median_checkout), 1)
      FROM
        comparison_date_checkout
    ) AS checkout_mean,
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(date_p95_checkout), 1)
      FROM
        comparison_date_checkout
    ) AS p95_checkout_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(cps.date_collision), 2) AS collision_mean,
    /* Step 22 (C10): the comparison dates' ARM 1 to 3 estimate */
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(date_unsat_fans), 0)
      FROM
        date_arm
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
    ) AS unsatisfied_fans_mean,
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(date_unsat_tix), 0)
      FROM
        date_arm
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
    ) AS unsatisfied_tix_mean,
    CAST(NULL AS FLOAT) AS sessions_mean,
    /* Step 22 (C4), Part 1b: Trusted Non-Purchaser benchmark = the card's per-date share over the comparison dates, averaged (fan score today; S1a moves it to ARM in Part 2) */
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(trusted_nonpurch_pct), 1)
      FROM
        comparison_date_trusted_nonpurch
    ) AS trusted_nonpurch_mean,
    /* Step 22 (C2): with a comparison set, the comparison dates that have a queue count (the events the Queue Demand Volume benchmark averages) */
    COUNT(cps.queue_joins_active) AS queue_event_count
  FROM
    comparison_date_values cps
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Direct'
),
bench AS (
  /* Step 22 (C2): columns listed so the two union branches line up by name, not position */
  SELECT
    queue_mean,
    released_mean,
    purchasers_mean,
    conv_mean,
    conv_a_mean,
    conv_b_mean,
    tix_mean,
    checkout_mean,
    p95_checkout_mean,
    collision_mean,
    unsatisfied_fans_mean,
    unsatisfied_tix_mean,
    sessions_mean,
    trusted_nonpurch_mean,
    queue_event_count
  FROM
    bench_cohort
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort'
  UNION ALL
  /* Step 22 (C2): columns listed so the two union branches line up by name, not position */
  SELECT
    queue_mean,
    released_mean,
    purchasers_mean,
    conv_mean,
    conv_a_mean,
    conv_b_mean,
    tix_mean,
    checkout_mean,
    p95_checkout_mean,
    collision_mean,
    unsatisfied_fans_mean,
    unsatisfied_tix_mean,
    sessions_mean,
    trusted_nonpurch_mean,
    queue_event_count
  FROM
    bench_direct
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Direct'
  LIMIT 1
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (Q6 A): a filter the user picked is never widened; when no date in view has a benchmark for a
   card's family, the card's note says so with the size of the groups it would have used */
note_dates AS (
  /* one read of date_card, one row per date and card family where the card has a value (STACK unpivot) */
  SELECT
    s.family,
    dc.unwidened_group,
    s.unwidened_events,
    s.bench_value
  FROM
    date_card dc
    LATERAL VIEW
      STACK(
        13,
        'queue',
        CAST(dc.queue_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.queue_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.queue_joins_active IS NOT NULL,
        'released',
        CAST(dc.released_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.released_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.released IS NOT NULL,
        'purchasers',
        CAST(dc.purchasers_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.purchasers_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.purchasers IS NOT NULL,
        'tix',
        CAST(dc.tix_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.tix_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.tickets_sold IS NOT NULL,
        'conv',
        CAST(dc.conv_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.conv_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.date_conv IS NOT NULL,
        'conv_a',
        CAST(dc.conv_a_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.conv_a_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.date_conv_a IS NOT NULL,
        'conv_b',
        CAST(dc.conv_b_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.conv_b_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.date_conv_b IS NOT NULL,
        'collision',
        CAST(dc.collision_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.collision_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.date_collision IS NOT NULL,
        'checkout',
        CAST(dc.checkout_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.checkout_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.date_median_checkout IS NOT NULL,
        'p95_checkout',
        CAST(dc.p95_checkout_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.p95_checkout_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.date_p95_checkout IS NOT NULL,
        'unsatisfied_tix',
        CAST(dc.unsatisfied_tix_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.unsatisfied_tix_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.date_unsat_tix IS NOT NULL,
        'unsatisfied_fans',
        CAST(dc.unsatisfied_fans_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.unsatisfied_fans_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.date_unsat_fans IS NOT NULL,
        'trusted_nonpurch',
        CAST(dc.trusted_nonpurch_unwidened_events AS BIGINT),
        CAST(dc.trusted_nonpurch_mean AS DOUBLE),
        dc.trusted_nonpurch_pct IS NOT NULL
      ) s
      AS family, unwidened_events, bench_value, has_card_value
  WHERE
    s.has_card_value
),
note_group_events AS (
  /* n for the too-few text: the summed sizes of the distinct groups the card's dates would use */
  SELECT
    family,
    SUM(group_events) AS group_events
  FROM
    (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        family,
        unwidened_group,
        COALESCE(unwidened_events, 0) AS group_events
      FROM
        note_dates
    ) g
  GROUP BY
    family
),
bench_notes AS (
  /* Q6 partial case (Dan 2026-11-06): in any cohort view, when only k of the card's n dates have a benchmark, the
     benchmark averages those k dates and the note says so; no note when k = n or the card is blank */
  SELECT
    d.family,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) <> 'Cohort'
      THEN
        NULL
      WHEN
        COUNT(d.bench_value) = 0
        AND (
          COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
          OR COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
          OR COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
          OR COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
          /* Dan 2026-11-07 (C5 rule): a Time Window other than the default, or queued-only, also counts as picked */
          OR (COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') <> 'all' AND NOT (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL))
          OR COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') <> 'all'
        )
      THEN
        CASE
          /* Dan 2026-11-07: no group is stored for these filters at all */
          WHEN
            COALESCE(MAX(ge.group_events), 0) = 0
          THEN
            'No comparable events for these filters'
          ELSE
            CONCAT(
              'Too few events for a benchmark (',
              CAST(MAX(ge.group_events) AS STRING),
              CASE
                WHEN CAST(CAST(MAX(ge.group_events) AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
                ELSE ' events)'
              END
            )
        END
      WHEN
        COUNT(d.bench_value) > 0
        AND COUNT(d.bench_value) < COUNT(*)
      THEN
        CONCAT(
          'Benchmark on ',
          CAST(COUNT(d.bench_value) AS STRING),
          ' of ',
          CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING),
          ' dates'
        )
    END AS note
  FROM
    note_dates d
      LEFT JOIN note_group_events ge
        ON ge.family = d.family
  GROUP BY
    d.family
),
bench_notes_row AS (
  /* one row holding every card's note, joined once (reading bench_notes once per column was slow) */
  SELECT
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'queue' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_queue,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'released' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_released,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'purchasers' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_purchasers,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'tix' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_tix,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'conv' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_conv,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'conv_a' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_conv_a,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'conv_b' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_conv_b,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'collision' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_collision,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'checkout' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_checkout,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'p95_checkout' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_p95_checkout,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'unsatisfied_tix' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_unsatisfied_tix,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'unsatisfied_fans' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_unsatisfied_fans,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'trusted_nonpurch' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_trusted_nonpurch
  FROM
    bench_notes
)
SELECT
  edp.page_sessions AS `EDP Visits`,
  f.queue_joins_active AS `Queue Demand Volume`,
  f.released AS `Released from Queue`,
  f.purchasers AS `Purchasers`,
  f.tickets_sold AS `Tickets Sold`,
  f.conversion_pct AS `Queue-to-Purchase Conversion (%)`,
  f.release_rate_pct AS `Release Rate (%)`,
  co.median_checkout_min AS `Median Checkout (min)`,
  co.p95_checkout_min AS `P95 Checkout (min)`,
  f.collision_pct AS `Reserve Collision Rate (%)`,
  u.unsatisfied_fans AS `Unsatisfied Fans`,
  ROUND(u.unsatisfied_tickets, 0) AS `Unsatisfied Tickets (est)`,
  u.demand_multiple AS `Demand Multiple`,
  tnp.trusted_nonpurchaser_pct AS `Trusted Non-Purchaser (%)`,
  /* Step 22 (C10): No score joiners (left out of the ARM 1 to 3 estimate), per date averaged */
  tnp.noscore_joins AS `No Score Joins`,
  b.conv_mean AS `Conversion Benchmark`,
  b.checkout_mean AS `Checkout Benchmark`,
  b.collision_mean AS `Collision Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (f.conversion_pct - b.conv_mean) / NULLIF(b.conv_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Conversion vs Benchmark (%)`,
  /* Batch 13 (Dan 2026-11-11 D2, D4): the two new conversion cards and their benchmarks */
  f.conv_a_pct AS `Conversion of Released (%)`,
  b.conv_a_mean AS `Conversion of Released Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (f.conv_a_pct - b.conv_a_mean) / NULLIF(b.conv_a_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Conversion of Released vs Benchmark (%)`,
  f.conv_b_pct AS `Conversion Before Sellout (%)`,
  b.conv_b_mean AS `Conversion Before Sellout Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (f.conv_b_pct - b.conv_b_mean) / NULLIF(b.conv_b_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Conversion Before Sellout vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (co.median_checkout_min - b.checkout_mean) / NULLIF(b.checkout_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Checkout vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (f.collision_pct - b.collision_mean) / NULLIF(b.collision_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Collision vs Benchmark (%)`,
  b.queue_mean AS `Queue Benchmark`,
  b.released_mean AS `Released Benchmark`,
  b.purchasers_mean AS `Purchasers Benchmark`,
  b.p95_checkout_mean AS `P95 Checkout Benchmark`,
  b.unsatisfied_tix_mean AS `Unsatisfied Tickets Benchmark`,
  b.unsatisfied_fans_mean AS `Unsatisfied Fans Benchmark`,
  b.trusted_nonpurch_mean AS `Trusted Non-Purchaser Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (f.queue_joins_active - b.queue_mean) / NULLIF(b.queue_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Queue vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (f.released - b.released_mean) / NULLIF(b.released_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Released vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (f.purchasers - b.purchasers_mean) / NULLIF(b.purchasers_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Purchasers vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (co.p95_checkout_min - b.p95_checkout_mean) / NULLIF(b.p95_checkout_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `P95 vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (ROUND(u.unsatisfied_tickets, 0) - b.unsatisfied_tix_mean)
      / NULLIF(b.unsatisfied_tix_mean, 0)
      * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Unsatisfied Tickets vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (u.unsatisfied_fans - b.unsatisfied_fans_mean) / NULLIF(b.unsatisfied_fans_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Unsatisfied Fans vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (tnp.trusted_nonpurchaser_pct - b.trusted_nonpurch_mean)
      / NULLIF(b.trusted_nonpurch_mean, 0)
      * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Trusted Non-Purchaser vs Benchmark (%)`,
  b.sessions_mean AS `EDP Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (edp.page_sessions - b.sessions_mean) / NULLIF(b.sessions_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `EDP vs Benchmark (%)`,
  b.tix_mean AS `Tickets Sold Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (f.tickets_sold - b.tix_mean) / NULLIF(b.tix_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Tickets Sold vs Benchmark (%)`,
  /* Step 22 (C2): event counters for the page header */
  sc.tour_dates_shown AS `Tour Dates Shown`,
  sc.tour_dates_total AS `Tour Dates Total`,
  b.queue_event_count AS `Benchmark Events`,
  /* Step 22 (C4): benchmark label when a comparison tour or event is set: <comparison tour label> . <n> events, n = the events the headline benchmark used */
  CASE
    WHEN
      (
        SELECT
          benchmark_kind
        FROM
          benchmark_kind
      ) = 'Direct'
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        (
          SELECT
            /* Step 22 (C23): the comparison tour's picker label */
            COALESCE(tour_display_label, tour_label, artist_name)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ),
        ' . ',
        CAST(b.queue_event_count AS STRING),
        ' events'
      )
  END AS `Benchmark Label`,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (Q6): one note per benchmarked card, empty unless a picked filter leaves no benchmark */
  COALESCE(nr.note_queue, '') AS `Queue Demand Volume Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_released, '') AS `Released from Queue Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_purchasers, '') AS `Purchasers Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_tix, '') AS `Tickets Sold Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_conv, '') AS `Queue-to-Purchase Conversion (%) Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_conv_a, '') AS `Conversion of Released (%) Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_conv_b, '') AS `Conversion Before Sellout (%) Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_collision, '') AS `Reserve Collision Rate (%) Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_checkout, '') AS `Median Checkout (min) Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_p95_checkout, '') AS `P95 Checkout (min) Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_unsatisfied_tix, '') AS `Unsatisfied Tickets (est) Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_unsatisfied_fans, '') AS `Unsatisfied Fans Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_trusted_nonpurch, '') AS `Trusted Non-Purchaser (%) Benchmark Note`
FROM
  funnel f
    CROSS JOIN checkout co
    CROSS JOIN edp_top_funnel edp
    CROSS JOIN unsatisfied u
    CROSS JOIN trusted_nonpurch tnp
    LEFT JOIN bench b
      ON 1 = 1
    CROSS JOIN scope_counts sc
    CROSS JOIN bench_notes_row nr

datasets.name: Fan Quality Cards
