/* fanquality_cards: consolidated Tab 4 single-row dataset (v3) */
/* Merges: access counts + gradient + trusted fan + ARM T4-T5 + benchmarks */
/* Reads from music_queue_member_fact (ARM per queue row, Step 22 S1) + arm_risk_score (first run only) + music_benchmark_stats */
WITH resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
/* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when the Region filter is active). */
picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 S6/C23: the picked tour's dates come from the shared tour block (picker label, never tour_label) */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): Region, Market, Venue Type and Benchmark Events narrow the tour dates; the picked-event branch is unchanged */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
scope_counts AS (
  /* Step 22 (C2): Tour Dates Shown = dates left after the filters; Tour Dates Total = every Main date of the tour (in Event view, of the picked event's tour) */
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT event_id_hex)
      FROM
        active_events
    ) AS tour_dates_shown,
    (
      SELECT
        CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pd.event_id_hex) FROM tour_dates pd)
        /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): the period's dates; tour and event views unchanged */
        ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT t.event_id_hex) END
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` t
      WHERE
        t.event_kind = 'Main'
        /* Step 22 S6/C23: the tour by its id (the picked event's 40-day tour in Event view, the picked tour in Tour
           view); in Tour view the dates the Region rule adds are counted too, so Shown never exceeds Total */
        AND (
          t.tour_id_global
            = COALESCE(
              (
                SELECT
                  MAX(e.tour_id_global)
                FROM
                  `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` e
                WHERE
                  e.event_id_hex
                    = (
                      SELECT
                        event_id_hex
                      FROM
                        resolved_event
                    )
              ),
              (
                SELECT
                  MAX(tour_id_global)
                FROM
                  picked_tour
              )
            )
          OR (
            (
              SELECT
                event_id_hex
              FROM
                resolved_event
            ) IS NULL
            AND t.event_id_hex IN (
              SELECT
                event_id_hex
              FROM
                tour_dates
            )
          )
        )
    ) AS tour_dates_total
),
/* Step 22 (C4): a comparison tour or event drives every benchmark on this page (the card formulas over the comparison
   dates, filtered as the tour). Moved up from below the cohort benchmark so the ARM per-date values can be built once
   for the tour's and the comparison's dates. S6/C23: the comparison tour is a picker label resolved to its tour id,
   and its dates follow the same Region rule as the tour block (global tour at Region All, per-region tours otherwise). */
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_event), '')
    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_tour), '') END AS tour_label
),
comparison_anchor AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_id_global,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_display_label AS tour_label
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
comparison_tour_regions AS (
  /* Region picked: the per-region tours that the comparison tour's dates in that region belong to (as picked_tour_regions) */
  SELECT
  DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        comparison_anchor
    )
),
benchmark_kind AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.region = :region
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            comparison_tour_regions
        )
      )
    )
    /* Step 22 (C1): the same filters narrow the comparison tour dates, so the benchmark follows every filter */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
/* Step 22 S1, S1a, C8: every ARM measure reads the member fact's ARM score per queue row (score at queue join by
   default, today's score when arm_basis = 'Today'). Only queues in an eligible config slot and rows with a linked
   account count (SOT-D1: unlinked rows out); No score stays in every denominator as its own tier.
   Benchmarked cards (Trusted = ARM 1 to 2 ticket share, ARM 4 to 5 ticket share, Gradient) use only dates whose queue
   opened on or after the first ARM run, the rule the benchmark families are built on (build 09 arm_first_run and
   arm_events, lines 498-514; Dan 2026-11-09, item 13 b), so card and benchmark cover the same kind of date. */
arm_first_run AS (
  /* the first ARM run, read from the data, never a literal (build 09 lines 498-502) */
  SELECT
    MIN(run_ts) AS first_run_ts
  FROM
    `prod_marketplace_dse`.`gold`.`arm_risk_score`
),
arm_dates AS (
  /* the tour's dates and the comparison dates, so each date's ARM values are built once by one rule */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    active_events
  UNION
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_events
),
arm_covered_dates AS (
  /* build 09 arm_events (lines 504-514): the date's earliest member-fact queue message, over all its queues and slots,
     is on or after the first ARM run */
  SELECT
    q.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
  WHERE
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_dates
    )
  GROUP BY
    q.event_id_hex
  HAVING
    /* Dan 2026-11-10: Today reads every date; at queue join only dates from the first ARM run */
    :arm_basis = 'Today'
    OR MIN(q.queue_message_ts)
      >= (
        SELECT
          first_run_ts
        FROM
          arm_first_run
      )
),
arm_rows AS (
  /* build 09 arm_rows (lines 516-535): eligible slot, linked account, net tickets on buying rows; C8 picks the basis */
  SELECT
    q.event_id_hex,
    q.member_id,
    q.queue_message_ts,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN q.arm_risk_score_today
      ELSE q.arm_risk_score_pit
    END AS arm_tier,
    q.entered,
    q.purchased,
    CASE
      WHEN q.purchased THEN q.tickets_net
      ELSE 0
    END AS tickets_net,
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_covered_dates
    ) AS arm_covered
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
  WHERE
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_dates
    )
    AND q.arm_queue_eligible
    AND q.arm_linked
),
date_high_risk AS (
  /* S1a 3.2s: Suspicious Accounts = High risk (ARM 4 to 5) fans, one per fan per date, each fan scored by their latest
     queue row (build 09 arm_member, line 555-575). A count with no benchmark, so it reads every date in view; before
     the first ARM run every fan is No score at queue join, so such dates count 0 */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN fan_tier IN ('4', '5') THEN 1
      END
    ) AS suspicious_count
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        member_id,
        MAX_BY(arm_tier, queue_message_ts) AS fan_tier
      FROM
        arm_rows
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex,
        member_id
    ) f
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
access_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(d.blocked_count), 0) AS blocked_count,
    ROUND(AVG(h.suspicious_count), 0) AS suspicious_count,
    ROUND(AVG(d.total_members), 0) AS total_members
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        /* Blocked stays on the fan score by design (AP S1a: what the queue did to the fan, not a risk rating) */
        COUNT(DISTINCT
          CASE
            WHEN score = 0 THEN member_id
          END
        ) AS blocked_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS total_members
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) d
      LEFT JOIN date_high_risk h
        ON h.event_id_hex = d.event_id_hex
),
date_fan_quality AS (
  /* One row per covered date (tour or comparison), each built exactly as build 09 builds each event */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    /* S1a 3.0a, Trusted Fan Ticket Share on ARM: Low risk (ARM 1 to 2) share of net queue tickets, each buying row by
       its own score (09 event_arm arm_low_tix_pct, lines 537-553); dates with net queue tickets above 0 only */
    CASE
      WHEN
        SUM(tickets_net) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN arm_tier IN ('1', '2') THEN tickets_net
              ELSE 0
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(tickets_net), 0),
          2
        )
    END AS trusted_fan_pct,
    /* S1 3.3, ARM 4 to 5 ticket share (09 event_arm arm_t45_pct, same lines and rule) */
    CASE
      WHEN
        SUM(tickets_net) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN arm_tier IN ('4', '5') THEN tickets_net
              ELSE 0
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(tickets_net), 0),
          2
        )
    END AS arm_t45_pct,
    /* S1 3.1g, Gradient on ARM (09 event_arm_gradient, lines 595-616): conversion of ARM 1 over conversion of ARM 5,
       per queue row, completed = entered the queue; NULL when ARM 5 has no buyers or a tier has no entrants */
    ROUND(
      (
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN
              arm_tier = '1'
              AND entered
              AND purchased
            THEN
              1
            ELSE 0
          END
        )
          * 1.0
          / NULLIF(
            SUM(
              CASE
                WHEN
                  arm_tier = '1'
                  AND entered
                THEN
                  1
                ELSE 0
              END
            ),
            0
          )
      )
        / NULLIF(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN
                arm_tier = '5'
                AND entered
                AND purchased
              THEN
                1
              ELSE 0
            END
          )
            * 1.0
            / NULLIF(
              SUM(
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    arm_tier = '5'
                    AND entered
                  THEN
                    1
                  ELSE 0
                END
              ),
              0
            ),
          0
        ),
      2
    ) AS gradient_ratio
  FROM
    arm_rows
  WHERE
    arm_covered
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
gradient AS (
  SELECT
    /* T1 and T5 conversion now ARM 1 and ARM 5 (entered and bought / entered, covered dates pooled); no widget reads them */
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN
            arm_tier = '1'
            AND entered
            AND purchased
          THEN
            1
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN
                arm_tier = '1'
                AND entered
              THEN
                1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ),
          0
        ),
      2
    ) AS t1_conv,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN
            arm_tier = '5'
            AND entered
            AND purchased
          THEN
            1
          ELSE 0
        END
      )
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN
                arm_tier = '5'
                AND entered
              THEN
                1
              ELSE 0
            END
          ),
          0
        ),
      2
    ) AS t5_conv,
    /* Step 22 Part 1b (A): the average of the dates' gradients (09 event_arm_gradient rule per date) */
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(gradient_ratio), 1)
      FROM
        date_fan_quality
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
    ) AS gradient_ratio
  FROM
    arm_rows
  WHERE
    arm_covered
    AND event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
trusted_fan AS (
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (A): the average of the dates' Low risk ticket share (09 event_arm rule per date) */
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(trusted_fan_pct), 1) AS trusted_fan_pct
  FROM
    date_fan_quality
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
arm_data AS (
  /* Step 22 S1 (with F23's net tickets and no buyer silently lost): the average of the dates' ARM 4 to 5 ticket share,
     per date as 09 event_arm builds each event (was pooled on each account's latest score) */
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(arm_t45_pct), 1) AS arm_t45_pct
  FROM
    date_fan_quality
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
-- Benchmark (cascading fallback)
/* Step 22 Part 1b (C5, Q5 A): each tour date is compared with its own venue type and genre group (Auto), or the
   picked values; the tour's benchmark is the average of its dates' benchmarks, over the same dates the card uses */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
date_bench_rows AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    /* Step 22 S1a, C8: the ARM families on the same basis as the card (at queue join, or Today); the old names are kept
       as aliases so the ranking, notes and averaging below are unchanged. trusted_* = ARM 1 to 2 ticket share */
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_low_tix_today_mean
      ELSE b.arm_low_tix_mean
    END AS trusted_fan_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_low_tix_today_event_count
      ELSE b.arm_low_tix_event_count
    END AS trusted_event_count,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_t45_today_mean
      ELSE b.arm_t45_mean
    END AS arm_t45_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_t45_today_event_count
      ELSE b.arm_event_count
    END AS arm_event_count,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_gradient_today_mean
      ELSE b.arm_gradient_mean
    END AS gradient_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_gradient_today_event_count
      ELSE b.arm_gradient_event_count
    END AS gradient_event_count,
    /* Same ranking as before Part 1b: market, then region, then all markets; within each, venue and genre, then venue type, then genre, then all music */
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
        ON (
          (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    /* Q6 A: a filter the user picked is never widened; if its group has under 10 events the card says so instead */
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  /* One benchmark per date and metric: the best-ranked group that has a value (10 or more events) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(trusted_fan_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE trusted_fan_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS trusted_fan_mean,
    MIN_BY(arm_t45_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE arm_t45_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS arm_t45_mean,
    MIN_BY(gradient_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE gradient_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS gradient_mean,
    /* The group each date used (for the header and the Q6 note) */
    MIN_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE trusted_fan_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS trusted_group,
    MIN_BY(trusted_event_count, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE trusted_fan_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS trusted_group_events,
    /* Q6 note: the widest group the date was allowed to try (one shared row under a picked filter) */
    MAX_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    ) AS unwidened_group,
    MAX_BY(trusted_event_count, fallback_rank) AS trusted_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(arm_event_count, fallback_rank) AS arm_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(gradient_event_count, fallback_rank) AS gradient_unwidened_events
  FROM
    date_bench_rows
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
date_card AS (
  /* One row per tour date: the card's per-date values beside that date's own benchmark */
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    df.trusted_fan_pct,
    df.gradient_ratio,
    df.arm_t45_pct,
    db.trusted_fan_mean,
    db.arm_t45_mean,
    db.gradient_mean,
    db.trusted_group,
    db.trusted_group_events,
    db.unwidened_group,
    db.trusted_unwidened_events,
    db.arm_unwidened_events,
    db.gradient_unwidened_events
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      LEFT JOIN date_fan_quality df
        ON df.event_id_hex = dk.event_id_hex
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dk.event_id_hex
),
bench_cohort AS (
  /* Average of the dates' benchmarks, over the dates where the card itself has a value */
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.trusted_fan_pct IS NOT NULL THEN c.trusted_fan_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS trusted_fan_mean,
    /* Step 22 S1: the ARM 4 to 5 card is now a per-date average, so its benchmark averages the same dates */
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.arm_t45_pct IS NOT NULL THEN c.arm_t45_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS arm_t45_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN c.gradient_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN c.gradient_mean
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS gradient_mean,
    /* Step 22 (C2), Part 1b: Trusted Fan benchmark events = the summed event counts of the distinct groups its dates used */
    (
      SELECT
        SUM(g.trusted_group_events)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            trusted_group,
            trusted_group_events
          FROM
            date_card
          WHERE
            trusted_fan_pct IS NOT NULL
            AND trusted_fan_mean IS NOT NULL
        ) g
    ) AS trusted_event_count
  FROM
    date_card c
),
/* Step 22 (C4): the comparison dates' per-date values, built by the same date_fan_quality rule as the tour's dates
   (comparison_resolved, comparison_anchor, benchmark_kind and comparison_events now sit above the ARM CTEs). With S1 the
   ARM 4 to 5 card has a comparison benchmark too, so it is no longer blank while a comparison is set. */
comparison_date_fan_quality AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    trusted_fan_pct,
    arm_t45_pct,
    gradient_ratio
  FROM
    date_fan_quality
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        comparison_events
    )
),
bench_direct AS (
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): the comparison dates built per date exactly like the card, then averaged */
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(trusted_fan_pct), 1) AS trusted_fan_mean,
    /* Step 22 C4 (with S1): the ARM 4 to 5 comparison benchmark, the card's per-date average over the comparison dates */
    ROUND(AVG(arm_t45_pct), 1) AS arm_t45_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(gradient_ratio), 1) AS gradient_mean,
    /* comparison dates with queue tickets: the dates the Trusted Fan benchmark averages */
    COUNT(trusted_fan_pct) AS comparison_event_count
  FROM
    comparison_date_fan_quality
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Direct'
),
bench AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN bk.benchmark_kind = 'Direct' THEN bd.trusted_fan_mean
      ELSE bc.trusted_fan_mean
    END AS trusted_fan_mean,
    /* Step 22 C4 (Part 2, S1 built): the ARM 4 to 5 card now has its comparison benchmark (was blank while a comparison was set) */
    CASE
      WHEN bk.benchmark_kind = 'Direct' THEN bd.arm_t45_mean
      ELSE bc.arm_t45_mean
    END AS arm_t45_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN bk.benchmark_kind = 'Direct' THEN bd.gradient_mean
      ELSE bc.gradient_mean
    END AS gradient_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN bk.benchmark_kind = 'Direct' THEN bd.comparison_event_count
      ELSE bc.trusted_event_count
    END AS trusted_event_count
  FROM
    bench_cohort bc
      CROSS JOIN benchmark_kind bk
      LEFT JOIN bench_direct bd
        ON 1 = 1
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (Q6 A): a filter the user picked is never widened; when no date in view has a benchmark for a
   card's family, the card's note says so with the size of the groups it would have used */
note_dates AS (
  SELECT
    'trusted' AS family,
    unwidened_group,
    trusted_unwidened_events AS unwidened_events,
    trusted_fan_mean AS bench_value
  FROM
    date_card
  WHERE
    trusted_fan_pct IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'arm' AS family,
    unwidened_group,
    arm_unwidened_events AS unwidened_events,
    arm_t45_mean AS bench_value
  FROM
    date_card
  WHERE
    arm_t45_pct IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'gradient' AS family,
    unwidened_group,
    gradient_unwidened_events AS unwidened_events,
    gradient_mean AS bench_value
  FROM
    date_card
  WHERE
    gradient_ratio IS NOT NULL
),
note_group_events AS (
  /* n for the too-few text: the summed sizes of the distinct groups the card's dates would use */
  SELECT
    family,
    SUM(group_events) AS group_events
  FROM
    (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        family,
        unwidened_group,
        COALESCE(unwidened_events, 0) AS group_events
      FROM
        note_dates
    ) g
  GROUP BY
    family
),
bench_notes AS (
  /* Q6 partial case (Dan 2026-11-06): in any cohort view, when only k of the card's n dates have a benchmark, the
     benchmark averages those k dates and the note says so; no note when k = n or the card is blank */
  SELECT
    d.family,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) <> 'Cohort'
      THEN
        NULL
      WHEN
        COUNT(d.bench_value) = 0
        AND (
          COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
          OR COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
          OR COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
          OR COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
          /* Dan 2026-11-07 (C5 rule): a Time Window other than the default, or queued-only, also counts as picked */
          OR (COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') <> 'all' AND NOT (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL))
          OR COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') <> 'all'
        )
      THEN
        CASE
          /* Dan 2026-11-07: no group is stored for these filters at all */
          WHEN
            COALESCE(MAX(ge.group_events), 0) = 0
          THEN
            'No comparable events for these filters'
          ELSE
            CONCAT(
              'Too few events for a benchmark (',
              CAST(MAX(ge.group_events) AS STRING),
              CASE
                WHEN CAST(CAST(MAX(ge.group_events) AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
                ELSE ' events)'
              END
            )
        END
      WHEN
        COUNT(d.bench_value) > 0
        AND COUNT(d.bench_value) < COUNT(*)
      THEN
        CONCAT(
          'Benchmark on ',
          CAST(COUNT(d.bench_value) AS STRING),
          ' of ',
          CAST(COUNT(*) AS STRING),
          ' dates'
        )
    END AS note
  FROM
    note_dates d
      LEFT JOIN note_group_events ge
        ON ge.family = d.family
  GROUP BY
    d.family
),
bench_notes_row AS (
  /* one row holding every card's note, joined once (reading bench_notes once per column was slow) */
  SELECT
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'trusted' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_trusted,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'arm' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_arm,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN family = 'gradient' THEN note
      END
    ) AS note_gradient
  FROM
    bench_notes
)
SELECT
  ac.blocked_count AS `Blocked`,
  ac.suspicious_count AS `Suspicious`,
  ac.total_members AS `Total Queue Members`,
  ROUND(ac.blocked_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(ac.total_members, 0), 1) AS `Blocked (%)`,
  g.t1_conv AS `T1 Conversion (%)`,
  g.t5_conv AS `T5 Conversion (%)`,
  g.gradient_ratio AS `Gradient (T1/T5)`,
  tf.trusted_fan_pct AS `Trusted Fan Ticket Share (%)`,
  b.trusted_fan_mean AS `Trusted Fan Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (tf.trusted_fan_pct - b.trusted_fan_mean) / NULLIF(b.trusted_fan_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Trusted Fan vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ad.arm_t45_pct AS `ARM T4-T5 Ticket Share (%)`,
  b.arm_t45_mean AS `ARM T4-T5 Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (ad.arm_t45_pct - b.arm_t45_mean) / NULLIF(b.arm_t45_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `ARM T4-T5 vs Benchmark (%)`,
  b.gradient_mean AS `Gradient Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (g.gradient_ratio - b.gradient_mean) / NULLIF(b.gradient_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Gradient vs Benchmark (%)`,
  /* Step 22 (C2): event counters for the page header */
  sc.tour_dates_shown AS `Tour Dates Shown`,
  sc.tour_dates_total AS `Tour Dates Total`,
  b.trusted_event_count AS `Benchmark Events`,
  /* Step 22 (C4): benchmark label when a comparison tour or event is set: <comparison tour label> . <n> events, n = the events the headline benchmark used */
  CASE
    WHEN
      (
        SELECT
          benchmark_kind
        FROM
          benchmark_kind
      ) = 'Direct'
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        (
          SELECT
            COALESCE(tour_label, artist_name)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ),
        ' . ',
        CAST(b.trusted_event_count AS STRING),
        ' events'
      )
  END AS `Benchmark Label`,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (Q6): one note per benchmarked card, empty unless a picked filter leaves no benchmark */
  COALESCE(nr.note_trusted, '') AS `Trusted Fan Ticket Share (%) Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_arm, '') AS `ARM T4-T5 Ticket Share (%) Benchmark Note`,
  COALESCE(nr.note_gradient, '') AS `Gradient (T1/T5) Benchmark Note`
FROM
  access_counts ac
    CROSS JOIN gradient g
    CROSS JOIN trusted_fan tf
    CROSS JOIN arm_data ad
    LEFT JOIN bench b
      ON 1 = 1
    CROSS JOIN scope_counts sc
    CROSS JOIN bench_notes_row nr

datasets.name: Tab1 Fan Quality
datasets.sql:
WITH resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
/* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when the Region filter is active). */
picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 S6/C23: the picked tour's dates come from the shared tour block (picker label, never tour_label) */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 C1: Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; a picked event is left alone */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
/* Step 22 C4: comparison tour or event, the same four CTEs as Overview Cards and Tab1 Topline. S6/C23: the comparison
   tour is a picker label resolved to its tour id, and its dates follow the same Region rule as the tour block (global
   tour at Region All, per-region tours otherwise); the arm group's Fan Quality Cards carries the identical block. */
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_event), '')
    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_tour), '') END AS tour_label
),
comparison_anchor AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_id_global,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_display_label AS tour_label
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
comparison_tour_regions AS (
  /* Region picked: the per-region tours that the comparison tour's dates in that region belong to (as picked_tour_regions) */
  SELECT
  DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        comparison_anchor
    )
),
benchmark_kind AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.region = :region
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            comparison_tour_regions
        )
      )
    )
    /* Step 22 (C1): the same filters narrow the comparison tour dates, so the benchmark follows every filter */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
/* Step 22 S1, S1a, C8: every ARM measure reads the member fact's ARM score per queue row (score at queue join by
   default, today's score when arm_basis = 'Today'). Only queues in an eligible config slot and rows with a linked
   account count (SOT-D1: unlinked rows out); No score stays in every denominator as its own tier.
   Benchmarked cards (Trusted = ARM 1 to 2 ticket share, ARM 4 to 5 ticket share) use only dates whose queue opened on
   or after the first ARM run, the rule the benchmark families are built on (build 09 arm_first_run and arm_events,
   lines 498-514; Dan 2026-11-09, item 13 b), so card and benchmark cover the same kind of date. The provider map and
   account-link join left this dataset: the member fact carries the link (S1). */
arm_first_run AS (
  /* the first ARM run, read from the data, never a literal (build 09 lines 498-502) */
  SELECT
    MIN(run_ts) AS first_run_ts
  FROM
    `prod_marketplace_dse`.`gold`.`arm_risk_score`
),
arm_dates AS (
  /* the tour's dates and the comparison dates, so each date's ARM values are built once by one rule */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    active_events
  UNION
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_events
),
arm_covered_dates AS (
  /* build 09 arm_events (lines 504-514): the date's earliest member-fact queue message, over all its queues and slots,
     is on or after the first ARM run */
  SELECT
    q.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
  WHERE
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_dates
    )
  GROUP BY
    q.event_id_hex
  HAVING
    /* Dan 2026-11-10: Today reads every date; at queue join only dates from the first ARM run */
    :arm_basis = 'Today'
    OR MIN(q.queue_message_ts)
      >= (
        SELECT
          first_run_ts
        FROM
          arm_first_run
      )
),
arm_rows AS (
  /* build 09 arm_rows (lines 516-535): eligible slot, linked account, net tickets on buying rows; C8 picks the basis */
  SELECT
    q.event_id_hex,
    q.member_id,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN q.arm_risk_score_today
      ELSE q.arm_risk_score_pit
    END AS arm_tier,
    q.purchased,
    CASE
      WHEN q.purchased THEN q.tickets_net
      ELSE 0
    END AS tickets_net,
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_covered_dates
    ) AS arm_covered
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
  WHERE
    q.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        arm_dates
    )
    AND q.arm_queue_eligible
    AND q.arm_linked
),
date_arm AS (
  /* One row per covered date (tour or comparison), each built as build 09 event_arm builds each event (lines 537-553):
     share of net queue tickets by each buying row's own score; dates with net queue tickets above 0 only */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    /* S1a 3.0a: Trusted Fan Share on ARM = Low risk (ARM 1 to 2) share (09 arm_low_tix_pct) */
    CASE
      WHEN
        SUM(tickets_net) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN arm_tier IN ('1', '2') THEN tickets_net
              ELSE 0
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(tickets_net), 0),
          2
        )
    END AS date_trusted,
    /* S1 3.3: ARM 4 to 5 share (09 arm_t45_pct) */
    CASE
      WHEN
        SUM(tickets_net) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN arm_tier IN ('4', '5') THEN tickets_net
              ELSE 0
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(tickets_net), 0),
          2
        )
    END AS date_arm45
  FROM
    arm_rows
  WHERE
    arm_covered
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
date_buyers AS (
  /* 1 on dates where a queue fan bought, on every member-fact row (the dates the checkout benchmark averages; unchanged) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN purchased THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS date_has_buyer
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact`
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
date_values AS (
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A) kept: one row per tour date, the card is the average of the dates */
  SELECT
    b.event_id_hex,
    a.date_trusted,
    a.date_arm45,
    b.date_has_buyer
  FROM
    date_buyers b
      LEFT JOIN date_arm a
        ON a.event_id_hex = b.event_id_hex
),
fan_quality AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(date_trusted), 1) AS trusted_fan_pct
  FROM
    date_values
),
arm_data AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 S1 (with F23's net tickets): the average of the dates' ARM 4 to 5 ticket share (was pooled on each
       account's latest score) */
    (
      SELECT
        ROUND(AVG(date_arm45), 1)
      FROM
        date_values
    ) AS arm_t45_pct,
    /* Average net tickets per buying queue row by tier (F23: net, was gross), every date in view (no benchmark);
       High risk = ARM 4 to 5, Low risk = ARM 1 to 2 (Dan 2026-11-10: the Low risk definition every other card
       uses, agreed 2026-10-22 and tied to Sean Poole's Domo ARM dashboard) */
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN
            arm_tier IN ('4', '5')
            AND purchased
          THEN
            tickets_net
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS high_risk_avg_tix,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN
            arm_tier IN ('1', '2')
            AND purchased
          THEN
            tickets_net
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS low_risk_avg_tix
  FROM
    arm_rows
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
wait_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(PERCENTILE(LEAST(checkout_seconds, 7200), 0.50) / 60.0, 2) AS median_checkout_min
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact`
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND purchased = TRUE
    AND checkout_seconds IS NOT NULL
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (C5, Q5 A): each tour date is compared with its own venue type and genre group (Auto), or the
   picked values; the tour's benchmark is the average of its dates' benchmarks, over the same dates the card uses */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
date_bench_rows AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    /* Step 22 S1a, C8: the ARM families on the same basis as the card (at queue join, or Today); the old names are kept
       as aliases so the ranking, notes and averaging below are unchanged. trusted_* = ARM 1 to 2 ticket share */
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_low_tix_today_mean
      ELSE b.arm_low_tix_mean
    END AS trusted_fan_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_low_tix_today_event_count
      ELSE b.arm_low_tix_event_count
    END AS trusted_event_count,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_t45_today_mean
      ELSE b.arm_t45_mean
    END AS arm_t45_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN b.arm_t45_today_event_count
      ELSE b.arm_event_count
    END AS arm_event_count,
    b.checkout_mean,
    b.checkout_event_count,
    /* Same ranking as before Part 1b: market, then region, then all markets; within each, venue and genre, then venue type, then genre, then all music */
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
        ON (
          (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    /* Q6 A: a filter the user picked is never widened; if its group has under 10 events the card says so instead */
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  /* One benchmark per date and metric: the best-ranked group that has a value (10 or more events) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(trusted_fan_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE trusted_fan_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS trusted_fan_mean,
    MIN_BY(arm_t45_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE arm_t45_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS arm_t45_mean,
    MIN_BY(checkout_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE checkout_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS checkout_mean,
    /* The group each date used, and its size (for the tests and the Q6 note) */
    MIN_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE trusted_fan_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS trusted_group,
    MIN_BY(trusted_event_count, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE trusted_fan_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS trusted_group_events,
    /* Under a picked filter the only rows left are the picked group; its size when it is too small, each group once */
    MAX_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    ) AS unwidened_group,
    MAX_BY(trusted_event_count, fallback_rank) AS trusted_unwidened_events
  FROM
    date_bench_rows
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
bench_cohort AS (
  /* Average of the dates' benchmarks, over the dates where the card itself has a value (ARM and checkout: dates with a buyer) */
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_trusted IS NOT NULL THEN db.trusted_fan_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS trusted_fan_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          /* Step 22 S1: the ARM 4 to 5 card is now a per-date average, so its benchmark averages the same dates */
          WHEN
            dv.date_arm45 IS NOT NULL
          THEN
            db.arm_t45_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS arm_t45_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_has_buyer = 1 THEN db.checkout_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS checkout_mean
  FROM
    date_values dv
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dv.event_id_hex
),
bench_note_events AS (
  /* Q6 A: under a picked filter, n = the events in the unwidened groups of the dates in view, each group once */
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(trusted_unwidened_events), 0) AS trusted_events,
    /* a filter the user picked (Venue Type or Genre not Auto or All, Region or Market not All), cohort mode only */
    (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      OR COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      /* DECISIONS.md row 41 (Dan 2026-11-07): a Time Window other than all, or queued-only, also counts as picked */
      OR (COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') <> 'all' AND NOT (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL))
      OR COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') <> 'all'
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort' AS picked_filter
  FROM
    (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        db.unwidened_group,
        db.trusted_unwidened_events
      FROM
        date_bench db
    ) g
),
bench_coverage AS (
  /* Q6 partial case (Dan 2026-11-06): n = dates where the card has a value, k = those dates that have a benchmark */
  SELECT
    COUNT(dv.date_trusted) AS trusted_n,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_trusted IS NOT NULL THEN db.trusted_fan_mean
      END
    ) AS trusted_k,
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort' AS is_cohort
  FROM
    date_values dv
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dv.event_id_hex
),
/* Step 22 C4: with a comparison tour or event, the ARM and checkout benchmarks are the cards' own formulas over its dates */
cmp_fan_quality AS (
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A) kept, S1a: the comparison dates built per date exactly like the card (date_arm, the
     same rule for both sides), then averaged */
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(date_trusted), 1) AS trusted_fan_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(date_arm45), 1) AS arm_t45_pct
  FROM
    date_arm
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        comparison_events
    )
),
cmp_wait_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(PERCENTILE(LEAST(checkout_seconds, 7200), 0.50) / 60.0, 2) AS median_checkout_min
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact`
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        comparison_events
    )
    AND purchased = TRUE
    AND checkout_seconds IS NOT NULL
),
bench_final AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        cf.trusted_fan_pct
      ELSE bc.trusted_fan_mean
    END AS trusted_fan_mean,
    /* Step 22 C4 (Part 2, S1 built): the ARM 4 to 5 card now has its comparison benchmark (was blank while a comparison was set) */
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        cf.arm_t45_pct
      ELSE bc.arm_t45_mean
    END AS arm_t45_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        cw.median_checkout_min
      ELSE bc.checkout_mean
    END AS checkout_mean
  FROM
    cmp_fan_quality cf
      CROSS JOIN cmp_wait_stats cw
      LEFT JOIN bench_cohort bc
        ON 1 = 1
)
SELECT
  fq.trusted_fan_pct AS `Trusted Fan Ticket Share (%)`,
  ad.arm_t45_pct AS `ARM T4-T5 Ticket Share (%)`,
  ad.high_risk_avg_tix AS `High-Risk Avg Tickets/Buyer`,
  ad.low_risk_avg_tix AS `Low-Risk Avg Tickets/Buyer`,
  ws.median_checkout_min AS `Median Checkout Time (min)`,
  bc.checkout_mean AS `Checkout Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (ws.median_checkout_min - bc.checkout_mean) / NULLIF(bc.checkout_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Checkout vs Benchmark (%)`,
  bc.trusted_fan_mean AS `Trusted Fan Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (fq.trusted_fan_pct - bc.trusted_fan_mean) / NULLIF(bc.trusted_fan_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Trusted vs Benchmark (%)`,
  bc.arm_t45_mean AS `ARM T4-T5 Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (ad.arm_t45_pct - bc.arm_t45_mean) / NULLIF(bc.arm_t45_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `ARM vs Benchmark (%)`,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (Q6 A): a picked filter is never widened; when no date in view has a benchmark the card says so */
  /* Partial case (Dan 2026-11-06), cohort mode, any view: some but not all card dates have a benchmark */
  CASE
    WHEN
      bn.picked_filter
      AND cov.trusted_n > 0
      AND cov.trusted_k = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN
          bn.trusted_events > 0
        THEN
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            bn.trusted_events,
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(bn.trusted_events AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
        ELSE 'No comparable events for these filters'
      END
    WHEN
      cov.is_cohort
      AND cov.trusted_k > 0
      AND cov.trusted_k < cov.trusted_n
    THEN
      CONCAT('Benchmark on ', cov.trusted_k, ' of ', cov.trusted_n, ' dates')
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Trusted Fan Ticket Share (%) Benchmark Note`
FROM
  fan_quality fq
    CROSS JOIN arm_data ad
    CROSS JOIN wait_stats ws
    LEFT JOIN bench_final bc
      ON 1 = 1
    CROSS JOIN bench_note_events bn
    CROSS JOIN bench_coverage cov

datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 S6/C23: the picked tour's dates come from the shared tour block (tour_dates) */
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        tour_dates
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 C1: Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; a picked event is left alone */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_event), '')
    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_tour), '') END AS tour_label
),
comparison_anchor AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_key,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    /* Step 22 S6/C23: tour_label carries the picker label; tour_id_global feeds comparison_events */
    l.tour_display_label AS tour_label,
    l.tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      /* Step 22 S6/C23: matched among picker tours only, where the label is unique */
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
benchmark_kind AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): each card is the average of the tour's dates, built per date the same way the
   benchmark builds each event (sql/nightly/09_benchmark_stats.sql), so the card and its benchmark share one basis */
date_values AS (
  SELECT
    ps.*,
    /* STR per date: sold over seats on sale, capped at 100; broken MFX inventory and MFX dates with nothing sold are left out, as in the benchmark */
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.inv_broken = 1
        OR COALESCE(ps.net_cap, 0) <= 0
        OR (
          ps.platform = 'MFX'
          AND COALESCE(ps.net_sold, 0) <= 0
        )
      THEN
        NULL
      ELSE ps.net_sold * 100.0 / GREATEST(ps.net_cap, ps.net_sold)
    END AS date_str,
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.revenue_ticket_qty > 0
        AND ps.gross_revenue > 0
      THEN
        ps.gross_revenue * 1.0 / ps.revenue_ticket_qty
    END AS date_atp,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.gross_revenue > 0 THEN ps.gross_revenue
    END AS date_gross,
    /* Queue Demand per date counts queued dates only; a date with no queue has no value */
    CASE
      WHEN ps.queue_joins > 0 THEN ps.queue_joins
    END AS date_queue_joins,
    /* Step 22 C13: Queue Demand per date on active joins (09 queue_joins_active); same dates as date_queue_joins, so
       the coverage and benchmark-date lines that test date_queue_joins are unchanged */
    CASE
      WHEN ps.queue_joins > 0 THEN ps.queue_joins_active
    END AS date_queue_joins_active,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 1, Dan 2026-11-09 decision 6): Tickets Sold per date leaves out Microflex dates
       whose seat count is untrusted (mfx_inventory_broken), as STR and the pooled tour STR already do */
    CASE
      WHEN ps.inv_broken = 1 THEN NULL
      ELSE ps.net_sold
    END AS date_net_sold
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(platform) AS platform,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        MAX(net_cap) AS net_cap,
        MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken,
        MAX(event_queue_joins) AS queue_joins,
        /* Step 22 C13: joins before the queue emptied, each fan once per event (PS event_queue_joins_active) */
        MAX(event_queue_joins_active) AS queue_joins_active,
        MAX(event_released) AS released,
        MAX(event_purchasers) AS purchasers,
        /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): buyers among fans with a join before the queue emptied (PS event_queue_active) */
        MAX(event_purchasers_active) AS purchasers_active,
        SUM(tickets_sold) AS tickets_sold,
        MAX(revenue_ticket_qty) AS revenue_ticket_qty,
        MAX(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) ps
),
event_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_str), 2) AS overall_str_pct,
    /* Tour total STR (no benchmark beside it) stays pooled, as before Part 1b (F12: broken MFX inventory left out) */
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.inv_broken = 1 THEN NULL
          ELSE dv.net_sold
        END
      )
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(
          SUM(
            CASE
              WHEN dv.inv_broken = 1 THEN NULL
              ELSE dv.net_cap
            END
          ),
          0
        ),
      2
    ) AS pooled_str_pct,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 1): Tickets Sold and Avg Tickets Sold on trusted dates only (date_net_sold) */
    SUM(dv.date_net_sold) AS sold,
    SUM(dv.net_cap) AS capacity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT dv.event_id_hex) AS event_count,
    /* F11 (Step 22): Avg Tickets divides only by events that have a Tickets Sold value. */
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_net_sold IS NOT NULL THEN dv.event_id_hex
      END
    ) AS sold_event_count,
    SUM(dv.queue_joins) AS queue_joins_total,
    /* Step 22 C13: Queue Demand (avg and total) on active joins; queue_joins_total stays for Release Rate */
    SUM(dv.queue_joins_active) AS queue_joins_active_total,
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_queue_joins_active), 0) AS queue_joins_avg,
    /* Conversion per queued date (09 line 548: purchasers over queue joins per event), then averaged, as bench_direct does */
    AVG(
      CASE
        /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): active buyers over active joins, queued dates only (09 conversion_pct) */
        WHEN
          dv.date_queue_joins IS NOT NULL
        THEN
          dv.purchasers_active * 100.0 / NULLIF(dv.date_queue_joins_active, 0)
      END
    ) AS conversion_avg,
    SUM(dv.released) AS released,
    SUM(dv.purchasers) AS purchasers,
    /* Batch 16 (Dan 2026-11-18): queue buyers who joined before the flush, added over the dates */
    SUM(dv.purchasers_active) AS purchasers_active_total,
    SUM(dv.tickets_sold) AS tickets_sold_queue,
    SUM(dv.revenue_ticket_qty) AS total_tickets,
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_atp), 2) AS avg_ticket_price,
    AVG(dv.date_gross) AS avg_gross_revenue,
    SUM(dv.gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue
  FROM
    date_values dv
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (C5, Q5 A): each tour date is compared with its own venue type and genre group (Auto), or the
   picked values; the tour's benchmark is the average of its dates' benchmarks, over the same dates the card uses */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
date_bench_rows AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    b.str_mean,
    b.str_event_count,
    /* Step 22 C13: Queue Demand benchmark = the active-join family; names kept so the lines below are unchanged */
    b.queue_active_mean AS queue_mean,
    b.queue_active_event_count AS queue_event_count,
    b.conv_mean,
    b.conv_event_count,
    b.atp_mean,
    b.atp_event_count,
    b.checkout_mean,
    b.checkout_event_count,
    b.collision_mean,
    b.collision_event_count,
    /* Step 22 TB1: Tickets Sold benchmark = the net_sold family (tickets sold, the card's basis), not tix (revenue
       tickets); the event count drives the Q6 note. Names kept so the lines below are unchanged */
    b.net_sold_mean AS tix_mean,
    b.net_sold_event_count AS tix_event_count,
    b.gross_mean,
    b.gross_event_count,
    /* Same ranking as before Part 1b: market, then region, then all markets; within each, venue and genre, then venue type, then genre, then all music */
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
        ON (
          (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    /* Q6 A: a filter the user picked is never widened; if its group has under 10 events the card says so instead */
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  /* One benchmark per date and metric: the best-ranked group that has a value (10 or more events) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(str_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS str_mean,
    MIN_BY(queue_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE queue_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS queue_mean,
    MIN_BY(conv_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE conv_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS conv_mean,
    MIN_BY(atp_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE atp_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS atp_mean,
    MIN_BY(checkout_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE checkout_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS checkout_mean,
    MIN_BY(collision_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE collision_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS collision_mean,
    MIN_BY(tix_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE tix_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS tix_mean,
    MIN_BY(gross_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE gross_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS gross_mean,
    /* The group each date used (for the header and the Q6 note) */
    MIN_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS str_group,
    MIN_BY(str_event_count, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS str_group_events,
    /* Q6 note: the widest group the date was allowed to try (one shared row under a picked filter) */
    MAX_BY(str_event_count, fallback_rank) AS str_unwidened_events,
    /* Which group that is: dates whose own cell has no row share the wider row, so it must be counted once */
    MAX_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
