    ) AS unwidened_group,
    MAX_BY(queue_event_count, fallback_rank) AS queue_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(atp_event_count, fallback_rank) AS atp_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(tix_event_count, fallback_rank) AS tix_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(gross_event_count, fallback_rank) AS gross_unwidened_events
  FROM
    date_bench_rows
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
bench_cohort AS (
  /* Average of the dates' benchmarks, over the dates where the card itself has a value */
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.str_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS str_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_queue_joins IS NOT NULL THEN db.queue_mean
        END
      ),
      0
    ) AS queue_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_queue_joins IS NOT NULL THEN db.conv_mean
      END
    ) AS conv_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_atp IS NOT NULL THEN db.atp_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS atp_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(db.checkout_mean), 2) AS checkout_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(db.collision_mean), 2) AS collision_mean,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 1): over the same trusted dates as the card */
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_net_sold IS NOT NULL THEN db.tix_mean
      END
    ) AS tix_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_gross IS NOT NULL THEN db.gross_mean
      END
    ) AS gross_mean
  FROM
    date_values dv
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dv.event_id_hex
),
bench_note_events AS (
  /* Q6 A: under a picked filter, n = the events in the unwidened groups of the dates in view, each group once */
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(str_unwidened_events), 0) AS str_events,
    COALESCE(SUM(queue_unwidened_events), 0) AS queue_events,
    COALESCE(SUM(atp_unwidened_events), 0) AS atp_events,
    COALESCE(SUM(tix_unwidened_events), 0) AS tix_events,
    COALESCE(SUM(gross_unwidened_events), 0) AS gross_events,
    /* a filter the user picked (Venue Type or Genre not Auto or All, Region or Market not All), cohort mode only */
    (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      OR COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      /* DECISIONS.md row 41 (Dan 2026-11-07): a Time Window other than all, or queued-only, also counts as picked */
      OR (COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') <> 'all' AND NOT (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL))
      OR COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') <> 'all'
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort' AS picked_filter
  FROM
    (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        db.unwidened_group,
        db.str_unwidened_events,
        db.queue_unwidened_events,
        db.atp_unwidened_events,
        db.tix_unwidened_events,
        db.gross_unwidened_events
      FROM
        date_bench db
    ) g
),
bench_coverage AS (
  /* Q6 partial case (Dan 2026-11-06): n = dates where the card has a value, k = those dates that have a benchmark */
  SELECT
    COUNT(dv.date_str) AS str_n,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.str_mean
      END
    ) AS str_k,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 1): the card's trusted dates */
    COUNT(dv.date_net_sold) AS tix_n,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_net_sold IS NOT NULL THEN db.tix_mean
      END
    ) AS tix_k,
    COUNT(dv.date_gross) AS gross_n,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_gross IS NOT NULL THEN db.gross_mean
      END
    ) AS gross_k,
    COUNT(dv.date_atp) AS atp_n,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_atp IS NOT NULL THEN db.atp_mean
      END
    ) AS atp_k,
    COUNT(dv.date_queue_joins) AS queue_n,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_queue_joins IS NOT NULL THEN db.queue_mean
      END
    ) AS queue_k,
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort' AS is_cohort
  FROM
    date_values dv
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dv.event_id_hex
),
comparison_tour_regions AS (
  /* Step 22 S6: with a Region picked, the per-region tours that the comparison tour's dates in that region belong to
     (the tour_block rule, applied to the comparison anchor's global tour) */
  SELECT
  DISTINCT
    cr.tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` cr
  WHERE
    cr.event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND cr.region = :region
    AND cr.tour_id_global
      = (
        SELECT
          tour_id_global
        FROM
          comparison_anchor
      )
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  /* Step 22 S6/C23: the comparison tour's dates by id (never by label text): its global tour when Region is All,
     else the per-region tours of its dates in the picked region */
  WHERE
    (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              tour_id_global
            FROM
              comparison_anchor
          )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.region = :region
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            comparison_tour_regions
        )
      )
    )
    AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): the same filters narrow the comparison tour dates, so the benchmark follows every filter */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
comparison_date_values AS (
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): the comparison tour is built per date exactly like the card (date_values), then averaged */
  SELECT
    cps.*,
    CASE
      WHEN
        cps.inv_broken = 1
        OR COALESCE(cps.net_cap, 0) <= 0
        OR (
          cps.platform = 'MFX'
          AND COALESCE(cps.net_sold, 0) <= 0
        )
      THEN
        NULL
      ELSE cps.net_sold * 100.0 / GREATEST(cps.net_cap, cps.net_sold)
    END AS date_str,
    CASE
      WHEN
        cps.revenue_ticket_qty > 0
        AND cps.gross_revenue > 0
      THEN
        cps.gross_revenue * 1.0 / cps.revenue_ticket_qty
    END AS date_atp,
    CASE
      WHEN cps.gross_revenue > 0 THEN cps.gross_revenue
    END AS date_gross,
    CASE
      WHEN cps.queue_joins > 0 THEN cps.queue_joins
    END AS date_queue_joins,
    /* Step 22 C13: same as date_values */
    CASE
      WHEN cps.queue_joins > 0 THEN cps.queue_joins_active
    END AS date_queue_joins_active,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 1): same as date_values */
    CASE
      WHEN cps.inv_broken = 1 THEN NULL
      ELSE cps.net_sold
    END AS date_net_sold
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(platform) AS platform,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        MAX(net_cap) AS net_cap,
        MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken,
        MAX(event_queue_joins) AS queue_joins,
        /* Step 22 C13: joins before the queue emptied, each fan once per event (PS event_queue_joins_active) */
        MAX(event_queue_joins_active) AS queue_joins_active,
        MAX(event_released) AS released,
        MAX(event_purchasers) AS purchasers,
        /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): buyers among fans with a join before the queue emptied (PS event_queue_active) */
        MAX(event_purchasers_active) AS purchasers_active,
        MAX(revenue_ticket_qty) AS revenue_ticket_qty,
        MAX(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
        MAX(median_checkout_min) AS median_checkout_min,
        MAX(reserve_attempts) AS reserve_attempts,
        MAX(reserve_collisions) AS reserve_collisions
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) cps
),
bench_direct AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(cdv.date_str), 2) AS str_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(cdv.date_queue_joins_active), 0) AS queue_mean /* Step 22 C13 */,
    /* Step 22 C4: unrounded here so the % difference is taken before rounding; the display column rounds */
    AVG(
      CASE
        /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): same as the card */
        WHEN
          cdv.date_queue_joins IS NOT NULL
        THEN
          cdv.purchasers_active * 100.0 / NULLIF(cdv.date_queue_joins_active, 0)
      END
    ) AS conv_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(cdv.date_atp), 2) AS atp_mean,
    ROUND(AVG(cdv.median_checkout_min), 2) AS checkout_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN cdv.reserve_attempts > 100 THEN cdv.reserve_collisions * 100.0 / cdv.reserve_attempts
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS collision_mean,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 1): the comparison tour's trusted dates, as the card */
    SUM(cdv.date_net_sold)
      * 1.0
      / NULLIF(
        COUNT(DISTINCT
          CASE
            WHEN cdv.date_net_sold IS NOT NULL THEN cdv.event_id_hex
          END
        ),
        0
      ) AS tix_mean,
    AVG(cdv.date_gross) AS gross_mean
  FROM
    comparison_date_values cdv
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Direct'
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT
    str_mean,
    queue_mean,
    conv_mean,
    atp_mean,
    checkout_mean,
    collision_mean,
    tix_mean,
    gross_mean
  FROM
    bench_cohort
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    str_mean,
    queue_mean,
    conv_mean,
    atp_mean,
    checkout_mean,
    collision_mean,
    tix_mean,
    gross_mean
  FROM
    bench_direct
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Direct'
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  em.overall_str_pct AS `STR (%)`,
  ROUND(em.sold * 1.0 / NULLIF(em.sold_event_count, 0), 0) AS `Avg Tickets Sold`,
  ROUND(em.avg_gross_revenue, 0) AS `Avg Gross Revenue`,
  em.avg_ticket_price AS `Avg Ticket Price`,
  b.str_mean AS `STR Benchmark`,
  b.tix_mean AS `Tickets Sold Benchmark`,
  b.gross_mean AS `Gross Revenue Benchmark`,
  b.atp_mean AS `ATP Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (em.overall_str_pct - b.str_mean) / NULLIF(b.str_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `STR vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (em.sold * 1.0 / NULLIF(em.sold_event_count, 0) - b.tix_mean) / NULLIF(b.tix_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Tickets Sold vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (em.avg_gross_revenue - b.gross_mean) / NULLIF(b.gross_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Gross Revenue vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (em.avg_ticket_price - b.atp_mean) / NULLIF(b.atp_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `ATP vs Benchmark (%)`,
  em.sold AS `Total Tickets Sold`,
  em.gross_revenue AS `Total Gross Revenue`,
  em.capacity AS `Capacity`,
  em.event_count AS `Events in Tour`,
  (
    SELECT
      view_mode
    FROM
      view_mode
  ) AS `View`,
  em.queue_joins_avg AS `Queue Demand (avg/event)`,
  em.queue_joins_active_total AS `Queue Demand (total)` /* Step 22 C13 */,
  em.released AS `Released from Queue`,
  em.purchasers AS `Purchasers`,
  ROUND(em.conversion_avg, 2) AS `Conversion Rate (%)`,
  /* Batch 16 (Dan 2026-11-18): the tour's queue buyers over its Queue Demand (total) */
  ROUND(em.purchasers_active_total * 100.0 / NULLIF(em.queue_joins_active_total, 0), 2) AS `Queue Conversion (total)`,
  em.total_tickets AS `Revenue Tickets`,
  b.queue_mean AS `Queue Demand Benchmark`,
  ROUND(b.conv_mean, 2) AS `Conversion Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (em.queue_joins_avg - b.queue_mean) / NULLIF(b.queue_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Queue vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (em.conversion_avg - b.conv_mean) / NULLIF(b.conv_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Conversion vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(em.released * 100.0 / NULLIF(em.queue_joins_total, 0), 1) AS `Release Rate (%)`,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b: the tour-total STR box ("How big was the tour?") keeps the pooled tour STR; the per-event box reads STR (%) */
  em.pooled_str_pct AS `Tour STR (%)`,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (Q6 A): a picked filter is never widened; when no date in view has a benchmark the card says so */
  /* Partial case (Dan 2026-11-06), cohort mode, any view: some but not all card dates have a benchmark */
  CASE
    WHEN
      bn.picked_filter
      AND bc.str_n > 0
      AND bc.str_k = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN
          bn.str_events > 0
        THEN
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            bn.str_events,
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(bn.str_events AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
        ELSE 'No comparable events for these filters'
      END
    WHEN
      bc.is_cohort
      AND bc.str_k > 0
      AND bc.str_k < bc.str_n
    THEN
      CONCAT('Benchmark on ', bc.str_k, ' of ', bc.str_n, ' dates')
    ELSE ''
  END AS `STR (%) Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      bn.picked_filter
      AND bc.tix_n > 0
      AND bc.tix_k = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN
          bn.tix_events > 0
        THEN
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            bn.tix_events,
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(bn.tix_events AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
        ELSE 'No comparable events for these filters'
      END
    WHEN
      bc.is_cohort
      AND bc.tix_k > 0
      AND bc.tix_k < bc.tix_n
    THEN
      CONCAT('Benchmark on ', bc.tix_k, ' of ', bc.tix_n, ' dates')
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Avg Tickets Sold Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      bn.picked_filter
      AND bc.gross_n > 0
      AND bc.gross_k = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN
          bn.gross_events > 0
        THEN
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            bn.gross_events,
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(bn.gross_events AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
        ELSE 'No comparable events for these filters'
      END
    WHEN
      bc.is_cohort
      AND bc.gross_k > 0
      AND bc.gross_k < bc.gross_n
    THEN
      CONCAT('Benchmark on ', bc.gross_k, ' of ', bc.gross_n, ' dates')
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Avg Gross Revenue Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      bn.picked_filter
      AND bc.atp_n > 0
      AND bc.atp_k = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN
          bn.atp_events > 0
        THEN
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            bn.atp_events,
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(bn.atp_events AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
        ELSE 'No comparable events for these filters'
      END
    WHEN
      bc.is_cohort
      AND bc.atp_k > 0
      AND bc.atp_k < bc.atp_n
    THEN
      CONCAT('Benchmark on ', bc.atp_k, ' of ', bc.atp_n, ' dates')
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Avg Ticket Price Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      bn.picked_filter
      AND bc.queue_n > 0
      AND bc.queue_k = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN
          bn.queue_events > 0
        THEN
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            bn.queue_events,
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(bn.queue_events AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
        ELSE 'No comparable events for these filters'
      END
    WHEN
      bc.is_cohort
      AND bc.queue_k > 0
      AND bc.queue_k < bc.queue_n
    THEN
      CONCAT('Benchmark on ', bc.queue_k, ' of ', bc.queue_n, ' dates')
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Queue Demand (avg/event) Benchmark Note`
FROM
  event_metrics em
    LEFT JOIN benchmark b
      ON 1 = 1
    CROSS JOIN bench_note_events bn
    CROSS JOIN bench_coverage bc

datasets.name: Tab1 Resale
datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the picker label resolves to the tour's dates through the shared tour block (Region All =
         the 40-day global tour; Region picked = the per-region tours of its dates there) */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 C1: Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; a picked event is left alone */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
/* Step 22 C4: comparison tour or event, the same four CTEs as Overview Cards and Tab1 Topline */
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_event), '')
    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_tour), '') END AS tour_label
),
comparison_anchor AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_key,
    /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the comparison tour is followed by its id; the picker label is kept for the benchmark label */
    l.tour_id_global,
    l.tour_display_label,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_label
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (C23): :comparison_tour is a picker label (unique among picker tours); matched here once only */
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
benchmark_kind AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 (S6): the comparison tour by its id, never its label text. Region All = its 40-day global tour; Region
       picked = the per-region tours that its dates in that region belong to (the tour block rule) */
    (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              tour_id_global
            FROM
              comparison_anchor
          )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            cr2.tour_id_region
          FROM
            `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` cr2
          WHERE
            cr2.event_kind = 'Main'
            AND cr2.region = :region
            AND cr2.tour_id_global
              = (
                SELECT
                  tour_id_global
                FROM
                  comparison_anchor
              )
        )
      )
    )
    AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): the same filters narrow the comparison tour dates, so the benchmark follows every filter */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
primary_sold AS (
  /* Step 22 (S2, SOT-D5): Primary Tickets Sold = the penetration denominator, primary net_sold (comps included) on the
     Host US and Canada dates that carry a penetration value (04 resale_penetration_pct) */
  SELECT
    SUM(net_sold) AS primary_tickets
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
        AND resale_penetration_pct IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    )
),
resale_data AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(resale_tickets_sold) AS resale_sold,
    SUM(resale_total_listings) AS total_listings,
    /* Step 22 (F6, F7): price and arbitrage move to date_values (per date, the 09 event_resale rule) */
    ROUND(AVG(median_days_to_resale), 1) AS median_days_to_resale
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(resale_tickets_sold) AS resale_tickets_sold,
        MAX(resale_total_listings) AS resale_total_listings,
        MAX(avg_resale_price) AS avg_resale_price,
        MAX(arbitrage_multiplier) AS arbitrage_multiplier,
        MAX(median_days_to_resale) AS median_days_to_resale
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    )
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A), kept: every resale card is the average of the tour's dates.
   Step 22 Part 2 (S2, S3, F6, F7, Arbitrage): each date reads the phase summary's own per-event resale values, exactly as
   09 event_resale builds an event (build/09 lines 642-658: Host dates with 5 or more posting rows, resale_total_listings),
   so card and benchmark share one formula. Penetration = TM resale over primary net_sold, US and Canada (S2); STR = sold
   over sold plus listed the night before (S3, card hidden until the resale team confirms); price per ticket, TM resale
   (F6); arbitrage = pooled listing over face (Arbitrage), per date ROUND((multiplier - 1) x 100, 1) as 09. */
date_values AS (
  SELECT
    ps.*,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN ps.resale_penetration_pct
    END AS date_resale_pen,
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.resale_total_listings >= 5
        AND ps.arbitrage_multiplier IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        ROUND((ps.arbitrage_multiplier - 1) * 100, 1)
    END AS date_arbitrage,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN ps.arbitrage_multiplier
    END AS date_arbitrage_multiplier,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN ps.resale_str_pct
    END AS date_resale_str,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN ps.avg_resale_price
    END AS date_resale_price
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        MAX(resale_tickets_sold) AS resale_tickets_sold,
        MAX(resale_total_listings) AS resale_total_listings,
        MAX(avg_resale_price) AS avg_resale_price,
        MAX(arbitrage_multiplier) AS arbitrage_multiplier,
        MAX(resale_penetration_pct) AS resale_penetration_pct,
        MAX(resale_str_pct) AS resale_str_pct
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) ps
),
date_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_resale_pen), 2) AS resale_pen_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_arbitrage), 1) AS arbitrage_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_arbitrage_multiplier), 3) AS arbitrage_multiplier,
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_resale_str), 2) AS resale_str_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_resale_price), 2) AS avg_resale_price
  FROM
    date_values dv
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (C5, Q5 A): each tour date is compared with its own venue type and genre group (Auto), or the
   picked values; the tour's benchmark is the average of its dates' benchmarks, over the same dates the card uses */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
date_bench_rows AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    b.resale_pen_mean,
    b.resale_event_count,
    b.arbitrage_mean,
    b.arbitrage_event_count,
    b.resale_str_mean,
    b.resale_str_event_count,
    b.resale_price_mean,
    b.resale_price_event_count,
    /* Same ranking as before Part 1b: market, then region, then all markets; within each, venue and genre, then venue type, then genre, then all music */
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
        ON (
          (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    /* Q6 A: a filter the user picked is never widened; if its group has under 10 events the card says so instead */
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  /* One benchmark per date and metric: the best-ranked group that has a value (10 or more events) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(resale_pen_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE resale_pen_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS resale_pen_mean,
    MIN_BY(arbitrage_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE arbitrage_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS arbitrage_mean,
    MIN_BY(resale_str_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE resale_str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS resale_str_mean,
    MIN_BY(resale_price_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE resale_price_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS resale_price_mean,
    /* The group each date used, and its size (for the tests and the Q6 note) */
    MIN_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE resale_pen_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS resale_group,
    MIN_BY(resale_event_count, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE resale_pen_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS resale_group_events,
    /* Under a picked filter the only rows left are the picked group; its size when it is too small, each group once */
    MAX_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    ) AS unwidened_group,
    MAX_BY(resale_event_count, fallback_rank) AS resale_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(arbitrage_event_count, fallback_rank) AS arbitrage_unwidened_events
  FROM
    date_bench_rows
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
resale_bench AS (
  /* Average of the dates' benchmarks, over the dates where the card itself has a value */
  SELECT
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_resale_pen IS NOT NULL THEN db.resale_pen_mean
      END
    ) AS resale_pen_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_arbitrage IS NOT NULL THEN db.arbitrage_mean
      END
    ) AS arbitrage_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_resale_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.resale_str_mean
      END
    ) AS resale_str_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_resale_price IS NOT NULL THEN db.resale_price_mean
      END
    ) AS resale_price_mean
  FROM
    date_values dv
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dv.event_id_hex
),
bench_note_events AS (
  /* Q6 A: under a picked filter, n = the events in the unwidened groups of the dates in view, each group once */
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(resale_unwidened_events), 0) AS resale_events,
    COALESCE(SUM(arbitrage_unwidened_events), 0) AS arbitrage_events,
    /* a filter the user picked (Venue Type or Genre not Auto or All, Region or Market not All), cohort mode only */
    (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      OR COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      /* DECISIONS.md row 41 (Dan 2026-11-07): a Time Window other than all, or queued-only, also counts as picked */
      OR (COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') <> 'all' AND NOT (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL))
      OR COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') <> 'all'
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort' AS picked_filter
  FROM
    (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        db.unwidened_group,
        db.resale_unwidened_events,
        db.arbitrage_unwidened_events
      FROM
        date_bench db
    ) g
),
bench_coverage AS (
  /* Q6 partial case (Dan 2026-11-06): n = dates where the card has a value, k = those dates that have a benchmark */
  SELECT
    COUNT(dv.date_resale_pen) AS resale_n,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_resale_pen IS NOT NULL THEN db.resale_pen_mean
      END
    ) AS resale_k,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_arbitrage IS NOT NULL THEN 1
      END
    ) AS arbitrage_n,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_arbitrage IS NOT NULL THEN db.arbitrage_mean
      END
    ) AS arbitrage_k,
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort' AS is_cohort
  FROM
    date_values dv
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dv.event_id_hex
),
/* Step 22 C4: with a comparison tour or event, each resale benchmark is the card's own formula over its dates */
cmp_primary_sold AS (
  /* Step 22 (S2, SOT-D5): Primary Tickets Sold = the penetration denominator, primary net_sold (comps included) on the
     Host US and Canada dates that carry a penetration value (04 resale_penetration_pct) */
  SELECT
    SUM(net_sold) AS primary_tickets
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
        AND resale_penetration_pct IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    )
),
/* Step 22 (C4 resale): the comparison benchmark is the comparison tour's own per-date average of the same per-date
   values the card uses (date_values), so a tour against itself reads 0 */
cmp_resale_data AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN resale_penetration_pct
      END
    ) AS resale_pen_pct,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN
          resale_total_listings >= 5
          AND arbitrage_multiplier IS NOT NULL
        THEN
          ROUND((arbitrage_multiplier - 1) * 100, 1)
      END
    ) AS arbitrage_pct,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN resale_str_pct
      END
    ) AS resale_str_pct,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN avg_resale_price
      END
    ) AS avg_resale_price
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        MAX(resale_tickets_sold) AS resale_tickets_sold,
        MAX(resale_total_listings) AS resale_total_listings,
        MAX(avg_resale_price) AS avg_resale_price,
        MAX(arbitrage_multiplier) AS arbitrage_multiplier,
        MAX(resale_penetration_pct) AS resale_penetration_pct,
        MAX(resale_str_pct) AS resale_str_pct
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    )
),
resale_bench_final AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        ROUND(cr.resale_pen_pct, 2)
      ELSE rb.resale_pen_mean
    END AS resale_pen_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        ROUND(cr.arbitrage_pct, 1)
      ELSE rb.arbitrage_mean
    END AS arbitrage_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        ROUND(cr.resale_str_pct, 2)
      ELSE rb.resale_str_mean
    END AS resale_str_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        ROUND(cr.avg_resale_price, 2)
      ELSE rb.resale_price_mean
    END AS resale_price_mean
  FROM
    cmp_resale_data cr
      CROSS JOIN cmp_primary_sold cp
      LEFT JOIN resale_bench rb
        ON 1 = 1
)
SELECT
  dm.resale_pen_pct AS `Resale Penetration (%)`,
  /* Step 22 (F7, Arbitrage): average of the dates' arbitrage, the 09 rule per date */
  dm.arbitrage_pct AS `Arbitrage Above Face (%)`,
  dm.arbitrage_multiplier AS `Resale Price Multiplier`,
  /* Step 22 (S3): average of the dates' resale STR (04 resale_str_pct); the widget stays hidden until the resale team confirms (C21) */
  dm.resale_str_pct AS `Resale Sell-Through (%)`,
  r.resale_sold AS `Resale Tickets Sold`,
  ps.primary_tickets AS `Primary Tickets Sold`,
  /* Step 22 (F6): average of the dates' per-ticket TM resale price */
  dm.avg_resale_price AS `Avg Resale Price ($)`,
  r.median_days_to_resale AS `Median Days to Resale Sale`,
  ROUND(rb.resale_pen_mean, 2) AS `Resale Pen Benchmark`,
  ROUND(rb.arbitrage_mean, 2) AS `Arbitrage Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (dm.resale_pen_pct - rb.resale_pen_mean) * 100.0 / NULLIF(rb.resale_pen_mean, 0),
    1
  ) AS `Resale Pen vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (dm.arbitrage_pct - rb.arbitrage_mean) / NULLIF(rb.arbitrage_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Arbitrage vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(rb.resale_str_mean, 2) AS `Resale STR Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (dm.resale_str_pct - rb.resale_str_mean) / NULLIF(rb.resale_str_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Resale STR vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(rb.resale_price_mean, 2) AS `Resale Price Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (dm.avg_resale_price - rb.resale_price_mean) / NULLIF(rb.resale_price_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Resale Price vs Benchmark (%)`,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (Q6 A): a picked filter is never widened; when no date in view has a benchmark the card says so */
  /* Partial case (Dan 2026-11-06), cohort mode, any view: some but not all card dates have a benchmark */
  CASE
    WHEN
      bn.picked_filter
      AND bc.resale_n > 0
      AND bc.resale_k = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN
          bn.resale_events > 0
        THEN
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            bn.resale_events,
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(bn.resale_events AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
        ELSE 'No comparable events for these filters'
      END
    WHEN
      bc.is_cohort
      AND bc.resale_k > 0
      AND bc.resale_k < bc.resale_n
    THEN
      CONCAT('Benchmark on ', bc.resale_k, ' of ', bc.resale_n, ' dates')
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Resale Penetration (%) Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      bn.picked_filter
      AND bc.arbitrage_n > 0
      AND bc.arbitrage_k = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN
          bn.arbitrage_events > 0
        THEN
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            bn.arbitrage_events,
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(bn.arbitrage_events AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
        ELSE 'No comparable events for these filters'
      END
    WHEN
      bc.is_cohort
      AND bc.arbitrage_k > 0
      AND bc.arbitrage_k < bc.arbitrage_n
    THEN
      CONCAT('Benchmark on ', bc.arbitrage_k, ' of ', bc.arbitrage_n, ' dates')
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Arbitrage Above Face (%) Benchmark Note`
FROM
  resale_data r,
  primary_sold ps,
  date_metrics dm,
  resale_bench_final rb,
  bench_note_events bn,
  bench_coverage bc

datasets.name: Tab1 Queue at Sellout
datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the picker label resolves to the tour's dates through the shared tour block (Region All =
         the 40-day global tour; Region picked = the per-region tours of its dates there) */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 C1: Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; a picked event is left alone */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
/* Step 22 C4: comparison tour or event, the same four CTEs as Overview Cards and Tab1 Topline */
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_event), '')
    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_tour), '') END AS tour_label
),
comparison_anchor AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_key,
    /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the comparison tour is followed by its id; the picker label is kept for the benchmark label */
    l.tour_id_global,
    l.tour_display_label,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_label
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (C23): :comparison_tour is a picker label (unique among picker tours); matched here once only */
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
benchmark_kind AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 (S6): the comparison tour by its id, never its label text. Region All = its 40-day global tour; Region
       picked = the per-region tours that its dates in that region belong to (the tour block rule) */
    (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              tour_id_global
            FROM
              comparison_anchor
          )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            cr2.tour_id_region
          FROM
            `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` cr2
          WHERE
            cr2.event_kind = 'Main'
            AND cr2.region = :region
            AND cr2.tour_id_global
              = (
                SELECT
                  tour_id_global
                FROM
                  comparison_anchor
              )
        )
      )
    )
    AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): the same filters narrow the comparison tour dates, so the benchmark follows every filter */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
-- Step 22 (C16): sellout date from the phase summary (was recomputed from music_str_daily)
sellout_per_event AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    /* Step 22 (C16): the build's one sellout date (04 sellout_anchor: first day total sold reaches 95% of the STR card's
       capacity, show day included), read instead of recounting str_pct >= 95 */
    MAX(sellout_dt) AS sellout_dt,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 1): the untrusted-seat-count flag, read by Events Sold Out only */
    MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND sellout_dt IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
queue_at_sellout_per_event AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 (C16): the build's queue_at_sellout (04: fans still in a queue on the sellout date), the per-event value
       the benchmark's queue_at_sellout family averages (09 event_sellout) */
    p.event_id_hex,
    MAX(p.queue_at_sellout) AS fans_in_queue
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
  WHERE
    /* Batch 13 (Dan 2026-11-11): Queue at Sellout leaves out Microflex dates whose seat count is untrusted
       (mfx_inventory_broken), as Events Sold Out and the benchmark (09 event_sellout) do */
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        sellout_per_event
      WHERE
        COALESCE(inv_broken, 0) = 0
    )
    AND p.queue_at_sellout IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    p.event_id_hex
),
queue_at_sellout AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(fans_in_queue), 0) AS fans_in_queue,
    SUM(fans_in_queue) AS total_fans_in_queue
  FROM
    queue_at_sellout_per_event
),
sellout_summary AS (
  SELECT
    /* Batch 13 (Dan 2026-11-12): First Sellout Date leaves out the same untrusted Microflex dates */
    MIN(CASE WHEN COALESCE(inv_broken, 0) = 0 THEN sellout_dt END) AS earliest_sellout,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 1): Events Sold Out leaves out Microflex dates whose seat count is untrusted
       (mfx_inventory_broken), as STR does; Queue at Sellout is unchanged */
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(inv_broken, 0) = 0 THEN 1
      END
    ) AS events_with_sellout
  FROM
    sellout_per_event
),
event_count AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT event_id_hex) AS total_events
  FROM
    active_events
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (C5, Q5 A): each tour date is compared with its own venue type and genre group (Auto), or the
   picked values; the tour's benchmark is the average of its dates' benchmarks, over the same dates the card uses.
   Step 22 (C16): the card reads the build's sellout date and queue_at_sellout, the values the benchmark averages */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
date_bench_rows AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    b.queue_at_sellout_mean,
    b.queue_at_sellout_event_count,
    /* Same ranking as before Part 1b: market, then region, then all markets; within each, venue and genre, then venue type, then genre, then all music */
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
        ON (
          (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    /* Q6 A: a filter the user picked is never widened; if its group has under 10 events the card says so instead */
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  /* One benchmark per date and metric: the best-ranked group that has a value (10 or more events) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(queue_at_sellout_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE queue_at_sellout_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS queue_at_sellout_mean,
    /* The group each date used, and its size (for the tests and the Q6 note) */
    MIN_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE queue_at_sellout_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS sellout_group,
    MIN_BY(queue_at_sellout_event_count, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE queue_at_sellout_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS sellout_group_events,
    /* Under a picked filter the only rows left are the picked group; its size when it is too small, each group once */
    MAX_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    ) AS unwidened_group,
    MAX_BY(queue_at_sellout_event_count, fallback_rank) AS sellout_unwidened_events
  FROM
    date_bench_rows
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
cohort_sellout_bench AS (
  /* Average of the dates' benchmarks, over the dates where the card itself has a value (sold-out dates with fans waiting) */
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(db.queue_at_sellout_mean), 0) AS bench_queue_at_sellout
  FROM
    queue_at_sellout_per_event qe
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = qe.event_id_hex
),
bench_note_events AS (
  /* Q6 A: under a picked filter, n = the events in the unwidened groups of the dates in view, each group once */
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(sellout_unwidened_events), 0) AS sellout_events,
    /* a filter the user picked (Venue Type or Genre not Auto or All, Region or Market not All), cohort mode only */
    (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      OR COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      /* DECISIONS.md row 41 (Dan 2026-11-07): a Time Window other than all, or queued-only, also counts as picked */
      OR (COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') <> 'all' AND NOT (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL))
      OR COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') <> 'all'
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort' AS picked_filter
  FROM
    (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        db.unwidened_group,
        db.sellout_unwidened_events
      FROM
        date_bench db
    ) g
),
bench_coverage AS (
  /* Q6 partial case (Dan 2026-11-06): n = dates where the card has a value, k = those dates that have a benchmark */
  SELECT
    COUNT(qe.event_id_hex) AS sellout_n,
    COUNT(db.queue_at_sellout_mean) AS sellout_k,
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort' AS is_cohort
  FROM
    queue_at_sellout_per_event qe
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = qe.event_id_hex
),
/* Step 22 C4: with a comparison tour or event, the benchmark is the same Queue at Sellout formula over its dates */
cmp_sellout_per_event AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    /* Step 22 (C16): the build's one sellout date (04 sellout_anchor: first day total sold reaches 95% of the STR card's
       capacity, show day included), read instead of recounting str_pct >= 95 */
    MAX(sellout_dt) AS sellout_dt,
    /* Batch 13: the comparison dates leave out the same untrusted dates */
    MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        comparison_events
    )
    AND sellout_dt IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
cmp_queue_at_sellout_per_event AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 (C16): the build's queue_at_sellout (04: fans still in a queue on the sellout date), the per-event value
       the benchmark's queue_at_sellout family averages (09 event_sellout) */
    p.event_id_hex,
    MAX(p.queue_at_sellout) AS fans_in_queue
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
  WHERE
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        cmp_sellout_per_event
      WHERE
        COALESCE(inv_broken, 0) = 0
    )
    AND p.queue_at_sellout IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    p.event_id_hex
),
cmp_queue_at_sellout AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(fans_in_queue), 0) AS fans_in_queue
  FROM
    cmp_queue_at_sellout_per_event
),
sellout_bench AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        cq.fans_in_queue
      ELSE c.bench_queue_at_sellout
    END AS bench_queue_at_sellout
  FROM
    cmp_queue_at_sellout cq
      LEFT JOIN cohort_sellout_bench c
        ON 1 = 1
)
SELECT
  q.fans_in_queue AS `Queue at Sellout`,
  q.total_fans_in_queue AS `Queue at Sellout (total)`,
  csb.bench_queue_at_sellout AS `Queue at Sellout Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (q.fans_in_queue - csb.bench_queue_at_sellout) / NULLIF(csb.bench_queue_at_sellout, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Queue at Sellout vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ss.events_with_sellout AS `Events that Sold Out`,
  ec.total_events AS `Total Events`,
  ss.earliest_sellout AS `First Sellout Date`,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (Q6 A): a picked filter is never widened; when no date in view has a benchmark the card says so */
  /* Partial case (Dan 2026-11-06), cohort mode, any view: some but not all card dates have a benchmark */
  CASE
    WHEN
      bn.picked_filter
      AND cov.sellout_n > 0
      AND cov.sellout_k = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN
          bn.sellout_events > 0
        THEN
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            bn.sellout_events,
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(bn.sellout_events AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
        ELSE 'No comparable events for these filters'
      END
    WHEN
      cov.is_cohort
      AND cov.sellout_k > 0
      AND cov.sellout_k < cov.sellout_n
    THEN
      CONCAT('Benchmark on ', cov.sellout_k, ' of ', cov.sellout_n, ' dates')
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Queue at Sellout Benchmark Note`
FROM
  queue_at_sellout q
    CROSS JOIN sellout_summary ss
    CROSS JOIN event_count ec
    LEFT JOIN sellout_bench csb
      ON 1 = 1
    CROSS JOIN bench_note_events bn
    CROSS JOIN bench_coverage cov

datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    /* Batch 13 item 1 (Dan 2026-11-11): the Tour picker shows tour_picker_label (artist · onsale · tour name) */
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-F0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): :tour_name is a picker label; the tour's dates come from the shared tour block */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* C1 (sign-off 2026-11-04): Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; Time Window does not (a tour keeps all its dates); a picked Event (branch below) is not narrowed */
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
tourwide_rows AS (
  /* Batch 13 item 5 (Dan 2026-11-11): Tour-wide presales only, on by default. Rule e of
     charlie-feedback-1104/research/C-tours/findings.md section 4, judged on every queue row of the picked tour's dates
     (the shared tour block, before Market, Venue Type and queued-only narrow the view), so a presale's standing is the
     tour's, not the view's. Unnamed queues keep their recorded name (Dan D3). */
  SELECT
    p.event_id_hex,
    p.queue_id,
    p.market,
    p.phase_name_canonical AS phase_key,
    p.sale_type,
    l.region,
    COALESCE(p.tickets_sold, 0) AS tickets_sold
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex,
          MAX(region) AS region
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
        WHERE
          event_kind = 'Main'
        GROUP BY
          event_id_hex
      ) l
        ON l.event_id_hex = p.event_id_hex
  WHERE
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        tour_dates
    )
    AND p.phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
),
tourwide_flags AS (
  /* A queue row is tour-wide when it is the general onsale, or its presale ran on at least half the tour's queued
     dates, or on at least half the queued dates of a region with 3 or more, or sold 5% or more of the tour's queue
     tickets. Every other presale is grouped as "Local and venue presales" while the switch is on. */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    queue_id,
    market,
    sale_type = 'Public Onsale window'
    OR key_dates >= 0.5 * tour_dates
    OR (
      region_dates >= 3
      AND key_region_dates >= 0.5 * region_dates
    )
    OR (
      tour_tickets > 0
      AND key_tickets >= 0.05 * tour_tickets
    ) AS tour_wide
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        r.*,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER ()) AS tour_dates,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER (PARTITION BY region)) AS region_dates,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER (PARTITION BY phase_key)) AS key_dates,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER (PARTITION BY phase_key, region)) AS key_region_dates,
        SUM(tickets_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY phase_key) AS key_tickets,
        SUM(tickets_sold) OVER () AS tour_tickets
      FROM
        tourwide_rows r
    ) s
),
phase_rows AS (
  /* Batch 13 item 5: the view's queue rows with their tour-wide flag; a row the rule never judged (no tour picked)
     counts as tour-wide, so nothing is grouped */
  SELECT
    p.*,
    COALESCE(tw.tour_wide, TRUE) AS tour_wide
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
      LEFT JOIN tourwide_flags tw
        ON tw.event_id_hex = p.event_id_hex
        AND tw.queue_id <=> p.queue_id
        AND tw.market <=> p.market
  WHERE
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND p.phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
),
raw_phases AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      /* Batch 13 item 5: with Tour-wide presales only on (default), presales that were not tour-wide are one row */
      WHEN
        COALESCE(:tourwide_only, 'On') = 'On'
        AND (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Tour'
        AND NOT tour_wide
      THEN
        'Local and venue presales'
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Tour'
        AND phase_name_canonical RLIKE '^Phase [0-9]+$'
      THEN
        'Other'
      ELSE phase_name_canonical
    END AS phase_name,
    MIN(phase_start) AS first_open,
    /* Step 22 (C13, Q8 B): Queue Joins leave out joins after the queue emptied (build 04 queue_joins_active);
       conversion keeps all joins, the build's own basis (PS conversion_pct, SPEC known gap) */
    SUM(queue_joins_active) AS queue_joins,
    SUM(queue_joins) AS queue_joins_all,
    SUM(purchasers) AS purchasers,
    /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): buyers among each queue's active joiners (PS purchasers_active) */
    SUM(purchasers_active) AS purchasers_active,
    /* Batch 14 (C7): released fans who joined before the flush (build 04 released_active) */
    SUM(released_active) AS released,
    SUM(tickets_sold) AS tickets_sold
  FROM
    phase_rows
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
  GROUP BY
    1
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(queue_joins) AS queue_joins,
    /* Step 22 (C13) */
    SUM(queue_joins_all) AS queue_joins_all,
    SUM(purchasers) AS purchasers,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 2): active buyers, so the total rows divide like the phase rows */
    SUM(purchasers_active) AS purchasers_active,
    SUM(released) AS released,
    SUM(tickets_sold) AS tickets_sold
  FROM
    raw_phases
),
event_totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(net_sold) AS all_channel_tickets,
    /* C18: box office tickets, one value per event (Host only; Microflex has no box office split, so 0) */
    SUM(box_office_sold) AS box_office_tickets
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        COALESCE(MAX(net_sold_box_qty), 0) AS box_office_sold
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) e
)
SELECT
  r.phase_name AS `Phase`,
  DATE_FORMAT(r.first_open, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `First Open`,
  r.queue_joins AS `Queue Joins`,
  r.released AS `Released from Queue`,
  /* Step 22 (C13): conversion stays on all joins */
  /* Step 22 answer 1 (a): active buyers over active joins (queue_joins is the active count here) */
  ROUND(r.purchasers_active * 100.0 / NULLIF(r.queue_joins, 0), 1) AS `Conversion %`,
  r.tickets_sold AS `Total Tickets`,
  ROUND(r.tickets_sold * 100.0 / NULLIF(et.all_channel_tickets, 0), 1) AS `% of Total`
FROM
  raw_phases r CROSS JOIN event_totals et
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Queue Window Total',
  '',
  g.queue_joins,
  g.released,
  /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 2): active buyers over active joins, the phase-row rule (was every buyer over every join) */
  ROUND(g.purchasers_active * 100.0 / NULLIF(g.queue_joins, 0), 1),
  g.tickets_sold,
  ROUND(g.tickets_sold * 100.0 / NULLIF(et.all_channel_tickets, 0), 1)
FROM
  grand_total g CROSS JOIN event_totals et
UNION ALL
/* C18 (P2-7): Outside queue windows splits into Box office and Online, outside queue phases; no queue joins, releases or conversion on either row (they are not queue outcomes) */
SELECT
  'Box office',
  '',
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
  CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10, 1)),
  et.box_office_tickets,
  ROUND(et.box_office_tickets * 100.0 / NULLIF(et.all_channel_tickets, 0), 1)
FROM
  event_totals et
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Online, outside queue phases',
  '',
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT),
  CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10, 1)),
  GREATEST(et.all_channel_tickets - g.tickets_sold - et.box_office_tickets, 0),
  ROUND(
    GREATEST(et.all_channel_tickets - g.tickets_sold - et.box_office_tickets, 0)
      * 100.0
      / NULLIF(et.all_channel_tickets, 0),
    1
  )
FROM
  event_totals et CROSS JOIN grand_total g
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Total',
  '',
  g.queue_joins,
  g.released,
  /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 2): same as Queue Window Total */
  ROUND(g.purchasers_active * 100.0 / NULLIF(g.queue_joins, 0), 1),
  et.all_channel_tickets,
  100.0
FROM
  grand_total g CROSS JOIN event_totals et
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Total' THEN 5
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Box office' THEN 4
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Online, outside queue phases' THEN 3
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Queue Window Total' THEN 2
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Other' THEN 1
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Local and venue presales' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END,
  `First Open` ASC NULLS LAST
