WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    /* Batch 13 item 1 (Dan 2026-11-11): the Tour picker shows tour_picker_label (artist · onsale · tour name) */
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-F0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 S6/C23: the picked tour's dates come from the shared tour block (tour_dates) */
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        tour_dates
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* C1 (sign-off 2026-11-04): Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; Time Window does not (a tour keeps all its dates); a picked Event (branch below) is not narrowed */
    AND (
      :market IS NULL

      OR has_queue

      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
tourwide_rows AS (
  /* Batch 13 item 5 (Dan 2026-11-11): Tour-wide presales only, on by default. Rule e of
     charlie-feedback-1104/research/C-tours/findings.md section 4, judged on every queue row of the picked tour's dates
     (the shared tour block, before Market, Venue Type and queued-only narrow the view), so a presale's standing is the
     tour's, not the view's. Unnamed queues keep their recorded name (Dan D3). */
  SELECT
    p.event_id_hex,
    p.queue_id,
    p.market,
    p.phase_name_canonical AS phase_key,
    p.sale_type,
    l.region,
    COALESCE(p.tickets_sold, 0) AS tickets_sold
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex,
          MAX(region) AS region
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
        WHERE
          event_kind = 'Main'
        GROUP BY
          event_id_hex
      ) l
        ON l.event_id_hex = p.event_id_hex
  WHERE
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        tour_dates
    )
    AND p.phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
),
tourwide_flags AS (
  /* A queue row is tour-wide when it is the general onsale, or its presale ran on at least half the tour's queued
     dates, or on at least half the queued dates of a region with 3 or more, or sold 5% or more of the tour's queue
     tickets. Every other presale is grouped as "Local and venue presales" while the switch is on. */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    queue_id,
    market,
    sale_type = 'Public Onsale window'
    OR key_dates >= 0.5 * tour_dates
    OR (
      region_dates >= 3
      AND key_region_dates >= 0.5 * region_dates
    )
    OR (
      tour_tickets > 0
      AND key_tickets >= 0.05 * tour_tickets
    ) AS tour_wide
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        r.*,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER ()) AS tour_dates,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER (PARTITION BY region)) AS region_dates,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER (PARTITION BY phase_key)) AS key_dates,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER (PARTITION BY phase_key, region)) AS key_region_dates,
        SUM(tickets_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY phase_key) AS key_tickets,
        SUM(tickets_sold) OVER () AS tour_tickets
      FROM
        tourwide_rows r
    ) s
),
phase_rows AS (
  /* Batch 13 item 5: the view's queue rows with their tour-wide flag; a row the rule never judged (no tour picked)
     counts as tour-wide, so nothing is grouped */
  SELECT
    p.*,
    COALESCE(tw.tour_wide, TRUE) AS tour_wide
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
      LEFT JOIN tourwide_flags tw
        ON tw.event_id_hex = p.event_id_hex
        AND tw.queue_id <=> p.queue_id
        AND tw.market <=> p.market
  WHERE
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND p.phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
),
phase_rev AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      /* Batch 13 item 5: with Tour-wide presales only on (default), presales that were not tour-wide are one row */
      WHEN
        COALESCE(:tourwide_only, 'On') = 'On'
        AND (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Tour'
        AND NOT tour_wide
      THEN
        'Local and venue presales'
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Tour'
        AND phase_name_canonical RLIKE '^Phase [0-9]+$'
      THEN
        'Other'
      ELSE phase_name_canonical
    END AS phase_name,
    SUM(phase_gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
    SUM(tickets_sold) AS tickets_sold,
    MIN(phase_start) AS first_open
  FROM
    phase_rows
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
  GROUP BY
    1
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(gross_revenue) AS total_rev,
    SUM(tickets_sold) AS total_tix
  FROM
    phase_rev
),
event_totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(net_sold) AS all_channel_tickets,
    SUM(gross_revenue) AS all_channel_revenue
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        MAX(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) e
)
SELECT
  p.phase_name AS `Phase`,
  p.tickets_sold AS `Tickets`,
  ROUND(p.gross_revenue / NULLIF(p.tickets_sold, 0), 2) AS `ATP`,
  p.gross_revenue AS `Gross Revenue`,
  ROUND(p.gross_revenue * 100.0 / NULLIF(et.all_channel_revenue, 0), 1) AS `% of Revenue`
FROM
  phase_rev p CROSS JOIN event_totals et
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Queue Window Total',
  g.total_tix,
  ROUND(g.total_rev / NULLIF(g.total_tix, 0), 2),
  g.total_rev,
  ROUND(g.total_rev * 100.0 / NULLIF(et.all_channel_revenue, 0), 1)
FROM
  grand_total g CROSS JOIN event_totals et
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Outside queue windows',
  GREATEST(et.all_channel_tickets - g.total_tix, 0),
  ROUND(
    GREATEST(et.all_channel_revenue - g.total_rev, 0)
      / NULLIF(GREATEST(et.all_channel_tickets - g.total_tix, 0), 0),
    2
  ),
  GREATEST(et.all_channel_revenue - g.total_rev, 0),
  ROUND(
    GREATEST(et.all_channel_revenue - g.total_rev, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(et.all_channel_revenue, 0),
    1
  )
FROM
  event_totals et CROSS JOIN grand_total g
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Total',
  et.all_channel_tickets,
  ROUND(et.all_channel_revenue / NULLIF(et.all_channel_tickets, 0), 2),
  et.all_channel_revenue,
  100.0
FROM
  event_totals et
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Total' THEN 4
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Outside queue windows' THEN 3
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Queue Window Total' THEN 2
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Other' THEN 1
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Local and venue presales' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END,
  `Gross Revenue` DESC NULLS LAST

),
phase_rows AS (
  /* Batch 13 item 5: the view's queue rows with their tour-wide flag; a row the rule never judged (no tour picked)
     counts as tour-wide, so nothing is grouped */
  SELECT
    p.*,
    COALESCE(tw.tour_wide, TRUE) AS tour_wide
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
      LEFT JOIN tourwide_flags tw
        ON tw.event_id_hex = p.event_id_hex
        AND tw.queue_id <=> p.queue_id

    p.event_id_hex IN (

    )

),
phase_map AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_id_hex,
    queue_id,
    CASE
      /* Batch 13 item 5: with Tour-wide presales only on (default), presales that were not tour-wide are one row */
      WHEN
        COALESCE(:tourwide_only, 'On') = 'On'
        AND (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Tour'
        AND NOT tour_wide
      THEN
        'Local and venue presales'
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Tour'
        AND phase_name_canonical RLIKE '^Phase [0-9]+$'
      THEN
        'Other'
      ELSE phase_name_canonical
    END AS phase,
    phase_start
  FROM
    phase_rows
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'

member_phase AS (
  /* Step 22 D3 (map-E D3, scratch/E_27 block) on ARM (S1a PH4, S1, C8): one row per fan, event and phase from the
     latest queue entry, purchased if any queue in that phase converted (ARM Summary rule). The ARM tier is read only
     from rows in an eligible slot with a linked account (SOT-D1: unlinked rows out), so the latest row is taken
     separately among those rows (arm_row); Total Unique Joins still counts every fan (all rows). No score is a tier
     in every denominator. Every date in view counts (no benchmark). */
  SELECT
    member_id,
    event_id_hex,
    arm_tier,
    arm_row,
    purchased,
    phase,
    phase_start
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        qmf.member_id,
        qmf.event_id_hex,
        COALESCE(
          CASE
            WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN qmf.arm_risk_score_today
            ELSE qmf.arm_risk_score_pit
          END,
          'No score'
        ) AS arm_tier,
        qmf.arm_queue_eligible
        AND qmf.arm_linked AS arm_row,
        MAX(
          CASE
            WHEN qmf.purchased THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY qmf.member_id, qmf.event_id_hex, pm.phase) = 1 AS purchased,
        pm.phase,
        pm.phase_start,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
              qmf.member_id,
              qmf.event_id_hex,
              pm.phase,
              qmf.arm_queue_eligible
              AND qmf.arm_linked
            ORDER BY qmf.queue_message_ts DESC
          ) AS rn
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` qmf
          INNER JOIN phase_map pm
            ON qmf.event_id_hex = pm.event_id_hex
            AND qmf.queue_id = pm.queue_id
      WHERE
        qmf.event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
    ) ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1

member_event AS (
  /* Step 22 D3: Total row on the ARM Summary grain (Tab2 ARM Comparison members): one row per fan and event, latest
     eligible linked queue entry, purchased if any queue for that event converted */
  SELECT
    member_id,
    arm_tier,
    purchased
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        q.member_id,
        COALESCE(
          CASE
            WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN q.arm_risk_score_today
            ELSE q.arm_risk_score_pit
          END,
          'No score'
        ) AS arm_tier,
        q.arm_queue_eligible
        AND q.arm_linked AS arm_row,
        MAX(
          CASE
            WHEN q.purchased THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY q.member_id, q.event_id_hex) = 1 AS purchased,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
              q.member_id,
              q.event_id_hex,
              q.arm_queue_eligible
              AND q.arm_linked
            ORDER BY q.queue_message_ts DESC
          ) AS rn
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
      WHERE
        q.event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
    ) ranked
  WHERE
    arm_row
    AND rn = 1
),
phase_data AS (
  /* Step 22 S1a PH4: Trusted % = ARM 1 to 2 share, Blocked % = ARM 4 to 5 share (column names kept for the widget) */
  SELECT
    phase,
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 4): blank, not 0.0, when no fan in the base has an ARM score */
    CASE
      WHEN
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN
              arm_row
              AND arm_tier <> 'No score'
            THEN
              1
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN
                arm_row
                AND arm_tier IN ('1', '2')
              THEN
                1
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(
              COUNT(
                CASE
                  WHEN arm_row THEN 1
                END
              ),
              0
            ),
          1
        )
    END AS queue_trusted_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN
              arm_row
              AND arm_tier <> 'No score'
            THEN
              1
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN
                arm_row
                AND arm_tier IN ('4', '5')
              THEN
                1
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(
              COUNT(
                CASE
                  WHEN arm_row THEN 1
                END
              ),
              0
            ),
          1
        )
    END AS queue_blocked_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN
              arm_row
              AND purchased
              AND arm_tier <> 'No score'
            THEN
              1
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN
                arm_row
                AND arm_tier IN ('1', '2')
                AND purchased
              THEN
                1
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(
              COUNT(
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    arm_row
                    AND purchased
                  THEN
                    1
                END
              ),
              0
            ),
          1
        )
    END AS buyer_trusted_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN
              arm_row
              AND purchased
              AND arm_tier <> 'No score'
            THEN
              1
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN
                arm_row
                AND arm_tier IN ('4', '5')
                AND purchased
              THEN
                1
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(
              COUNT(
                CASE
                  WHEN
                    arm_row
                    AND purchased
                  THEN
                    1
                END
              ),
              0
            ),
          1
        )
    END AS buyer_blocked_pct,
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS total_unique_joins,
    MIN(phase_start) AS first_open
  FROM
    member_phase
  GROUP BY
    phase
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    /* Fix 2026-11-11 (item 4): blank, not 0.0, when no fan in the base has an ARM score */
    CASE
      WHEN
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN arm_tier <> 'No score' THEN 1
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN arm_tier IN ('1', '2') THEN 1
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
          1
        )
    END AS queue_trusted_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN arm_tier <> 'No score' THEN 1
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN arm_tier IN ('4', '5') THEN 1
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
          1
        )
    END AS queue_blocked_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN
              purchased
              AND arm_tier <> 'No score'
            THEN
              1
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN
                arm_tier IN ('1', '2')
                AND purchased
              THEN
                1
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(
              COUNT(
                CASE
                  WHEN purchased THEN 1
                END
              ),
              0
            ),
          1
        )
    END AS buyer_trusted_pct,
    CASE
      WHEN
        COUNT(
          CASE
            WHEN
              purchased
              AND arm_tier <> 'No score'
            THEN
              1
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN
                arm_tier IN ('4', '5')
                AND purchased
              THEN
                1
            END
          )
            * 100.0
            / NULLIF(
              COUNT(
                CASE
                  WHEN purchased THEN 1
                END
              ),
              0
            ),
          1
        )
    END AS buyer_blocked_pct,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT member_id)
      FROM
        member_phase
    ) AS total_unique_joins
  FROM
    member_event
)
SELECT
  d.phase AS `Phase`,
  d.queue_trusted_pct AS `Queue Trusted %`,
  d.queue_blocked_pct AS `Queue Blocked %`,
  d.buyer_trusted_pct AS `Buyer Trusted %`,
  d.buyer_blocked_pct AS `Buyer Blocked %`,
  d.total_unique_joins AS `Total Unique Joins`,
  CASE
    WHEN d.phase = 'Other' THEN 9999999999
    WHEN d.phase = 'Local and venue presales' THEN 9999999998
    ELSE UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.first_open)
  END AS `sort_order`
FROM
  phase_data d
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Total',
  g.queue_trusted_pct,
  g.queue_blocked_pct,
  g.buyer_trusted_pct,
  g.buyer_blocked_pct,
  g.total_unique_joins,
  CAST(9999999999 + 1 AS BIGINT)
FROM
  grand_total g
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Total' THEN 2
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Other' THEN 1
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Local and venue presales' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END,
  `sort_order` ASC

datasets.name: Tab2 Presale Contribution
datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    /* Batch 13 item 1 (Dan 2026-11-11): the Tour picker shows tour_picker_label (artist · onsale · tour name) */
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-F0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 S6/C23: the picked tour's dates come from the shared tour block (tour_dates) */
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        tour_dates
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* C1 (sign-off 2026-11-04): Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; Time Window does not (a tour keeps all its dates); a picked Event (branch below) is not narrowed */
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
tourwide_rows AS (
  /* Batch 13 item 5 (Dan 2026-11-11): Tour-wide presales only, on by default. Rule e of
     charlie-feedback-1104/research/C-tours/findings.md section 4, judged on every queue row of the picked tour's dates
     (the shared tour block, before Market, Venue Type and queued-only narrow the view), so a presale's standing is the
     tour's, not the view's. Unnamed queues keep their recorded name (Dan D3). */
  SELECT
    p.event_id_hex,
    p.queue_id,
    p.market,
    p.phase_name_canonical AS phase_key,
    p.sale_type,
    l.region,
    COALESCE(p.tickets_sold, 0) AS tickets_sold
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex,
          MAX(region) AS region
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
        WHERE
          event_kind = 'Main'
        GROUP BY
          event_id_hex
      ) l
        ON l.event_id_hex = p.event_id_hex
  WHERE
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        tour_dates
    )
    AND p.phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
),
tourwide_flags AS (
  /* A queue row is tour-wide when it is the general onsale, or its presale ran on at least half the tour's queued
     dates, or on at least half the queued dates of a region with 3 or more, or sold 5% or more of the tour's queue
     tickets. Every other presale is grouped as "Local and venue presales" while the switch is on. */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    queue_id,
    market,
    sale_type = 'Public Onsale window'
    OR key_dates >= 0.5 * tour_dates
    OR (
      region_dates >= 3
      AND key_region_dates >= 0.5 * region_dates
    )
    OR (
      tour_tickets > 0
      AND key_tickets >= 0.05 * tour_tickets
    ) AS tour_wide
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        r.*,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER ()) AS tour_dates,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER (PARTITION BY region)) AS region_dates,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER (PARTITION BY phase_key)) AS key_dates,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_id_hex) OVER (PARTITION BY phase_key, region)) AS key_region_dates,
        SUM(tickets_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY phase_key) AS key_tickets,
        SUM(tickets_sold) OVER () AS tour_tickets
      FROM
        tourwide_rows r
    ) s
),
phase_rows AS (
  /* Batch 13 item 5: the view's queue rows with their tour-wide flag; a row the rule never judged (no tour picked)
     counts as tour-wide, so nothing is grouped */
  SELECT
    p.*,
    COALESCE(tw.tour_wide, TRUE) AS tour_wide
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
      LEFT JOIN tourwide_flags tw
        ON tw.event_id_hex = p.event_id_hex
        AND tw.queue_id <=> p.queue_id
        AND tw.market <=> p.market
  WHERE
    p.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND p.phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
),
raw_phases AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      /* Batch 13 item 5: with Tour-wide presales only on (default), presales that were not tour-wide are one row */
      WHEN
        COALESCE(:tourwide_only, 'On') = 'On'
        AND (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Tour'
        AND NOT tour_wide
      THEN
        'Local and venue presales'
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Tour'
        AND phase_name_canonical RLIKE '^Phase [0-9]+$'
      THEN
        'Other'
      ELSE phase_name_canonical
    END AS phase_name,
    SUM(tickets_sold) AS tickets_sold,
    MIN(phase_start) AS first_open
  FROM
    phase_rows
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
  GROUP BY
    1
),
event_totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(net_sold) AS all_channel_tickets,
    /* C18: box office tickets, one value per event (Host only; Microflex has no box office split, so 0) */
    SUM(box_office_sold) AS box_office_tickets
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        COALESCE(MAX(net_sold_box_qty), 0) AS box_office_sold
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) e
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(tickets_sold) AS tickets_sold
  FROM
    raw_phases
),
all_rows AS (
  SELECT
    phase_name,
    tickets_sold,
    first_open
  FROM
    raw_phases
  UNION ALL
  /* C18 (P2-7): Outside queue windows splits into Box office and Online, outside queue phases; each is its own share of all-channel tickets, not a queue outcome */
  SELECT
    'Box office',
    et.box_office_tickets,
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)
  FROM
    event_totals et
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Online, outside queue phases',
    GREATEST(et.all_channel_tickets - g.tickets_sold - et.box_office_tickets, 0),
    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP)
  FROM
    event_totals et CROSS JOIN grand_total g
)
SELECT
  phase_name AS `Phase`,
  tickets_sold AS `Tickets Sold`,
  ROUND(
    tickets_sold
      * 100.0
      / NULLIF(
        (
          SELECT
            all_channel_tickets
          FROM
            event_totals
        ),
        0
      ),
    1
  ) AS `% of Total`,
  CASE
    WHEN phase_name = 'Other' THEN 9999999998
    WHEN phase_name = 'Local and venue presales' THEN 9999999995
    WHEN phase_name = 'Box office' THEN 9999999997
    WHEN phase_name = 'Online, outside queue phases' THEN 9999999996
    ELSE UNIX_TIMESTAMP(first_open)
  END AS `sort_order`
FROM
  all_rows
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN phase_name = 'Online, outside queue phases' THEN 1
    WHEN phase_name = 'Box office' THEN 2
    WHEN phase_name = 'Other' THEN 3
    WHEN phase_name = 'Local and venue presales' THEN 0.5
    ELSE 0
  END,
  first_open ASC

datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the picker label resolves to the tour's dates through the shared tour block (Region All =
         the 40-day global tour; Region picked = the per-region tours of its dates there) */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): Region, Market, Venue Type and Benchmark Events narrow the tour dates; the picked-event branch is unchanged */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): each card is the average of the tour's dates, built per date the same way its
   benchmark builds each event, so card and benchmark share one basis. One per-event CTE feeds the card dates, the
   comparison dates and the live tier benchmark pool, so the three sides cannot drift apart. */
event_values AS (
  SELECT
    ps.event_id_hex,
    ps.net_sold,
    ps.vip_sold,
    ps.platinum_sold,
    /* Overall STR per date: the Tab1 Topline rule, which is the 09 str_pct rule (sold over seats on sale, capped at 100;
       broken MFX inventory and MFX dates with nothing sold are left out) */
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.inv_broken = 1
        OR COALESCE(ps.net_cap, 0) <= 0
        OR (
          ps.platform = 'MFX'
          AND COALESCE(ps.net_sold, 0) <= 0
        )
      THEN
        NULL
      ELSE ps.net_sold * 100.0 / GREATEST(ps.net_cap, ps.net_sold)
    END AS date_str,
    /* Standard STR per date: sold minus VIP and Platinum (floored at 0) over seats on sale minus VIP and Platinum
       capacity, capped at 100 (basis-audit note 4); NULL tiers count as 0 (F15, F24); dates with seat inventory, not broken */
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.inv_broken = 1
        OR COALESCE(ps.seat_capacity, 0) <= 0
        OR COALESCE(ps.net_cap, 0) <= 0
      THEN
        NULL
      WHEN
        ps.net_cap - COALESCE(ps.vip_cap, 0) - COALESCE(ps.plat_cap, 0) > 0
      THEN
        GREATEST(ps.net_sold - COALESCE(ps.vip_sold, 0) - COALESCE(ps.platinum_sold, 0), 0)
          * 100.0
          / GREATEST(
            ps.net_cap - COALESCE(ps.vip_cap, 0) - COALESCE(ps.plat_cap, 0),
            GREATEST(ps.net_sold - COALESCE(ps.vip_sold, 0) - COALESCE(ps.platinum_sold, 0), 0)
          )
    END AS date_std_str,
    /* VIP and Platinum STR per date: tier sold over tier capacity, capped at 100, on dates with that tier's capacity */
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.inv_broken = 1
        OR COALESCE(ps.seat_capacity, 0) <= 0
        OR COALESCE(ps.net_cap, 0) <= 0
      THEN
        NULL
      WHEN
        ps.vip_cap > 0
      THEN
        GREATEST(COALESCE(ps.vip_sold, 0), 0)
          * 100.0
          / GREATEST(ps.vip_cap, COALESCE(ps.vip_sold, 0))
    END AS date_vip_str,
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.inv_broken = 1
        OR COALESCE(ps.seat_capacity, 0) <= 0
        OR COALESCE(ps.net_cap, 0) <= 0
      THEN
        NULL
      WHEN
        ps.plat_cap > 0
      THEN
        GREATEST(COALESCE(ps.platinum_sold, 0), 0)
          * 100.0
          / GREATEST(ps.plat_cap, COALESCE(ps.platinum_sold, 0))
    END AS date_plat_str
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(platform) AS platform,
        MAX(net_sold) AS net_sold,
        MAX(net_cap) AS net_cap,
        MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken,
        MAX(seat_capacity) AS seat_capacity,
        MAX(vip_sold) AS vip_sold,
        MAX(platinum_sold) AS platinum_sold,
        MAX(vip_cap) AS vip_cap,
        MAX(plat_cap) AS plat_cap
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) ps
),
date_values AS (
  SELECT
    ev.*
  FROM
    event_values ev
  WHERE
    ev.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
event_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_str), 2) AS overall_str,
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_std_str), 2) AS standard_str,
    /* Step 22 (F26): blank, not 0, when the selection sold no VIP or no Platinum */
    CASE
      WHEN
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN dv.date_vip_str IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(dv.vip_sold, 0)
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(AVG(dv.date_vip_str), 2)
    END AS vip_str,
    CASE
      WHEN
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN dv.date_plat_str IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(dv.platinum_sold, 0)
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(AVG(dv.date_plat_str), 2)
    END AS platinum_str
  FROM
    date_values dv
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (C5, Q5 A): each tour date is compared with its own venue type and genre group (Auto), or the
   picked values; the tour's benchmark is the average of its dates' benchmarks, over the same dates the card uses */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
date_bench_rows AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    b.str_mean,
    b.str_event_count,
    /* Step 22 (C6): the Standard, VIP and Platinum STR benchmarks are 09 families now (event_sold_tiers, the same
       per-event rule as event_values), read through the same per-date block as str_mean */
    b.std_str_mean,
    b.std_str_event_count,
    b.vip_str_mean,
    b.vip_str_event_count,
    b.plat_str_mean,
    b.plat_str_event_count,
    /* Same ranking as before Part 1b: market, then region, then all markets; within each, venue and genre, then venue type, then genre, then all music */
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
        ON (
          (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    /* Q6 A: a filter the user picked is never widened; if its group has under 10 events the card says so instead */
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  /* One benchmark per date and metric: the best-ranked group that has a value (10 or more events) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(str_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS str_mean,
    /* Step 22 (C6): each tier family takes its own best-ranked group with a value (10 or more events, 09) */
    MIN_BY(std_str_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE std_str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS std_str_mean,
    MIN_BY(vip_str_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE vip_str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS vip_str_mean,
    MIN_BY(plat_str_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE plat_str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS plat_str_mean,
    /* The group each date used (for the header and the Q6 note) */
    MIN_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS str_group,
    MIN_BY(str_event_count, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS str_group_events,
    /* Q6 note: the widest group the date was allowed to try (one shared row under a picked filter) */
    MAX_BY(str_event_count, fallback_rank) AS str_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(std_str_event_count, fallback_rank) AS std_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(vip_str_event_count, fallback_rank) AS vip_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(plat_str_event_count, fallback_rank) AS plat_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    ) AS str_unwidened_group
  FROM
    date_bench_rows
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
bench_cohort AS (
  /* Average of the dates' benchmarks, over the dates where the card itself has a value */
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.str_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS str_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_std_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.std_str_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS std_str,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_vip_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.vip_str_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS vip_str,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_plat_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.plat_str_mean
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS plat_str,
    /* Q6 note inputs: dates with a card value, dates with a benchmark, and the summed size of the distinct groups */
    COUNT(dv.date_str) AS str_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.str_mean
      END
    ) AS str_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_std_str) AS std_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_std_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.std_str_mean
      END
    ) AS std_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_vip_str) AS vip_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_vip_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.vip_str_mean
      END
    ) AS vip_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_plat_str) AS plat_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_plat_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.plat_str_mean
      END
    ) AS plat_bench_dates
  FROM
    date_values dv
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dv.event_id_hex
),
bench_group_sizes AS (
  /* n for the Q6 note: summed event count of the distinct unwidened groups the dates fall in (same-level groups do not overlap) */
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            str_unwidened_group,
            str_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS str_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            str_unwidened_group,
            std_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS std_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            str_unwidened_group,
            vip_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS vip_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            str_unwidened_group,
            plat_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS plat_n
),
/* Step 22 (C4): with a comparison tour or event, every tier STR benchmark is the card formula over the comparison dates (filtered as the tour); without one, the cohort benchmarks are unchanged */
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_event), '')
    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_tour), '') END AS tour_label
),
comparison_anchor AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_key,
    /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the comparison tour is followed by its id; the picker label is kept for the benchmark label */
    l.tour_id_global,
    l.tour_display_label,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_label
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (C23): :comparison_tour is a picker label (unique among picker tours); matched here once only */
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
benchmark_kind AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 (S6): the comparison tour by its id, never its label text. Region All = its 40-day global tour; Region
       picked = the per-region tours that its dates in that region belong to (the tour block rule) */
    (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              tour_id_global
            FROM
              comparison_anchor
          )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            cr2.tour_id_region
          FROM
            `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` cr2
          WHERE
            cr2.event_kind = 'Main'
            AND cr2.region = :region
            AND cr2.tour_id_global
              = (
                SELECT
                  tour_id_global
                FROM
                  comparison_anchor
              )
        )
      )
    )
    AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): the same filters narrow the comparison tour dates, so the benchmark follows every filter */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
bench_direct AS (
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): the comparison tour is built per date exactly like the card (event_values), then averaged */
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(cdv.date_str), 2) AS str_mean,
    COUNT(cdv.date_str) AS str_events,
    ROUND(AVG(cdv.date_std_str), 2) AS std_str,
    CASE
      WHEN
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN cdv.date_vip_str IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(cdv.vip_sold, 0)
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(AVG(cdv.date_vip_str), 2)
    END AS vip_str,
    CASE
      WHEN
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN cdv.date_plat_str IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(cdv.platinum_sold, 0)
          END
        ) > 0
      THEN
        ROUND(AVG(cdv.date_plat_str), 2)
    END AS plat_str
  FROM
    event_values cdv
  WHERE
    cdv.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        comparison_events
    )
),
tier_bench AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        bd.str_mean
      ELSE bc.str_mean
    END AS overall_str,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        bd.std_str
      ELSE bc.std_str
    END AS std_str,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        bd.vip_str
      ELSE bc.vip_str
    END AS vip_str,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        bd.plat_str
      ELSE bc.plat_str
    END AS plat_str
  FROM
    bench_cohort bc CROSS JOIN bench_direct bd
),
q6_note AS (
  /* Q6 A: a picked filter (Venue Type or Genre not Auto or All, Region or Market not All, Time Window not all, or
     queued-only on; Dan 2026-11-07) whose groups give no date in view a benchmark. Step 22 (C6): the tier benchmarks
     come from 09 with every filter now, so the same picked test counts for all four cards. */
  SELECT
    COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
    OR COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
    OR COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    OR COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
    OR (COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') <> 'all' AND NOT (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL))
    OR COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') <> 'all' AS picked_any,
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort' AS is_cohort
)
SELECT
  em.overall_str AS overall_str,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (decision F): a missing benchmark shows blank, not 0 */
  tb.overall_str AS overall_bench,
  ROUND((em.overall_str - tb.overall_str) / NULLIF(tb.overall_str, 0) * 100, 1) AS overall_delta,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (Dan 2026-11-06): blank, not 0, when no date has seat inventory; such dates have no per-date value */
  em.standard_str AS standard_str,
  tb.std_str AS standard_bench,
  ROUND((em.standard_str - tb.std_str) / NULLIF(tb.std_str, 0) * 100, 1) AS standard_delta,
  /* Step 22 (F26): blank, not 0, when the tour has no VIP */
  em.vip_str AS vip_str,
  tb.vip_str AS vip_bench,
  ROUND((em.vip_str - tb.vip_str) / NULLIF(tb.vip_str, 0) * 100, 1) AS vip_delta,
  /* Step 22 (F26): blank, not 0, when the tour has no Platinum */
  em.platinum_str AS platinum_str,
  tb.plat_str AS platinum_bench,
  ROUND((em.platinum_str - tb.plat_str) / NULLIF(tb.plat_str, 0) * 100, 1) AS platinum_delta,
  /* Step 22 (C4): benchmark label when a comparison tour or event is set: <comparison tour label> . <n> events, n = the events the headline benchmark used */
  CASE
    WHEN
      (
        SELECT
          benchmark_kind
        FROM
          benchmark_kind
      ) = 'Direct'
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        (
          SELECT
            COALESCE(tour_display_label, artist_name)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ),
        ' . ',
        CAST(
          (
            SELECT
              str_events
            FROM
              bench_direct
          ) AS STRING
        ),
        ' events'
      )
  END AS `Benchmark Label`,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (Q6, Dan 2026-11-06): too-few text when a picked filter leaves no card date with a benchmark;
     'Benchmark on k of n dates' when only some card dates have one (Cohort, any view); no note when all or the card is blank */
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND em.overall_str IS NOT NULL
      AND q.picked_any
      AND bc.str_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.str_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.str_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.str_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND em.overall_str IS NOT NULL
      AND bc.str_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.str_bench_dates < bc.str_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.str_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.str_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `overall_str Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND em.standard_str IS NOT NULL
      AND q.picked_any
      AND bc.std_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.std_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.std_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.std_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND em.standard_str IS NOT NULL
      AND bc.std_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.std_bench_dates < bc.std_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.std_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.std_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `standard_str Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND em.vip_str IS NOT NULL
      AND q.picked_any
      AND bc.vip_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.vip_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.vip_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.vip_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND em.vip_str IS NOT NULL
      AND bc.vip_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.vip_bench_dates < bc.vip_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.vip_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.vip_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `vip_str Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND em.platinum_str IS NOT NULL
      AND q.picked_any
      AND bc.plat_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.plat_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.plat_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.plat_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND em.platinum_str IS NOT NULL
      AND bc.plat_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.plat_bench_dates < bc.plat_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.plat_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.plat_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `platinum_str Benchmark Note`
FROM
  event_metrics em
    CROSS JOIN tier_bench tb
    CROSS JOIN bench_cohort bc
    CROSS JOIN bench_group_sizes gs
    CROSS JOIN q6_note q

datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */
picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): :tour_name is a picker label; the tour's dates come from the shared tour block */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* C1 (sign-off 2026-11-04): Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; Time Window does not (a tour keeps all its dates); a picked Event (branch below) is not narrowed */
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      AND ps.phase_name_canonical RLIKE '^Phase [0-9]+$'
    THEN
      'Other'
    ELSE ps.phase_name_canonical
  END AS `Phase`,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE(m.checkout_minutes, 0.5), 1) AS `Median Checkout (min)`,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE(m.checkout_minutes, 0.95), 1) AS `P95 Checkout (min)`,
  MIN(ps.phase_start) AS sort_key
FROM
  `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` m
    JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` ps
      ON m.event_id_hex = ps.event_id_hex
      AND m.queue_id = ps.queue_id
      /* F16: the phase summary is one row per event, queue and market; without the market a fan counts twice */
      AND m.market = ps.market
WHERE
  m.event_id_hex IN (
    SELECT
      event_id_hex
    FROM
      active_events
  )
  AND ps.phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
  AND m.purchased = true
  /* F16: the card rule, each buyer's fastest order (checkout_minutes), capped at 120 above; no exit-time filter */
  AND m.checkout_minutes > 0
  /* Step 22 (C28, C20, G1): the 2-hour window is a filter (build 02), not a cap */
  AND m.checkout_minutes <= 120
  /* Batch 14 (Dan 2026-11-16): the flush rule, as every queue count (build 02 joined_after_flush) */
  AND NOT m.joined_after_flush
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN `Phase` = 'Other' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END,
  sort_key

WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (

    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (

  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'

    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (

),
tour_dates AS (

  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )

),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the picker label resolves to the tour's dates through the shared tour block (Region All =
         the 40-day global tour; Region picked = the per-region tours of its dates there) */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 C1: Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; a picked event is left alone */
    AND (

      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )

        event_id_hex
      FROM
