    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
/* Step 22 C4: comparison tour or event, the same four CTEs as Overview Cards and Tab1 Topline */
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_event), '')
    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_tour), '') END AS tour_label
),
comparison_anchor AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_key,
    /* Step 22 (S6, C23): the comparison tour is followed by its id; the picker label is kept for the benchmark label */
    l.tour_id_global,
    l.tour_display_label,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_label
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (C23): :comparison_tour is a picker label (unique among picker tours); matched here once only */
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
benchmark_kind AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 (S6): the comparison tour by its id, never its label text. Region All = its 40-day global tour; Region
       picked = the per-region tours that its dates in that region belong to (the tour block rule) */
    (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              tour_id_global
            FROM
              comparison_anchor
          )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            cr2.tour_id_region
          FROM
            `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` cr2
          WHERE
            cr2.event_kind = 'Main'
            AND cr2.region = :region
            AND cr2.tour_id_global
              = (
                SELECT
                  tour_id_global
                FROM
                  comparison_anchor
              )
        )
      )
    )
    AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): the same filters narrow the comparison tour dates, so the benchmark follows every filter */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): each card is the average of the tour's dates, built per date the same way the
   benchmark builds each event (sql/nightly/09_benchmark_stats.sql), so the card and its benchmark share one basis.
   Cards 34, 38 and 39 show the per-date average beside the benchmark; their tour totals stay as their own fields. */
date_values AS (
  SELECT
    ps.*,
    /* Step 22 Part 2 (S2, S3, F6, F7, Arbitrage): each resale value per date reads the phase summary's own per-event
       value, exactly as 09 event_resale builds an event (build/09 lines 642-658: 5 or more posting rows). Penetration =
       TM resale over primary net_sold, US and Canada (S2); arbitrage = pooled listing over face, ROUND((multiplier - 1)
       x 100, 1) (Arbitrage, F7); STR = sold over sold plus listed the night before (S3); price per ticket (F6) */
    CASE
      WHEN ps.resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN ps.resale_penetration_pct
    END AS date_resale_pen,
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.resale_total_listings >= 5
        AND ps.avg_arbitrage IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        ROUND((ps.avg_arbitrage - 1) * 100, 1)
    END AS date_arbitrage,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN ps.resale_str_pct
    END AS date_resale_str,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN ps.avg_resale_price
    END AS date_resale_price,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.avg_lift_pct > 0 THEN ps.avg_lift_pct
    END AS date_plat_lift,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.platinum_avg_face > 0 THEN ps.platinum_avg_face
    END AS date_plat_face,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.platinum_avg_sold > 0 THEN ps.platinum_avg_sold
    END AS date_plat_avg_sold,
    /* Platinum and VIP tickets, VIP revenue, ATP and share per date: 09 event_tiers lines 300-312 */
    /* Step 22 (E, Dan 2026-11-06): VIP and Platinum ticket counts leave out broken MFX inventory (09 event_tiers) */
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(ps.inv_broken, 0) = 0 THEN NULLIF(ps.platinum_sold, 0)
    END AS date_plat_tix,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(ps.inv_broken, 0) = 0 THEN NULLIF(ps.vip_sold, 0)
    END AS date_vip_tix,
    NULLIF(ps.vip_gross_revenue, 0) AS date_vip_rev,
    CASE
      WHEN ps.vip_revenue_tickets > 0 THEN ps.vip_gross_revenue * 1.0 / ps.vip_revenue_tickets
    END AS date_vip_atp,
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.vip_gross_revenue > 0
        AND ps.gross_revenue > 0
      THEN
        ps.vip_gross_revenue * 100.0 / ps.gross_revenue
    END AS date_vip_share,
    /* Dates behind the (unbound) pooled VIP and Platinum STR columns: seat inventory with tier capacity */
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.seat_capacity > 0
        AND ps.vip_cap > 0
      THEN
        1
    END AS date_has_vip_cap,
    CASE
      WHEN
        ps.seat_capacity > 0
        AND ps.plat_cap > 0
      THEN
        1
    END AS date_has_plat_cap
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(revenue_ticket_qty) AS revenue_ticket_qty,
        MAX(resale_tickets_sold) AS resale_tickets_sold,
        MAX(resale_total_listings) AS resale_total_listings,
        MAX(resale_total_listings) AS total_listings,
        MAX(avg_resale_price) AS avg_resale_price,
        MAX(arbitrage_multiplier) AS avg_arbitrage,
        MAX(platinum_lift_pct) AS avg_lift_pct,
        MAX(platinum_avg_face) AS platinum_avg_face,
        MAX(platinum_avg_sold) AS platinum_avg_sold,
        MAX(vip_sold) AS vip_sold,
        MAX(platinum_sold) AS platinum_sold,
        MAX(vip_revenue_tickets) AS vip_revenue_tickets,
        MAX(vip_gross_revenue) AS vip_gross_revenue,
        MAX(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
        MAX(seat_capacity) AS seat_capacity,
        MAX(vip_cap) AS vip_cap,
        MAX(plat_cap) AS plat_cap,
        /* Step 22 (S2, S3, E): the build's per-event penetration and resale STR, and the broken-inventory flag */
        MAX(resale_penetration_pct) AS resale_penetration_pct,
        MAX(resale_str_pct) AS resale_str_pct,
        MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) ps
),
event_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(dv.date_resale_pen), 2) AS resale_pen,
    AVG(dv.date_plat_tix) AS plat_tix_avg,
    AVG(dv.date_vip_tix) AS vip_tix_avg,
    AVG(dv.date_vip_rev) AS vip_rev_avg,
    AVG(dv.date_vip_atp) AS vip_atp_avg,
    AVG(dv.date_vip_share) AS vip_share_avg,
    /* Step 22 (F7, S3, F6): arbitrage, resale STR and price are averages of the dates too, on the 09 per-event rule */
    AVG(dv.date_arbitrage) AS arbitrage_avg,
    AVG(dv.date_resale_str) AS resale_str_avg,
    AVG(dv.date_resale_price) AS resale_price_avg
  FROM
    date_values dv
),
platinum_data AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN avg_lift_pct > 0 THEN avg_lift_pct
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS platinum_lift_pct,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN platinum_avg_face > 0 THEN platinum_avg_face
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS avg_platinum_face,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN platinum_avg_sold > 0 THEN platinum_avg_sold
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS avg_platinum_sold
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(platinum_lift_pct) AS avg_lift_pct,
        MAX(platinum_avg_face) AS platinum_avg_face,
        MAX(platinum_avg_sold) AS platinum_avg_sold
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    )
),
tier_counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(vip_sold) AS vip_tickets_sold,
    SUM(platinum_sold) AS platinum_tickets_sold,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN vip_sold > 0 THEN 1
      END
    ) AS vip_events,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN platinum_sold > 0 THEN 1
      END
    ) AS plat_events
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(vip_sold) AS vip_sold,
        MAX(platinum_sold) AS platinum_sold
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
        AND NOT COALESCE(
          mfx_inventory_broken,
          false
        ) /* Step 22 (E): tier totals leave out broken MFX inventory */
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    )
),
vip_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(vip_revenue_tickets) AS vip_revenue_tickets,
    SUM(vip_gross_revenue) AS vip_gross_revenue,
    SUM(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN vip_gross_revenue > 0 THEN 1
      END
    ) AS vip_rev_events
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(vip_revenue_tickets) AS vip_revenue_tickets,
        MAX(vip_gross_revenue) AS vip_gross_revenue,
        MAX(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    )
),
tier_agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(standard_sold) AS std_sold,
    SUM(vip_sold) AS vip_sold,
    SUM(platinum_sold) AS plat_sold,
    SUM(seats_sold) AS total_sold,
    SUM(seat_capacity) AS total_cap,
    SUM(vip_cap) AS vip_cap,
    SUM(plat_cap) AS plat_cap
  FROM
    (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        event_id_hex,
        standard_sold,
        vip_sold,
        platinum_sold,
        seats_sold,
        seat_capacity,
        vip_cap,
        plat_cap
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
        AND seat_capacity > 0
    )
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (C5, Q5 A): each tour date is compared with its own venue type and genre group (Auto), or the
   picked values; the tour's benchmark is the average of its dates' benchmarks, over the same dates the card uses */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN l.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
date_bench_rows AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    b.resale_pen_mean,
    b.resale_event_count,
    b.arbitrage_mean,
    b.arbitrage_event_count,
    b.resale_str_mean,
    b.resale_str_event_count,
    b.resale_price_mean,
    b.resale_price_event_count,
    b.plat_lift_mean,
    b.plat_lift_event_count,
    b.str_mean,
    b.str_event_count,
    b.vip_tix_mean,
    b.vip_tix_event_count,
    b.plat_tix_mean,
    b.plat_tix_event_count,
    b.vip_rev_mean,
    b.vip_rev_event_count,
    b.vip_atp_mean,
    b.vip_atp_event_count,
    b.vip_share_mean,
    b.vip_share_event_count,
    b.plat_face_mean,
    b.plat_face_event_count,
    b.plat_sold_mean,
    b.plat_sold_event_count,
    /* Same ranking as before Part 1b: market, then region, then all markets; within each, venue and genre, then venue type, then genre, then all music */
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
        ON (
          (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            b.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    /* Q6 A: a filter the user picked is never widened; if its group has under 10 events the card says so instead */
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  /* One benchmark per date and metric: the best-ranked group that has a value (10 or more events) */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(resale_pen_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE resale_pen_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS resale_pen_mean,
    MIN_BY(arbitrage_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE arbitrage_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS arbitrage_mean,
    MIN_BY(resale_str_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE resale_str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS resale_str_mean,
    MIN_BY(resale_price_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE resale_price_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS resale_price_mean,
    MIN_BY(plat_lift_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE plat_lift_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS plat_lift_mean,
    MIN_BY(str_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS str_mean,
    MIN_BY(vip_tix_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE vip_tix_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS vip_tix_mean,
    MIN_BY(plat_tix_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE plat_tix_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS plat_tix_mean,
    MIN_BY(vip_rev_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE vip_rev_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS vip_rev_mean,
    MIN_BY(vip_atp_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE vip_atp_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS vip_atp_mean,
    MIN_BY(vip_share_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE vip_share_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS vip_share_mean,
    MIN_BY(plat_face_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE plat_face_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS plat_face_mean,
    MIN_BY(plat_sold_mean, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE plat_sold_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS plat_sold_mean,
    /* The group each date used for Resale Penetration (for the header and the event counter) */
    MIN_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE resale_pen_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS resale_group,
    MIN_BY(resale_event_count, fallback_rank)
      FILTER ( WHERE resale_pen_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS resale_group_events,
    /* Under a picked filter the only rows left are the picked group; its size per family when it is too small */
    MAX_BY(
      CONCAT_WS('|', benchmark_mode, venue_type_filter, genre_filter, region_filter, market_filter),
      fallback_rank
    ) AS unwidened_group,
    MAX_BY(resale_event_count, fallback_rank) AS resale_pen_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(arbitrage_event_count, fallback_rank) AS arbitrage_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(resale_str_event_count, fallback_rank) AS resale_str_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(resale_price_event_count, fallback_rank) AS resale_price_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(plat_lift_event_count, fallback_rank) AS plat_lift_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(str_event_count, fallback_rank) AS str_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(vip_tix_event_count, fallback_rank) AS vip_tix_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(plat_tix_event_count, fallback_rank) AS plat_tix_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(vip_rev_event_count, fallback_rank) AS vip_rev_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(vip_atp_event_count, fallback_rank) AS vip_atp_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(vip_share_event_count, fallback_rank) AS vip_share_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(plat_face_event_count, fallback_rank) AS plat_face_unwidened_events,
    MAX_BY(plat_sold_event_count, fallback_rank) AS plat_sold_unwidened_events
  FROM
    date_bench_rows
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
),
bench_cohort AS (
  /* Average of the dates' benchmarks, over the dates where the card itself has a value */
  SELECT
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_resale_pen IS NOT NULL THEN db.resale_pen_mean
      END
    ) AS resale_pen_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_arbitrage IS NOT NULL THEN db.arbitrage_mean
      END
    ) AS arbitrage_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_resale_str IS NOT NULL THEN db.resale_str_mean
      END
    ) AS resale_str_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_resale_price IS NOT NULL THEN db.resale_price_mean
      END
    ) AS resale_price_mean,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN dv.date_plat_lift IS NOT NULL THEN db.plat_lift_mean
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS plat_lift_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_plat_face IS NOT NULL THEN db.plat_face_mean
      END
    ) AS plat_face_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_plat_avg_sold IS NOT NULL THEN db.plat_sold_mean
      END
    ) AS plat_sold_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_plat_tix IS NOT NULL THEN db.plat_tix_mean
      END
    ) AS plat_tix_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_vip_tix IS NOT NULL THEN db.vip_tix_mean
      END
    ) AS vip_tix_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_vip_rev IS NOT NULL THEN db.vip_rev_mean
      END
    ) AS vip_rev_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_vip_atp IS NOT NULL THEN db.vip_atp_mean
      END
    ) AS vip_atp_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_vip_share IS NOT NULL THEN db.vip_share_mean
      END
    ) AS vip_share_mean,
    /* The pooled VIP and Platinum STR columns (no widget reads them) keep the overall STR mean as before, now per date */
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_has_vip_cap IS NOT NULL THEN db.str_mean
      END
    ) AS vip_str_mean,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_has_plat_cap IS NOT NULL THEN db.str_mean
      END
    ) AS plat_str_mean,
    /* Q6 note inputs: per family, dates with a card value and dates with a benchmark */
    COUNT(dv.date_resale_pen) AS resale_pen_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_resale_pen IS NOT NULL THEN db.resale_pen_mean
      END
    ) AS resale_pen_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_arbitrage) AS arbitrage_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_arbitrage IS NOT NULL THEN db.arbitrage_mean
      END
    ) AS arbitrage_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_resale_price) AS resale_price_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_resale_price IS NOT NULL THEN db.resale_price_mean
      END
    ) AS resale_price_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_plat_lift) AS plat_lift_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_plat_lift IS NOT NULL THEN db.plat_lift_mean
      END
    ) AS plat_lift_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_plat_face) AS plat_face_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_plat_face IS NOT NULL THEN db.plat_face_mean
      END
    ) AS plat_face_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_plat_avg_sold) AS plat_sold_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_plat_avg_sold IS NOT NULL THEN db.plat_sold_mean
      END
    ) AS plat_sold_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_plat_tix) AS plat_tix_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_plat_tix IS NOT NULL THEN db.plat_tix_mean
      END
    ) AS plat_tix_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_vip_tix) AS vip_tix_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_vip_tix IS NOT NULL THEN db.vip_tix_mean
      END
    ) AS vip_tix_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_vip_rev) AS vip_rev_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_vip_rev IS NOT NULL THEN db.vip_rev_mean
      END
    ) AS vip_rev_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_vip_atp) AS vip_atp_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_vip_atp IS NOT NULL THEN db.vip_atp_mean
      END
    ) AS vip_atp_bench_dates,
    COUNT(dv.date_vip_share) AS vip_share_card_dates,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN dv.date_vip_share IS NOT NULL THEN db.vip_share_mean
      END
    ) AS vip_share_bench_dates
  FROM
    date_values dv
      LEFT JOIN date_bench db
        ON db.event_id_hex = dv.event_id_hex
),
bench_group_sizes AS (
  /* n for the Q6 note: summed event count of the distinct unwidened groups the dates fall in (same-level groups do not overlap) */
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            resale_pen_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS resale_pen_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            arbitrage_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS arbitrage_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            resale_price_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS resale_price_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            plat_lift_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS plat_lift_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            plat_face_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS plat_face_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            plat_sold_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS plat_sold_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            plat_tix_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS plat_tix_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            vip_tix_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS vip_tix_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            vip_rev_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS vip_rev_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            vip_atp_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS vip_atp_n,
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            unwidened_group,
            vip_share_unwidened_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
        )
    ) AS vip_share_n,
    /* Resale Penetration groups the dates actually used (for the Benchmark Events counter) */
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(events), 0)
      FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT
            resale_group,
            resale_group_events AS events
          FROM
            date_bench
          WHERE
            resale_group IS NOT NULL
        )
    ) AS resale_used_events
),
cmp_platinum_data AS (
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN avg_lift_pct > 0 THEN avg_lift_pct
        END
      ),
      1
    ) AS platinum_lift_pct,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN platinum_avg_face > 0 THEN platinum_avg_face
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS avg_platinum_face,
    ROUND(
      AVG(
        CASE
          WHEN platinum_avg_sold > 0 THEN platinum_avg_sold
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS avg_platinum_sold
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(platinum_lift_pct) AS avg_lift_pct,
        MAX(platinum_avg_face) AS platinum_avg_face,
        MAX(platinum_avg_sold) AS platinum_avg_sold
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    )
),
/* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): the comparison tour is built per date exactly like the card (date_values), then averaged */
comparison_date_values AS (
  SELECT
    cps.*,
    /* Step 22 Part 2 (S2, S3, F6, F7, Arbitrage): each resale value per date reads the phase summary's own per-event
       value, exactly as 09 event_resale builds an event (build/09 lines 642-658: 5 or more posting rows). Penetration =
       TM resale over primary net_sold, US and Canada (S2); arbitrage = pooled listing over face, ROUND((multiplier - 1)
       x 100, 1) (Arbitrage, F7); STR = sold over sold plus listed the night before (S3); price per ticket (F6) */
    CASE
      WHEN cps.resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN cps.resale_penetration_pct
    END AS date_resale_pen,
    CASE
      WHEN
        cps.resale_total_listings >= 5
        AND cps.avg_arbitrage IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        ROUND((cps.avg_arbitrage - 1) * 100, 1)
    END AS date_arbitrage,
    CASE
      WHEN cps.resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN cps.resale_str_pct
    END AS date_resale_str,
    CASE
      WHEN cps.resale_total_listings >= 5 THEN cps.avg_resale_price
    END AS date_resale_price,
    CASE
      WHEN cps.avg_lift_pct > 0 THEN cps.avg_lift_pct
    END AS date_plat_lift,
    CASE
      WHEN cps.platinum_avg_face > 0 THEN cps.platinum_avg_face
    END AS date_plat_face,
    CASE
      WHEN cps.platinum_avg_sold > 0 THEN cps.platinum_avg_sold
    END AS date_plat_avg_sold,
    /* Platinum and VIP tickets, VIP revenue, ATP and share per date: 09 event_tiers lines 300-312 */
    /* Step 22 (E, Dan 2026-11-06): VIP and Platinum ticket counts leave out broken MFX inventory (09 event_tiers) */
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(cps.inv_broken, 0) = 0 THEN NULLIF(cps.platinum_sold, 0)
    END AS date_plat_tix,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(cps.inv_broken, 0) = 0 THEN NULLIF(cps.vip_sold, 0)
    END AS date_vip_tix,
    NULLIF(cps.vip_gross_revenue, 0) AS date_vip_rev,
    CASE
      WHEN cps.vip_revenue_tickets > 0 THEN cps.vip_gross_revenue * 1.0 / cps.vip_revenue_tickets
    END AS date_vip_atp,
    CASE
      WHEN
        cps.vip_gross_revenue > 0
        AND cps.gross_revenue > 0
      THEN
        cps.vip_gross_revenue * 100.0 / cps.gross_revenue
    END AS date_vip_share,
    /* Dates behind the (unbound) pooled VIP and Platinum STR columns: seat inventory with tier capacity */
    CASE
      WHEN
        cps.seat_capacity > 0
        AND cps.vip_cap > 0
      THEN
        1
    END AS date_has_vip_cap,
    CASE
      WHEN
        cps.seat_capacity > 0
        AND cps.plat_cap > 0
      THEN
        1
    END AS date_has_plat_cap
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex,
        MAX(revenue_ticket_qty) AS revenue_ticket_qty,
        MAX(resale_tickets_sold) AS resale_tickets_sold,
        MAX(resale_total_listings) AS resale_total_listings,
        MAX(resale_total_listings) AS total_listings,
        MAX(avg_resale_price) AS avg_resale_price,
        MAX(arbitrage_multiplier) AS avg_arbitrage,
        MAX(platinum_lift_pct) AS avg_lift_pct,
        MAX(platinum_avg_face) AS platinum_avg_face,
        MAX(platinum_avg_sold) AS platinum_avg_sold,
        MAX(vip_sold) AS vip_sold,
        MAX(platinum_sold) AS platinum_sold,
        MAX(vip_revenue_tickets) AS vip_revenue_tickets,
        MAX(vip_gross_revenue) AS vip_gross_revenue,
        MAX(gross_revenue) AS gross_revenue,
        MAX(seat_capacity) AS seat_capacity,
        MAX(vip_cap) AS vip_cap,
        MAX(plat_cap) AS plat_cap,
        /* Step 22 (S2, S3, E): the build's per-event penetration and resale STR, and the broken-inventory flag */
        MAX(resale_penetration_pct) AS resale_penetration_pct,
        MAX(resale_str_pct) AS resale_str_pct,
        MAX(CAST(mfx_inventory_broken AS INT)) AS inv_broken
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
      GROUP BY
        event_id_hex
    ) cps
),
bench_direct_dates AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(cdv.date_resale_pen) AS resale_pen_mean,
    AVG(cdv.date_plat_tix) AS plat_tix_mean,
    AVG(cdv.date_vip_tix) AS vip_tix_mean,
    AVG(cdv.date_vip_rev) AS vip_rev_mean,
    AVG(cdv.date_vip_atp) AS vip_atp_mean,
    AVG(cdv.date_vip_share) AS vip_share_mean,
    /* Step 22 (C4 resale): the comparison tour's own per-date average of the card's per-date values */
    AVG(cdv.date_arbitrage) AS arbitrage_mean,
    AVG(cdv.date_resale_str) AS resale_str_mean,
    AVG(cdv.date_resale_price) AS resale_price_mean
  FROM
    comparison_date_values cdv
),
cmp_tier_agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(vip_sold) AS vip_sold,
    SUM(platinum_sold) AS plat_sold,
    SUM(vip_cap) AS vip_cap,
    SUM(plat_cap) AS plat_cap
  FROM
    (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        event_id_hex,
        standard_sold,
        vip_sold,
        platinum_sold,
        seats_sold,
        seat_capacity,
        vip_cap,
        plat_cap
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary`
      WHERE
        event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
        AND seat_capacity > 0
    )
),
bench_final AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        ROUND(bdd.resale_pen_mean, 2)
      ELSE c.resale_pen_mean
    END AS resale_pen_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        ROUND(bdd.arbitrage_mean, 1)
      ELSE c.arbitrage_mean
    END AS arbitrage_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        ROUND(bdd.resale_str_mean, 2)
      ELSE c.resale_str_mean
    END AS resale_str_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        ROUND(bdd.resale_price_mean, 2)
      ELSE c.resale_price_mean
    END AS resale_price_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        cp.platinum_lift_pct
      ELSE c.plat_lift_mean
    END AS plat_lift_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        cp.avg_platinum_face
      ELSE c.plat_face_mean
    END AS plat_face_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        cp.avg_platinum_sold
      ELSE c.plat_sold_mean
    END AS plat_sold_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        bdd.plat_tix_mean
      ELSE c.plat_tix_mean
    END AS plat_tix_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        bdd.vip_tix_mean
      ELSE c.vip_tix_mean
    END AS vip_tix_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        bdd.vip_rev_mean
      ELSE c.vip_rev_mean
    END AS vip_rev_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        bdd.vip_atp_mean
      ELSE c.vip_atp_mean
    END AS vip_atp_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        bdd.vip_share_mean
      ELSE c.vip_share_mean
    END AS vip_share_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN cta.vip_sold > 0 THEN ROUND(cta.vip_sold * 100.0 / NULLIF(cta.vip_cap, 0), 2)
        END
      ELSE c.vip_str_mean
    END AS vip_str_mean,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        CASE
          WHEN cta.plat_sold > 0 THEN ROUND(cta.plat_sold * 100.0 / NULLIF(cta.plat_cap, 0), 2)
        END
      ELSE c.plat_str_mean
    END AS plat_str_mean
  FROM
    cmp_platinum_data cp
      CROSS JOIN cmp_tier_agg cta
      CROSS JOIN bench_direct_dates bdd
      CROSS JOIN bench_cohort c
),
scope_counts AS (
  /* Step 22 C2: dates shown after the filters, all dates of the tour, and events in the benchmark the headline Resale Penetration card used */
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT event_id_hex)
      FROM
        active_events
    ) AS tour_dates_shown,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Event'
      THEN
        1
      ELSE
        (
          SELECT
            CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pd.event_id_hex) FROM tour_dates pd)
        /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): the period's dates; tour and event views unchanged */
        ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT t.event_id_hex) END
          FROM
            `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` t
          WHERE
            (
              NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
              /* Step 22 (S6): every Main date of the picked 40-day global tour */
              OR t.tour_id_global IN (
                SELECT
                  tour_id_global
                FROM
                  picked_tour
              )
            )
            AND t.event_kind = 'Main'
        )
    END AS tour_dates_total,
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            benchmark_kind
          FROM
            benchmark_kind
        ) = 'Direct'
      THEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(DISTINCT event_id_hex)
          FROM
            comparison_events
        )
      /* Step 22 Part 1b (C5): summed size of the Resale Penetration groups the dates used; the page header replaces this counter */
      ELSE
        (
          SELECT
            resale_used_events
          FROM
            bench_group_sizes
        )
    END AS benchmark_events
),
/* Step 22 (S4, Dan 2026-11-05): the Platinum sales fact holds US, CA, UK and IE only, so when every selected date is in
   AU, MX or NZ the Platinum Lift, Face and Sold cards say "not available for this region" (in their note fields) */
plat_region_scope AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) > 0
    AND COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(l.market, '') NOT IN ('AU', 'MX', 'NZ') THEN 1
      END
    ) = 0 AS plat_not_available
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
q6_note AS (
  /* Q6 A: a picked filter (Venue Type or Genre not Auto or All, Region or Market not All, Time Window not all, or
     queued-only on; Dan 2026-11-07), Cohort benchmark only */
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort'
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      OR COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      OR (COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') <> 'all' AND NOT (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL))
      OR COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') <> 'all'
    ) AS picked_cohort,
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort' AS is_cohort
)
SELECT
  /* Section 1: Resale (11 columns; Step 22 item 12 drops the unbound pooled Resale Sell-Through) */
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): average of the dates' penetration, dates with 5 or more postings, as the benchmark */
  em.resale_pen AS `Resale Penetration (%)`,
  ROUND(b.resale_pen_mean, 2) AS `Resale Pen Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (em.resale_pen - b.resale_pen_mean) * 100.0 / NULLIF(b.resale_pen_mean, 0),
    1
  ) AS `Resale Pen vs Benchmark (%)`,
  /* Step 22 (F7, Arbitrage): average of the dates' arbitrage, the 09 rule per date */
  ROUND(em.arbitrage_avg, 1) AS `Arbitrage Above Face (%)`,
  ROUND(b.arbitrage_mean, 2) AS `Arbitrage Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (ROUND(em.arbitrage_avg, 1) - b.arbitrage_mean) / NULLIF(b.arbitrage_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Arbitrage vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(b.resale_str_mean, 2) AS `Resale STR Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    /* Step 22 (S3): against the average of the dates' resale STR (the value column itself is dropped, item 12) */
    (ROUND(em.resale_str_avg, 2) - b.resale_str_mean)
      / NULLIF(b.resale_str_mean, 0)
      * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Resale STR vs Benchmark (%)`,
  /* Step 22 (F6): average of the dates' per-ticket TM resale price */
  ROUND(em.resale_price_avg, 2) AS `Avg Resale Price ($)`,
  ROUND(b.resale_price_mean, 2) AS `Resale Price Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (ROUND(em.resale_price_avg, 2) - b.resale_price_mean) / NULLIF(b.resale_price_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Resale Price vs Benchmark (%)`,
  /* Section 2: Platinum (7 columns; item 12 drops the unbound pooled Platinum STR) */
  p.platinum_lift_pct AS `Platinum Lift (%)`,
  b.plat_lift_mean AS `Plat Lift Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (p.platinum_lift_pct - b.plat_lift_mean) / NULLIF(b.plat_lift_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Plat Lift vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(bp.str_mean, 2) AS `Plat STR Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (
      CASE
        WHEN ta.plat_sold > 0 THEN ROUND(ta.plat_sold * 100.0 / NULLIF(ta.plat_cap, 0), 2)
        ELSE NULL
      END
        - bp.str_mean
    )
      / NULLIF(bp.str_mean, 0)
      * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Plat STR vs Benchmark (%)`,
  p.avg_platinum_face AS `Avg Platinum Face ($)`,
  p.avg_platinum_sold AS `Avg Platinum Sold ($)`,
  /* Section 3: VIP (7 columns; item 12 drops the unbound pooled VIP STR) */
  ROUND(bv.str_mean, 2) AS `VIP STR Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (
      CASE
        WHEN ta.vip_sold > 0 THEN ROUND(ta.vip_sold * 100.0 / NULLIF(ta.vip_cap, 0), 2)
        ELSE NULL
      END
        - bv.str_mean
    )
      / NULLIF(bv.str_mean, 0)
      * 100,
    1
  ) AS `VIP STR vs Benchmark (%)`,
  /* VIP Revenue: real columns from music_event_phase_summary; seat-rule values arrive with the Step 20g nightly rebuild */
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (decision A): VIP Revenue, VIP Tickets and Platinum Tickets beside a benchmark are the per-date
     average (dates that sold the tier); the tour totals stay as their own fields with no benchmark. VIP ATP and VIP
     Share are the average of the dates' values (dates with VIP revenue), as the benchmark */
  ROUND(em.vip_rev_avg, 0) AS `VIP Revenue ($)`,
  ROUND(em.vip_atp_avg, 2) AS `VIP ATP ($)`,
  ROUND(em.vip_share_avg, 2) AS `VIP Share of Revenue (%)`,
  ROUND(em.vip_tix_avg, 0) AS `VIP Tickets Sold`,
  ROUND(em.plat_tix_avg, 0) AS `Platinum Tickets Sold`,
  vr.vip_gross_revenue AS `Total VIP Revenue ($)`,
  tc.vip_tickets_sold AS `Total VIP Tickets Sold`,
  tc.platinum_tickets_sold AS `Total Platinum Tickets Sold`,
  /* Step 15: cohort-mean benchmarks (per event, events that sold the tier) for the eight Platinum and VIP cards */
  ROUND(b.plat_tix_mean, 0) AS `Platinum Tickets Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (em.plat_tix_avg - b.plat_tix_mean) / NULLIF(b.plat_tix_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Platinum Tickets vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(b.plat_face_mean, 2) AS `Avg Platinum Face Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (p.avg_platinum_face - b.plat_face_mean) / NULLIF(b.plat_face_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Avg Platinum Face vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(b.plat_sold_mean, 2) AS `Avg Platinum Sold Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (p.avg_platinum_sold - b.plat_sold_mean) / NULLIF(b.plat_sold_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `Avg Platinum Sold vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(b.vip_tix_mean, 0) AS `VIP Tickets Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (em.vip_tix_avg - b.vip_tix_mean) / NULLIF(b.vip_tix_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `VIP Tickets vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(b.vip_rev_mean, 0) AS `VIP Revenue Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (em.vip_rev_avg - b.vip_rev_mean) / NULLIF(b.vip_rev_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `VIP Revenue vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(b.vip_atp_mean, 2) AS `VIP ATP Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (em.vip_atp_avg - b.vip_atp_mean) / NULLIF(b.vip_atp_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `VIP ATP vs Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(b.vip_share_mean, 2) AS `VIP Share Benchmark`,
  ROUND(
    (em.vip_share_avg - b.vip_share_mean) / NULLIF(b.vip_share_mean, 0) * 100,
    1
  ) AS `VIP Share vs Benchmark (%)`,
  /* Step 22 C2: event counters */
  sc.tour_dates_shown AS `Tour Dates Shown`,
  sc.tour_dates_total AS `Tour Dates Total`,
  sc.benchmark_events AS `Benchmark Events`,
  /* Step 22 Part 1b (Q6, Dan 2026-11-06): too-few text when a picked filter leaves no card date with a benchmark;
     'Benchmark on k of n dates' when only some card dates have one (Cohort, any view); no note when all or the card is blank */
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.resale_pen_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.resale_pen_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.resale_pen_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.resale_pen_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.resale_pen_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.resale_pen_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.resale_pen_bench_dates < bc.resale_pen_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.resale_pen_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.resale_pen_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Resale Penetration (%) Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.arbitrage_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.arbitrage_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.arbitrage_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.arbitrage_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.arbitrage_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.arbitrage_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.arbitrage_bench_dates < bc.arbitrage_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.arbitrage_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.arbitrage_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Arbitrage Above Face (%) Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.resale_price_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.resale_price_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.resale_price_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.resale_price_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.resale_price_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.resale_price_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.resale_price_bench_dates < bc.resale_price_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.resale_price_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.resale_price_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Avg Resale Price ($) Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    /* Step 22 (S4): every selected date in AU, MX or NZ (no Platinum sales fact there) */
    WHEN
      prs.plat_not_available
    THEN
      'Not available for this region'
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.plat_lift_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.plat_lift_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.plat_lift_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.plat_lift_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.plat_lift_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.plat_lift_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.plat_lift_bench_dates < bc.plat_lift_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.plat_lift_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.plat_lift_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Platinum Lift (%) Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    /* Step 22 (S4): every selected date in AU, MX or NZ (no Platinum sales fact there) */
    WHEN
      prs.plat_not_available
    THEN
      'Not available for this region'
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.plat_face_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.plat_face_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.plat_face_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.plat_face_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.plat_face_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.plat_face_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.plat_face_bench_dates < bc.plat_face_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.plat_face_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.plat_face_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Avg Platinum Face ($) Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    /* Step 22 (S4): every selected date in AU, MX or NZ (no Platinum sales fact there) */
    WHEN
      prs.plat_not_available
    THEN
      'Not available for this region'
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.plat_sold_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.plat_sold_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.plat_sold_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.plat_sold_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.plat_sold_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.plat_sold_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.plat_sold_bench_dates < bc.plat_sold_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.plat_sold_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.plat_sold_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Avg Platinum Sold ($) Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.plat_tix_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.plat_tix_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.plat_tix_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.plat_tix_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.plat_tix_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.plat_tix_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.plat_tix_bench_dates < bc.plat_tix_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.plat_tix_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.plat_tix_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Platinum Tickets Sold Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.vip_tix_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.vip_tix_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.vip_tix_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.vip_tix_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.vip_tix_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.vip_tix_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.vip_tix_bench_dates < bc.vip_tix_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.vip_tix_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.vip_tix_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `VIP Tickets Sold Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.vip_rev_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.vip_rev_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.vip_rev_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.vip_rev_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.vip_rev_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.vip_rev_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.vip_rev_bench_dates < bc.vip_rev_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.vip_rev_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.vip_rev_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `VIP Revenue ($) Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.vip_atp_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.vip_atp_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.vip_atp_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.vip_atp_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.vip_atp_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.vip_atp_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.vip_atp_bench_dates < bc.vip_atp_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.vip_atp_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.vip_atp_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `VIP ATP ($) Benchmark Note`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      q.picked_cohort
      AND bc.vip_share_card_dates > 0
      AND bc.vip_share_bench_dates = 0
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN gs.vip_share_n = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            CAST(gs.vip_share_n AS STRING),
            CASE
              WHEN CAST(CAST(gs.vip_share_n AS STRING) AS STRING) = '1' THEN ' event)'
              ELSE ' events)'
            END
          )
      END
    WHEN
      q.is_cohort
      AND bc.vip_share_bench_dates > 0
      AND bc.vip_share_bench_dates < bc.vip_share_card_dates
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        'Benchmark on ',
        CAST(bc.vip_share_bench_dates AS STRING),
        ' of ',
        CAST(bc.vip_share_card_dates AS STRING),
        ' dates'
      )
    ELSE ''
  END AS `VIP Share of Revenue (%) Benchmark Note`
FROM
  event_metrics em
    CROSS JOIN plat_region_scope prs
    CROSS JOIN bench_cohort bc
    CROSS JOIN bench_group_sizes gs
    CROSS JOIN q6_note q
    CROSS JOIN scope_counts sc
    CROSS JOIN platinum_data p
    CROSS JOIN tier_counts tc
    CROSS JOIN tier_agg ta
    CROSS JOIN vip_revenue vr
    LEFT JOIN bench_final b
      ON 1 = 1
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        vip_str_mean AS str_mean
      FROM
        bench_final
    ) bv
      ON 1 = 1
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        plat_str_mean AS str_mean
      FROM
        bench_final
    ) bp
      ON 1 = 1

datasets.name: Tab2 ARM Comparison
datasets.sql:
WITH resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-F0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
/* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when the Region filter is active). */
picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    ) /* Step 22 S6/C23: shared tour block */
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): Region, Market, Venue Type and Benchmark Events narrow the tour dates; the picked-event branch is unchanged */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
members AS (
  /* Step 22 S1a 3.1d, S1, C8, C7: the tier chart moves from the fan score to ARM. One row per fan per event, the tier
     from the fan's latest queue row in an eligible slot with a linked account (SOT-D1: unlinked rows out; the D3 / ARM
     Summary latest-row rule, build 09 arm_member lines 555-575), at queue join or Today by arm_basis; purchased if any
     queue for that event converted (D2 never-bought rule, as 09 arm_member reads orders_member). No score is its own
     tier. Every date in view counts (no benchmark), so before the first ARM run a fan at queue join is No score. */
  SELECT
    member_id,
    event_id_hex,
    arm_tier,
    CASE arm_tier
      WHEN '1' THEN 'ARM 1: Low behavioral risk'
      WHEN '2' THEN 'ARM 2: Slightly elevated'
      WHEN '3' THEN 'ARM 3: Moderate'
      WHEN '4' THEN 'ARM 4: Elevated'
      WHEN '5' THEN 'ARM 5: High behavioral risk'
      ELSE 'No score: No ARM score available'
    END AS tier_label,
    CASE arm_tier
      WHEN '1' THEN 1
      WHEN '2' THEN 2
      WHEN '3' THEN 3
      WHEN '4' THEN 4
      WHEN '5' THEN 5
      ELSE 6
    END AS score_band_order,
    purchased
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        q.member_id,
        q.event_id_hex,
        COALESCE(
          CASE
            WHEN :arm_basis = 'Today' THEN q.arm_risk_score_today
            ELSE q.arm_risk_score_pit
          END,
          'No score'
        ) AS arm_tier,
        q.arm_queue_eligible
        AND q.arm_linked AS arm_row,
        MAX(
          CASE
            WHEN q.purchased THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) OVER (PARTITION BY q.member_id, q.event_id_hex) = 1 AS purchased,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
              q.member_id,
              q.event_id_hex,
              q.arm_queue_eligible
              AND q.arm_linked
            ORDER BY q.queue_message_ts DESC
          ) AS rn
      FROM
        `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_queue_member_fact` q
      WHERE
        q.event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
    ) ranked
  WHERE
    arm_row
    AND rn = 1
),
queue_totals AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM
    members
),
buyer_totals AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM
    members
  WHERE
    purchased
),
summary AS (
  /* Step 22 S1a: the Summary moves to ARM like PH4 (trusted = ARM 1 to 2 share, blocked = ARM 4 to 5 share); names kept */
  SELECT
    ROUND(
      COUNT(
        CASE
          WHEN arm_tier IN ('1', '2') THEN 1
        END
      )
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
      1
    ) AS queue_trusted_pct,
    ROUND(
      COUNT(
        CASE
          WHEN arm_tier IN ('4', '5') THEN 1
        END
      )
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
      1
    ) AS queue_blocked_pct,
    ROUND(
      COUNT(
        CASE
          WHEN
            arm_tier IN ('1', '2')
            AND purchased
          THEN
            1
        END
      )
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN purchased THEN 1
            END
          ),
          0
        ),
      1
    ) AS buyer_trusted_pct,
    ROUND(
      COUNT(
        CASE
          WHEN
            arm_tier IN ('4', '5')
            AND purchased
          THEN
            1
        END
      )
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(
          COUNT(
            CASE
              WHEN purchased THEN 1
            END
          ),
          0
        ),
      1
    ) AS buyer_blocked_pct
  FROM
    members
),
queue_bands AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 C7: the ARM tier label with OMT's description (set in members) */
    tier_label AS `Score Band`,
    score_band_order,
    'Queue' AS `Segment`,
    ROUND(
      COUNT(*)
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(
          (
            SELECT
              total
            FROM
              queue_totals
          ),
          0
        ),
      1
    ) AS `% of Segment`
  FROM
    members
  GROUP BY
    tier_label,
    score_band_order
),
buyer_bands AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 C7: the ARM tier label with OMT's description (set in members) */
    tier_label AS `Score Band`,
    score_band_order,
    'Purchaser' AS `Segment`,
    ROUND(
      COUNT(*)
        * 100.0
        / NULLIF(
          (
            SELECT
              total
            FROM
              buyer_totals
          ),
          0
        ),
      1
    ) AS `% of Segment`
  FROM
    members
  WHERE
    purchased
  GROUP BY
    tier_label,
    score_band_order
)
SELECT
  `Score Band`,
  score_band_order,
  `Segment`,
  `% of Segment`,
  NULL AS queue_trusted_pct,
  NULL AS queue_blocked_pct,
  NULL AS buyer_trusted_pct,
  NULL AS buyer_blocked_pct
FROM
  queue_bands
UNION ALL
SELECT
  `Score Band`,
  score_band_order,
  `Segment`,
  `% of Segment`,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL
FROM
  buyer_bands
UNION ALL
SELECT
  NULL,
  NULL,
  'Summary',
  NULL,
  queue_trusted_pct,
  queue_blocked_pct,
  buyer_trusted_pct,
  buyer_blocked_pct
FROM
  summary
ORDER BY
  score_band_order,
  `Segment`

datasets.name: VIP Price Ladder
datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex,
    NULLIF(TRIM(:tour_name), '') AS tour_label
),
anchor AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_key,
    l.tour_label,
    l.venue_type,
    l.genre_group,
    l.promoter_group,
    l.artist_name,
    l.venue_name,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_dt,
    l.platform
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l CROSS JOIN resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (C23): :tour_name is a picker label (unique among picker tours) */
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
tour_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 (S6): the tour's dates from the shared tour block (Region All = the 40-day global tour; Region picked =
       the per-region tours of its dates there) */
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        tour_dates
    )
    AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): Region, Market, Venue Type and Benchmark Events narrow the tour dates; the picked-event branch is unchanged */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    tour_events
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Tour'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
vip_rows AS (
  SELECT
    o.Event_ID AS event_id_hex,
    o.Price_Level_Name,
    o.Face_Value,
    /* Step 22 (F10): USD at the row's own rate, the same conversion as the build's gross_revenue (04 order_rows) */
    o.Face_Value
      * COALESCE(o.USD_Exchange_Rate, 1) AS face_value_usd,
    o.Venue_Country,
    /* Step 22 (C22): VIP package fields for Charlie's model, as 04 order_rows */
    o.Offer_Type,
    o.Mask,
    o.Void_Flag,
    o.Platform,
    o.Section,
    o.`Row`,
    o.Seat_Number,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          o.Event_ID,
          COALESCE(
            o.Barcode,
            CONCAT(
              'nobc|',
              COALESCE(o.Order_ID, ''),
              '|',
              COALESCE(o.Section, ''),
              '|',
              COALESCE(o.`Row`, ''),
              '|',
              /* Step 22 (F1): seat added to the no-barcode key so distinct seats on one order are not merged (04 order_rows) */
              COALESCE(o.Seat_Number, ''),
              '|',
              COALESCE(CAST(o.Face_Value AS STRING), ''),
              '|',
              COALESCE(CAST(o.Order_Date_Time AS STRING), '')
            )
          )
        ORDER BY
          CASE o.Ticket_Status
            WHEN 'Active' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Transfer Surrender' THEN 2
            WHEN 'Transfer Sent' THEN 3
            ELSE 9
          END
      ) AS rn
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`orders_consumer_model` o
  WHERE
    o.Event_ID IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND o.Ticket_Type NOT IN ('Resale', 'COMP')
    AND o.Ticket_Status IN ('Active', 'Transfer Surrender', 'Transfer Sent')
),
/* Step 22 (C22, option (c) Dan 2026-11-09): Host US and Canada read Charlie's model, a VIP ticket is one sold as a VIP
   package (Offer_Type 63, mask set, not void, Host platform); other markets keep the Step 20g seat rule below. Same
   scope and rule as the build's VIP Revenue (04 vip_model_scope, order_rows_tiered), so the ladder adds up to it. */
vip_model_scope AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    platform = 'Host'
    AND market IN ('US', 'CA')
    AND event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
vip_seats AS (
  -- Step 20g: a ticket is VIP when its seat is VIP in the seat inventory, the same rule as VIP Tickets Sold and VIP STR.
  -- Step 22 (C22): only outside US and Canada now.
  SELECT
    event_id,
    sect_nm,
    row_nm,
    seat_nm
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_id,
        sect_nm,
        row_nm,
        seat_nm,
        offer_sets,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY event_id, place_id
            ORDER BY seat_revision_num DESC
          ) AS seat_rn
      FROM
        `dataservices_treasury`.`treasury_inventory`.`host_inventory_seat`
      WHERE
        event_id IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            active_events
        )
        AND event_id NOT IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            vip_model_scope
        )
        AND archive_ind = false
        AND status_cat_cd != 'PRODUCTION_KILL'
    ) s
  WHERE
    seat_rn = 1
    AND NOT (
      offer_sets LIKE '%PLATINUM%'
      OR offer_sets LIKE '%PLATSP%'
      OR offer_sets LIKE '%PLATINUMSLP%'
    )
    AND (
      offer_sets LIKE '%VIP%'
      OR offer_sets LIKE '%CITVIP%'
    )
  GROUP BY
    event_id,
    sect_nm,
    row_nm,
    seat_nm
),
ladder AS (
  SELECT
    /* Step 22 (F10): one rung per local price and country, shown in USD at the ticket-weighted rate */
    SUM(v.face_value_usd)
      / COUNT(*) AS vip_price,
    COUNT(*) AS tickets,
    SUM(v.face_value_usd) AS revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.event_id_hex) AS events
  FROM
    vip_rows v
      LEFT JOIN vip_seats s
        ON s.event_id = v.event_id_hex
        AND s.sect_nm = v.Section
        AND s.row_nm = v.`Row`
        AND s.seat_nm = v.Seat_Number
      LEFT JOIN vip_model_scope vs
        ON vs.event_id_hex = v.event_id_hex
  WHERE
    v.rn = 1
    /* Step 22 (C22): package rows in US and Canada, VIP seats elsewhere (04 order_rows_tiered is_vip_seat) */
    AND CASE
      WHEN
        vs.event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
      THEN
        (
          v.Offer_Type = '63'
          AND v.Mask IS NOT NULL
          AND COALESCE(v.Void_Flag, 'F') <> 'T'
          AND UPPER(v.Platform) = 'HOST'
        )
      ELSE s.event_id IS NOT NULL
    END
  GROUP BY
    v.Face_Value,
    v.Venue_Country
)
SELECT
  ROUND(vip_price, 2) AS `VIP Price ($)`,
  tickets AS `Tickets`,
  ROUND(revenue, 0) AS `Revenue ($)`,
  ROUND(tickets * 100.0 / SUM(tickets) OVER (), 1) AS `Share of VIP Tickets (%)`,
  ROUND(revenue * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER (), 0), 1) AS `Share of VIP Revenue (%)`,
  events AS `Events`
FROM
  ladder
/* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no ladder across many tours; pick a tour */
WHERE
  NOT (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL)
ORDER BY
  tickets DESC,
  vip_price DESC
