WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */
picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): :tour_name is a picker label; the tour's dates come from the shared tour block */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 (C1): Region, Market, Venue Type and Benchmark Events narrow the tour dates; the picked-event branch is unchanged */
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
/* Step 22 (S6 Downstream): music_asu_tour_conversion keeps its old tour_key grain. The dates in view (the picked
   tour's dates after the filters, or the picked event) map to their tour_key values through the lookup; each ASU
   group those keys belong to counts once (its values repeat on every tour_key row of the group). One group: its own
   row, unchanged. Several groups (a 40-day tour can span old keys with separate campaigns): counts summed and the
   shares recomputed with the build's formulas (08 final SELECT); a fan signed up in two groups counts in each. */
tour_keys AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_key
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
tour_groups AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    asu_group_key,
    campaign_count,
    registrants,
    registrants_queued,
    registrants_bought,
    queue_buyers
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_asu_tour_conversion`
  WHERE
    tour_key IN (
      SELECT
        tour_key
      FROM
        tour_keys
    )
),
tour_row AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS asu_groups,
    SUM(campaign_count) AS campaign_count,
    SUM(registrants) AS registrants,
    ROUND(
      SUM(registrants_queued) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(registrants), 0),
      1
    ) AS registrants_queued_pct,
    ROUND(
      SUM(registrants_bought) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(registrants), 0),
      1
    ) AS registrants_bought_pct,
    ROUND(
      SUM(registrants_bought) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(queue_buyers), 0),
      1
    ) AS buyers_registered_pct
  FROM
    tour_groups
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 0
),
bench_groups AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    asu_group_key,
    registrants_queued_pct,
    registrants_bought_pct,
    buyers_registered_pct
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_asu_tour_conversion`
  WHERE
    /* Step 22 (S6): every group of the tour in view is left out of its own benchmark */
    asu_group_key NOT IN (
      SELECT
        asu_group_key
      FROM
        tour_groups
    )
),
tour_bench AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS bench_tours,
    AVG(registrants_queued_pct) AS queued_pct_bench,
    AVG(registrants_bought_pct) AS bought_pct_bench,
    AVG(buyers_registered_pct) AS buyers_registered_pct_bench
  FROM
    bench_groups
)
SELECT
  t.campaign_count AS `Campaigns`,
  t.registrants AS `Sign-ups`,
  t.registrants_queued_pct AS `Joined the Queue (% of Sign-ups)`,
  ROUND(tb.queued_pct_bench, 1) AS `Joined the Queue Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (t.registrants_queued_pct - tb.queued_pct_bench) * 100.0 / NULLIF(tb.queued_pct_bench, 0),
    1
  ) AS `Joined the Queue vs Benchmark (%)`,
  t.registrants_bought_pct AS `Purchased (% of Sign-ups)`,
  ROUND(tb.bought_pct_bench, 1) AS `Purchased Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (t.registrants_bought_pct - tb.bought_pct_bench) * 100.0 / NULLIF(tb.bought_pct_bench, 0),
    1
  ) AS `Purchased vs Benchmark (%)`,
  t.buyers_registered_pct AS `Share of Buyers who Signed Up (%)`,
  ROUND(tb.buyers_registered_pct_bench, 1) AS `Share of Buyers Benchmark (%)`,
  ROUND(
    (t.buyers_registered_pct - tb.buyers_registered_pct_bench)
      * 100.0
      / NULLIF(tb.buyers_registered_pct_bench, 0),
    1
  ) AS `Share of Buyers vs Benchmark (%)`,
  CASE
    /* Step 22 (C1): when the filters leave no date, say so instead of claiming no campaign ran */
    WHEN
      NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT
          1
        FROM
          active_events
      )
    THEN
      'No tour dates match the filters.'
    WHEN t.asu_groups IS NULL THEN 'No Artist Sign Up campaign ran for this tour.'
  END AS `no_campaign_text`
FROM
  tour_bench tb
    LEFT JOIN tour_row t
      ON TRUE

/* Step 22 Part 1b: page header, one row, repeated at the top of every page (Dan 2026-11-05). Replaces the three
   counter cards (Tour dates shown, Tour dates in total, Benchmark events). Benchmark events = distinct events across
   the groups the tour's dates use (Dan 2026-11-06), STR family, the same family the old counter used. */
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).

        )

        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))

),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  /* Step 22 S6/C23: the picked tour's dates come from the shared tour block (tour_dates) */
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        tour_dates
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (

      OR :region = 'All'

        (

            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event

    END AS view_mode
),
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),

    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL

comparison_anchor AS (
  /* Step 22 S6/C23: the comparison tour is a picker label, matched among picker tours only (labels are unique there);
     tour_label now carries that picker label so the label lines below read it unchanged; tour_id_global feeds
     comparison_events */
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_key,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_display_label AS tour_label,
    l.tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex

  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
comparison_tour_regions AS (
  /* Step 22 S6: with a Region picked, the per-region tours that the comparison tour's dates in that region belong to
     (the tour_block rule, applied to the comparison anchor's global tour) */
  SELECT
  DISTINCT
    cr.tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` cr
  WHERE
    cr.event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND cr.region = :region
    AND cr.tour_id_global
      = (
        SELECT
          tour_id_global
        FROM
          comparison_anchor
      )
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  /* Step 22 S6/C23: the comparison tour's dates by id (never by label text): its global tour when Region is All,
     else the per-region tours of its dates in the picked region */
  WHERE
    (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              tour_id_global
            FROM
              comparison_anchor
          )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.region = :region
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            comparison_tour_regions
        )
      )
    )
    AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
dates_in_view AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.artist_name,
    l.tour_label,
    l.venue_type,
    l.genre_group,
    l.onsale_dt,
    /* Step 22 S6/C23: the picker label and the global tour id, for the Tour line and the Event-view total */
    l.tour_display_label,
    l.tour_id_global,
    l.event_name
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
tour_total AS (
  /* Every Main date of the tour; in Event view, of the picked event's tour */
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.event_id_hex) AS tour_dates_total
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` t
  WHERE
    t.event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 S6/C23: Tour view = the picked tour's dates (tour_dates: the global tour, or its per-region tours when
       Region is on); Event view = the picked event's global tour */
    AND (
      (
        (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Tour'
        AND t.event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            tour_dates
        )
      )
      OR (
        (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Event'
        AND t.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              MAX(tour_id_global)
            FROM
              dates_in_view
          )
      )
    )
),
venue_mix AS (
  SELECT
    CONCAT_WS(
      ' / ',
      TRANSFORM(
        ARRAY_SORT(
          COLLECT_LIST(
            STRUCT(-date_count AS sort_key, CONCAT(venue_type, ' (', date_count, ')') AS label)
          )
        ),
        x -> x.label
      )
    ) AS venue_mix
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(venue_type, 'Unknown venue type') AS venue_type,
        COUNT(*) AS date_count
      FROM
        dates_in_view
      GROUP BY
        1
    )
),
genre_mix AS (
  /* Batch 13 (Dan 2026-11-11, answer 2): the genre most of the dates carry, no count; a recorded genre wins over
     a missing one, then A to Z on a tie */
  SELECT
    COALESCE(MIN_BY(genre_group, sort_key), 'Unknown genre') AS genre_mix
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        genre_group,
        STRUCT(
          CASE
            WHEN genre_group IS NULL THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END,
          -COUNT(*),
          genre_group
        ) AS sort_key
      FROM
        dates_in_view
      GROUP BY
        genre_group
    )
),
tour_event_name AS (
  /* Batch 13 (review, Page header): the event name most of the dates carry (Harry Styles: "Together, Together",
     not the alphabetically last name); a blank name never wins, then A to Z on a tie */
  SELECT
    MIN_BY(event_name, sort_key) AS event_name
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        event_name,
        STRUCT(-COUNT(*), event_name) AS sort_key
      FROM
        dates_in_view
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(event_name), '') IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY
        event_name
    )
),
/* ---- Benchmark groups: the same per-date pick as the cards (C5, Q6), STR family ---- */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    d.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN d.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN d.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    dates_in_view d
),
bench_slice AS (
  /* The benchmark rows for the filters in force; every per-date group comes from this one slice */
  SELECT
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    b.str_mean,
    b.str_event_count,
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(
      STRUCT(
        s.benchmark_mode,
        s.venue_type_filter,
        s.genre_filter,
        s.region_filter,
        s.market_filter,
        s.str_event_count
      ),
      s.fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE s.str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS picked,
    /* Q6: when no allowed group reaches 10 events, the widest group the date was allowed to try */
    MAX_BY(
      STRUCT(
        s.benchmark_mode,
        s.venue_type_filter,
        s.genre_filter,
        s.region_filter,
        s.market_filter,
        s.str_event_count
      ),
      s.fallback_rank
    ) AS tried
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN bench_slice s
        ON (
          (
            s.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND s.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND s.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            s.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND s.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND s.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            s.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND s.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND s.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            s.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND s.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND s.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  GROUP BY
    dk.event_id_hex
),
groups_used AS (
  /* The group rows to count, each row once: the groups the dates used; when none has a benchmark (Q6 "too few"), the
     widest groups they tried */
  SELECT
  DISTINCT
    g.benchmark_mode,
    g.venue_type_filter,
    g.genre_filter,
    g.region_filter,
    g.market_filter,
    g.str_event_count
  FROM
    (
      /* speed fix 2026-11-10: "any date picked" as a window, not a scalar subquery (same result) */
      SELECT
        CASE
          WHEN
            MAX(
              CASE
                WHEN picked IS NOT NULL THEN 1
                ELSE 0
              END
            ) OVER () = 1
          THEN
            picked
          ELSE tried
        END AS g
      FROM
        date_bench
    )
  WHERE
    g IS NOT NULL
),
group_level AS (
  /* Every group the tour uses sits on one region and market level (Q6 never widens a picked region or market; the
     default view reads All), so the groups differ only by venue type and genre */
  SELECT
    MAX(region_filter) AS region_filter,
    MAX(market_filter) AS market_filter,
    COUNT(DISTINCT region_filter, market_filter) AS levels
  FROM
    groups_used
),
cells AS (
  /* Venue type and genre cells on that level: a venue type group and a genre group overlap exactly in their cell */
  SELECT
    s.venue_type_filter,
    s.genre_filter,
    s.str_event_count
  FROM
    bench_slice s CROSS JOIN group_level gl
  WHERE
    s.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
    AND s.region_filter = gl.region_filter
    AND s.market_filter = gl.market_filter
),
used_venue_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    venue_type_filter
  FROM
    groups_used
  WHERE
    benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
),
used_genres AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    genre_filter
  FROM
    groups_used
  WHERE
    benchmark_mode = 'genre'
),
distinct_benchmark_events AS (
  /* speed fix 2026-11-10: one pass over groups_used (same arithmetic as before: venue type groups + genre groups,
     minus the cells counted twice, plus cells used on their own; all music when used; NULL when no group) */
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN a.group_rows = 0 THEN NULL
      WHEN a.has_all_music = 1 THEN a.all_music_events
      ELSE
        COALESCE(a.venue_type_events, 0)
          + COALESCE(a.genre_events, 0)
          - COALESCE(o.overlap_events, 0)
          + COALESCE(x.own_cell_events, 0)
    END AS benchmark_events,
    gl.levels
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS group_rows,
        MAX(
          CASE
            WHEN benchmark_mode = 'all_music' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) AS has_all_music,
        MAX(
          CASE
            WHEN benchmark_mode = 'all_music' THEN str_event_count
          END
        ) AS all_music_events,
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN benchmark_mode = 'venue_type' THEN str_event_count
          END
        ) AS venue_type_events,
        SUM(
          CASE
            WHEN benchmark_mode = 'genre' THEN str_event_count
          END
        ) AS genre_events
      FROM
        groups_used
    ) a
      CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT
          SUM(c.str_event_count) AS overlap_events
        FROM
          cells c
        WHERE
          c.venue_type_filter IN (
            SELECT
              venue_type_filter
            FROM
              used_venue_types
          )
          AND c.genre_filter IN (
            SELECT
              genre_filter
            FROM
              used_genres
          )
      ) o
      CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT
          SUM(g.str_event_count) AS own_cell_events
        FROM
          groups_used g
        WHERE
          g.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
          AND g.venue_type_filter NOT IN (
            SELECT
              venue_type_filter
            FROM
              used_venue_types
          )
          AND g.genre_filter NOT IN (
            SELECT
              genre_filter
            FROM
              used_genres
          )
      ) x
      CROSS JOIN group_level gl
),
group_words AS (
  /* Batch 13 (review, Page header): the groups in words, largest share of dates first, joined with "&":
     "Stadium | Pop (33) & Arena | Pop (31)" */
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS group_count,
    CONCAT_WS(
      ' - ',
      TRANSFORM(
        ARRAY_SORT(
          COLLECT_LIST(
            STRUCT(
              -date_count AS sort_key,
              CONCAT(label, ' (', date_count, ')') AS label
            )
          )
        ),
        x -> x.label
      )
    ) AS groups_with_dates,
    MAX(label) AS only_label
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        CONCAT(
          CASE
            WHEN picked.venue_type_filter = 'All' THEN 'All Venues'
            ELSE picked.venue_type_filter
          END,
          ' | ',
          CASE
            WHEN picked.genre_filter = 'All' THEN 'All Genres'
            ELSE picked.genre_filter
          END,
          CASE
            WHEN picked.market_filter <> 'All' THEN CONCAT(' | ', picked.market_filter)
            WHEN picked.region_filter <> 'All' THEN CONCAT(' | ', picked.region_filter)
            ELSE ''
          END
        ) AS label,
        COUNT(*) AS date_count
      FROM
        date_bench
      WHERE
        picked IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY
        1
    )
),
coverage AS (
  /* Q6 partial case (Dan 2026-11-06): some dates have a benchmark and some do not; say how many it covers */
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        covered_dates < all_dates
      THEN
        CONCAT(' . Benchmark on ', covered_dates, ' of ', all_dates, ' dates')
      ELSE ''
    END AS coverage_note
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            date_bench
          WHERE
            picked IS NOT NULL
        ) AS covered_dates,
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(DISTINCT event_id_hex)
          FROM
            dates_in_view
        ) AS all_dates
    )
),
dates_agg AS (
  /* speed fix 2026-11-10: the date aggregates as one row (one row even when no date matches, as before) */
  SELECT
    MAX(artist_name) AS artist_name,
    MAX(tour_display_label) AS tour_display_label,
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): artist and tour counts for the Artist and Tour boxes */
    COUNT(DISTINCT artist_name) AS artist_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT tour_id_global) AS tour_count,
    (
      SELECT
        event_name
      FROM
        tour_event_name
    ) AS event_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT event_id_hex) AS dates_shown,
    COUNT(*) AS date_rows
  FROM
    dates_in_view
),
header_parts AS (
  /* speed fix 2026-11-10: every single-row piece joined once, instead of one scalar subquery per use */
  SELECT
    vm.view_mode,
    bk.benchmark_kind,
    tt.tour_dates_total,
    vmx.venue_mix,
    gmx.genre_mix,
    ca.comparison_label,
    ce.comparison_events,
    pd.picked_dates,
    dbe.benchmark_events,
    gw.group_count,
    gw.only_label,
    gw.groups_with_dates,
    cv.coverage_note
  FROM
    view_mode vm
      CROSS JOIN benchmark_kind bk
      CROSS JOIN tour_total tt
      CROSS JOIN venue_mix vmx
      CROSS JOIN genre_mix gmx
      CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT
          MAX(tour_label) AS comparison_label
        FROM
          comparison_anchor
      ) ca
      CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT
          COUNT(DISTINCT event_id_hex) AS comparison_events
        FROM
          comparison_events
      ) ce
      CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*) AS picked_dates
        FROM
          date_bench
        WHERE
          picked IS NOT NULL
      ) pd
      CROSS JOIN distinct_benchmark_events dbe
      CROSS JOIN group_words gw
      CROSS JOIN coverage cv
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(d.artist_count, 0),
    CASE WHEN d.artist_count = 1 THEN ' artist' ELSE ' artists' END)
    ELSE d.artist_name END AS `Artist`,
  /* Step 22 C23: the picker label (Tour view: the picked label, which also names a regional view; Event view: the event's tour) */
  COALESCE(
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): "85 tours on sale in the last week" */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(d.tour_count, 0),
      CASE WHEN d.tour_count = 1 THEN ' tour' ELSE ' tours' END, ' on sale in ',
      CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN 'the last week' WHEN '1mo' THEN 'the last month' WHEN '2mo' THEN 'the last 2 months' WHEN '3mo' THEN 'the last 3 months' WHEN '6mo' THEN 'the last 6 months' WHEN '12mo' THEN 'the last 12 months' WHEN '18mo' THEN 'the last 18 months' WHEN '2yr' THEN 'the last 2 years' WHEN '5yr' THEN 'the last 5 years' ELSE 'all time' END) END,
    NULLIF(TRIM(d.event_name), ''),
    CASE
      WHEN p.view_mode = 'Tour' THEN NULLIF(:tour_name, '')
    END,
    d.tour_display_label
  ) AS `Tour`,
  CONCAT(d.dates_shown, ' of ', p.tour_dates_total, ' dates') AS `Dates`,
  p.venue_mix AS `Venue Mix`,
  p.genre_mix AS `Genre`,
  CASE
    WHEN d.date_rows = 0 THEN 'No dates match these filters'
    WHEN
      p.benchmark_kind = 'Direct'
    THEN
      CONCAT(
        p.comparison_label,
        ' . ',
        p.comparison_events,
        CASE
          WHEN p.comparison_events = 1 THEN ' event'
          ELSE ' events'
        END
      )
    /* Q6: "too few" only under a filter the user picked (Time Window and queued-only count; Dan 2026-11-07) */
    WHEN
      p.picked_dates = 0
      AND (
        COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
        OR COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
        OR COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        OR COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
        OR (COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') <> 'all' AND NOT (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL))
        OR COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') <> 'all'
      )
    THEN
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(p.benchmark_events, 0) = 0 THEN 'No comparable events for these filters'
        ELSE
          CONCAT(
            'Too few events for a benchmark (',
            FORMAT_NUMBER(p.benchmark_events, 0),
            CASE
              WHEN p.benchmark_events = 1 THEN ' event'
              ELSE ' events'
            END,
            ')'
          )
      END
    WHEN p.picked_dates = 0 THEN ''
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): venue mix - groups - events, e.g. "Arena (96) / Stadium (46) - 30 groups
       - 335,281 events"; every date is still compared with its own venue type and genre group */
    WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN
      CONCAT(
        p.venue_mix,
        ' - ',
        FORMAT_NUMBER(p.group_count, 0),
        CASE WHEN p.group_count = 1 THEN ' benchmark group' ELSE ' benchmark groups' END,
        ' - ',
        FORMAT_NUMBER(p.benchmark_events, 0),
        CASE WHEN p.benchmark_events = 1 THEN ' event' ELSE ' events' END,
        p.coverage_note
      )
    WHEN
      p.group_count = 1
    THEN
      /* Batch 13 (Dan 2026-11-11, answer 4): "Stadium | Pop - 1,234 events" */
      CONCAT(
        p.only_label,
        ' - ',
        FORMAT_NUMBER(p.benchmark_events, 0),
        CASE
          WHEN p.benchmark_events = 1 THEN ' event'
          ELSE ' events'
        END,
        p.coverage_note
      )
    ELSE
      /* Batch 13 (review): no lead-in (Filter Info explains it) */
      CONCAT(
        p.groups_with_dates,
        ' - ',
        FORMAT_NUMBER(p.benchmark_events, 0),
        CASE
          WHEN p.benchmark_events = 1 THEN ' event'
          ELSE ' events'
        END,
        p.coverage_note
      )
  END AS `Benchmark`,
  CASE
    WHEN p.benchmark_kind = 'Direct' THEN p.comparison_events
    ELSE p.benchmark_events
  END AS `Benchmark Events`
FROM
  dates_agg d CROSS JOIN header_parts p

datasets.name: Filter - ARM Basis

/* Filter - ARM Basis (Step 22 C8): the two values of the new arm_basis parameter, for its filter widget */
SELECT
  'At queue join' AS arm_basis
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Today' AS arm_basis

datasets.name: filter_tour_picker
datasets.sql:
/* filter_tour_picker (Step 22 C23, decision 2026-11-04 list B): the Tour and Comparison Tour pickers. One row per
   picker tour (tour_in_picker: 2+ dropdown dates, ran a queue, latest onsale from 2022-01-01, on the 40-day global
   key), named by tour_picker_label (artist · onsale · tour name, batch 13), unique among picker tours.
   Not bound to Region or Market (C23), so the other filters never push a tour out of the list.
   Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): 'All tours in Time Window' is listed first; picking it shows every onsale in the Time
   Window. Clearing a single-select falls back to its default, so an empty pick cannot reach this mode. */
SELECT
  tour_name
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      'All tours in Time Window' AS tour_name,
      0 AS sort_group,
      '' AS sort_artist,
      DATE '1900-01-01' AS sort_anchor
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      tour_picker_label AS tour_name,
      1 AS sort_group,
      LOWER(MAX(artist_name)) AS sort_artist,
      MIN(tour_anchor_dt_global) AS sort_anchor
    FROM
      `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
    WHERE
      tour_in_picker
      AND event_kind = 'Main'
    GROUP BY
      tour_picker_label
  )
ORDER BY
  sort_group,
  sort_artist,
  sort_anchor

datasets.name: filter_results_benchmark
datasets.sql:
/* filter_results_benchmark (Step 22 C24, benchmark side): the events that stand behind the benchmark the page header
   and the cards use, one row per event, after all filters. Cohort mode: the benchmark groups each tour date picks
   (the per-date rule of C5 and the Q6 fallback, the CTEs below are Page Header's verbatim, STR family as in the
   header's Benchmark Events), read from music_benchmark_events (the rows the benchmark stats aggregate, build 09
   statement 1) with the same time window, queue flag, region and market level and cohort keys; an event counts in
   the STR family when its str_pct is not NULL. Comparison mode: the comparison tour's or event's dates. */
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  /* Step 22 S6/C23: the picked tour's dates come from the shared tour block (tour_dates) */
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        tour_dates
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
comparison_resolved AS (
  SELECT
    /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): no comparison in period mode; the period option as Comparison Tour = none */
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:comparison_event, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_event), '')
    ) END AS event_id_hex,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) OR COALESCE(:comparison_tour, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' THEN NULL
      ELSE NULLIF(TRIM(:comparison_tour), '') END AS tour_label
),
comparison_anchor AS (
  /* Step 22 S6/C23: the comparison tour is a picker label, matched among picker tours only (labels are unique there);
     tour_label now carries that picker label so the label lines below read it unchanged; tour_id_global feeds
     comparison_events */
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.tour_key,
    l.artist_name,
    l.event_name,
    l.tour_display_label AS tour_label,
    l.tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      CROSS JOIN comparison_resolved r
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex
    OR (
      r.event_id_hex IS NULL
      AND l.tour_in_picker
      AND l.tour_picker_label = r.tour_label
      AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    )
  ORDER BY
    CASE
      WHEN l.event_id_hex = r.event_id_hex THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    CASE
      WHEN l.has_queue THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END,
    l.onsale_dt,
    l.event_id_hex
  LIMIT 1
),
benchmark_kind AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            COUNT(*)
          FROM
            comparison_anchor
        ) > 0
      THEN
        'Direct'
      ELSE 'Cohort'
    END AS benchmark_kind
),
comparison_tour_regions AS (
  /* Step 22 S6: with a Region picked, the per-region tours that the comparison tour's dates in that region belong to
     (the tour_block rule, applied to the comparison anchor's global tour) */
  SELECT
  DISTINCT
    cr.tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` cr
  WHERE
    cr.event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND cr.region = :region
    AND cr.tour_id_global
      = (
        SELECT
          tour_id_global
        FROM
          comparison_anchor
      )
),
comparison_events AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  /* Step 22 S6/C23: the comparison tour's dates by id (never by label text): its global tour when Region is All,
     else the per-region tours of its dates in the picked region */
  WHERE
    (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND l.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              tour_id_global
            FROM
              comparison_anchor
          )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND l.region = :region
        AND l.tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            comparison_tour_regions
        )
      )
    )
    AND l.event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR l.region = :region
    )
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR l.market = :market
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR l.venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR l.has_queue
    )
    AND (
      (
        SELECT
          view_mode
        FROM
          view_mode
      ) = 'Tour'
      OR (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          comparison_resolved
      ) IS NULL
    )
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    comparison_resolved
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      SELECT
        view_mode
      FROM
        view_mode
    ) = 'Event'
),
dates_in_view AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_id_hex,
    l.artist_name,
    l.tour_label,
    l.venue_type,
    l.genre_group,
    l.onsale_dt,
    /* Step 22 S6/C23: the picker label and the global tour id, for the Tour line and the Event-view total */
    l.tour_display_label,
    l.tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
  WHERE
    l.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
),
tour_total AS (
  /* Every Main date of the tour; in Event view, of the picked event's tour */
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.event_id_hex) AS tour_dates_total
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` t
  WHERE
    t.event_kind = 'Main'
    /* Step 22 S6/C23: Tour view = the picked tour's dates (tour_dates: the global tour, or its per-region tours when
       Region is on); Event view = the picked event's global tour */
    AND (
      (
        (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Tour'
        AND t.event_id_hex IN (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            tour_dates
        )
      )
      OR (
        (
          SELECT
            view_mode
          FROM
            view_mode
        ) = 'Event'
        AND t.tour_id_global
          = (
            SELECT
              MAX(tour_id_global)
            FROM
              dates_in_view
          )
      )
    )
),
venue_mix AS (
  SELECT
    CONCAT_WS(
      ' / ',
      TRANSFORM(
        ARRAY_SORT(
          COLLECT_LIST(
            STRUCT(-date_count AS sort_key, CONCAT(venue_type, ' (', date_count, ')') AS label)
          )
        ),
        x -> x.label
      )
    ) AS venue_mix
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(venue_type, 'Unknown venue type') AS venue_type,
        COUNT(*) AS date_count
      FROM
        dates_in_view
      GROUP BY
        1
    )
),
genre_mix AS (
  SELECT
    CONCAT_WS(
      ' / ',
      TRANSFORM(
        ARRAY_SORT(
          COLLECT_LIST(
            STRUCT(-date_count AS sort_key, CONCAT(genre_group, ' (', date_count, ')') AS label)
          )
        ),
        x -> x.label
      )
    ) AS genre_mix
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        COALESCE(genre_group, 'Unknown genre') AS genre_group,
        COUNT(*) AS date_count
      FROM
        dates_in_view
      GROUP BY
        1
    )
),
/* ---- Benchmark groups: the same per-date pick as the cards (C5, Q6), STR family ---- */
date_keys AS (
  SELECT
    d.event_id_hex,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN d.venue_type
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_venue_type
    END AS eff_venue_type,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'Auto' THEN d.genre_group
      WHEN COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') = 'All' THEN 'All'
      ELSE :bench_genre
    END AS eff_genre
  FROM
    dates_in_view d
),
bench_slice AS (
  /* The benchmark rows for the filters in force; every per-date group comes from this one slice */
  SELECT
    b.benchmark_mode,
    b.venue_type_filter,
    b.genre_filter,
    b.region_filter,
    b.market_filter,
    b.str_mean,
    b.str_event_count,
    CASE
      WHEN b.market_filter <> 'All' THEN 0
      WHEN b.region_filter <> 'All' THEN 10
      ELSE 20
    END
      + CASE b.benchmark_mode
        WHEN 'venue_genre' THEN 1
        WHEN 'venue_type' THEN 2
        WHEN 'genre' THEN 3
        WHEN 'all_music' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
      END AS fallback_rank
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` b
  WHERE
    b.promoter_filter = 'All'
    AND b.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
    AND b.tier = 'all'
    AND b.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
    AND b.market_filter IN (COALESCE(:market, 'All'), 'All')
    AND b.region_filter IN (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All'),
      'All',
      (
        SELECT
          MAX(g.region_filter)
        FROM
          `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_stats` g
        WHERE
          g.market_filter = COALESCE(:market, 'All')
          AND g.market_filter <> 'All'
      )
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.venue_type_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:bench_genre, 'Auto') NOT IN ('Auto', 'All')
      AND b.genre_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:market, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.market_filter = 'All'
    )
    AND NOT (
      COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
      AND b.region_filter = 'All'
    )
),
date_bench AS (
  SELECT
    dk.event_id_hex,
    MIN_BY(
      STRUCT(
        s.benchmark_mode,
        s.venue_type_filter,
        s.genre_filter,
        s.region_filter,
        s.market_filter,
        s.str_event_count
      ),
      s.fallback_rank
    )
      FILTER ( WHERE s.str_mean IS NOT NULL ) AS picked,
    /* Q6: when no allowed group reaches 10 events, the widest group the date was allowed to try */
    MAX_BY(
      STRUCT(
        s.benchmark_mode,
        s.venue_type_filter,
        s.genre_filter,
        s.region_filter,
        s.market_filter,
        s.str_event_count
      ),
      s.fallback_rank
    ) AS tried
  FROM
    date_keys dk
      INNER JOIN bench_slice s
        ON (
          (
            s.benchmark_mode = 'venue_genre'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND s.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND s.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            s.benchmark_mode = 'venue_type'
            AND dk.eff_venue_type <> 'All'
            AND s.venue_type_filter = dk.eff_venue_type
            AND s.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
          OR (
            s.benchmark_mode = 'genre'
            AND dk.eff_genre <> 'All'
            AND s.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND s.genre_filter = dk.eff_genre
          )
          OR (
            s.benchmark_mode = 'all_music'
            AND s.venue_type_filter = 'All'
            AND s.genre_filter = 'All'
          )
        )
  GROUP BY
    dk.event_id_hex
),
groups_used AS (
  /* The group rows to count, each row once: the groups the dates used; when none has a benchmark (Q6 "too few"), the
     widest groups they tried */
  SELECT
  DISTINCT
    g.benchmark_mode,
    g.venue_type_filter,
    g.genre_filter,
    g.region_filter,
    g.market_filter,
    g.str_event_count
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        CASE
          WHEN
            (
              SELECT
                COUNT(*)
              FROM
                date_bench
              WHERE
                picked IS NOT NULL
            ) > 0
          THEN
            picked
          ELSE tried
        END AS g
      FROM
        date_bench
    )
  WHERE
    g IS NOT NULL
),
benchmark_event_rows AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id_hex,
    CONCAT(
      CASE
        WHEN g.venue_type_filter = 'All' THEN 'All Venues'
        ELSE g.venue_type_filter
      END,
      ' | ',
      CASE
        WHEN g.genre_filter = 'All' THEN 'All Genres'
        ELSE g.genre_filter
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN g.market_filter <> 'All' THEN CONCAT(' | ', g.market_filter)
        WHEN g.region_filter <> 'All' THEN CONCAT(' | ', g.region_filter)
        ELSE ''
      END
    ) AS group_label
  FROM
    groups_used g
      INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_benchmark_events` e
        ON e.time_window = CASE WHEN (COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window' AND NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(:event_id_hex, '')), '') IS NULL) THEN 'all' ELSE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') END
        AND e.queue_flag = COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all')
        AND e.region_filter = g.region_filter
        AND e.market_filter = g.market_filter
        AND (
          g.benchmark_mode NOT IN ('venue_type', 'venue_genre')
          OR e.venue_type = g.venue_type_filter
        )
        AND (
          g.benchmark_mode NOT IN ('genre', 'venue_genre')
          OR e.genre_group = g.genre_filter
        )
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Cohort'
    AND e.str_pct IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    c.event_id_hex,
    (
      SELECT
        tour_label
      FROM
        comparison_anchor
    ) AS group_label
  FROM
    comparison_events c
  WHERE
    (
      SELECT
        benchmark_kind
      FROM
        benchmark_kind
    ) = 'Direct'
),
benchmark_list AS (
  /* an event in two groups (a venue type group and a genre group) is listed once, with both group names */
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    CONCAT_WS(' / ', ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(group_label))) AS benchmark_group
  FROM
    benchmark_event_rows
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
)
SELECT
  l.artist_name AS `Artist`,
  l.event_name AS `Event`,
  l.venue_name AS `Venue`,
  l.market AS `Market`,
  l.event_dt AS `Event Date`,
  l.onsale_dt AS `Onsale Date`,
  l.venue_type AS `Venue Type`,
  l.genre_group AS `Genre`,
  bl.benchmark_group AS `Benchmark Group`
FROM
  benchmark_list bl
    INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      ON l.event_id_hex = bl.event_id_hex
ORDER BY
  LOWER(l.artist_name),
  l.event_dt,
  l.venue_name

datasets.name: tab3_flushed_fans
datasets.sql:
/* tab3_flushed_fans (Step 22 C14, Q7, 2026-11-09): one row per sale (event, queue) with OMT cover, fans let
   through before the queue's own seats fell under 10% and stayed there, against fans let through at or after that
   point (flushed), each with its buyers. Counts come from the phase summary (build 04 lines 175-183), summed over
   its market rows, so the dataset does not scan the member fact. */
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */
picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): :tour_name is a picker label; the tour's dates come from the shared tour block */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* C1 (sign-off 2026-11-04): Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; Time Window does not (a tour keeps all its dates); a picked Event (branch below) is not narrowed */
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
sales AS (
  SELECT
    ps.event_id_hex,
    ps.queue_id,
    /* one phase name per queue; MAX only collapses the market rows */
    MAX(ps.phase_name_canonical) AS phase_name,
    MAX(ps.queue_start_ts) AS queue_start_ts,
    MAX(ps.seats_ran_out_ts) AS seats_ran_out_ts,
    MAX(ps.queue_empty_ts) AS queue_empty_ts,
    MAX(ps.queue_own_seats) AS queue_own_seats,
    SUM(ps.released) AS released,
    SUM(ps.released_before_ran_out) AS released_before_ran_out,
    SUM(ps.purchasers_before_ran_out) AS purchasers_before_ran_out,
    SUM(ps.flushed_released) AS flushed_released,
    SUM(ps.flushed_purchasers) AS flushed_purchasers
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` ps
  WHERE
    ps.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND ps.phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
    /* C14: only sales the queue system (OMT) logged, from May 2025 */
    AND ps.omt_covered
  GROUP BY
    ps.event_id_hex,
    ps.queue_id
)
SELECT
  l.event_label AS `Event`,
  DATE_FORMAT(l.event_dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS `Event Date`,
  s.phase_name AS `Sale`,
  s.queue_id AS `Queue ID`,
  DATE_FORMAT(s.queue_start_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `Sale Start`,
  DATE_FORMAT(s.seats_ran_out_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `Flushed (UTC)`,
  s.released AS `Released`,
  /* No ran-out point (the sale started under 10% of its own seats, never got that low, or has no own-seat count):
     the build stores 0 in all four counts; the table shows them blank so a 0 is not read as "nobody let through" */
  CASE
    WHEN s.seats_ran_out_ts IS NOT NULL THEN s.released_before_ran_out
  END AS `Let Through Before`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      s.seats_ran_out_ts IS NOT NULL
    THEN
      ROUND(s.purchasers_before_ran_out * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.released_before_ran_out, 0), 1)
  END AS `Let Through Before Conversion (%)`,
  CASE
    WHEN s.seats_ran_out_ts IS NOT NULL THEN s.flushed_released
  END AS `Flushed`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      s.seats_ran_out_ts IS NOT NULL
    THEN
      ROUND(s.flushed_purchasers * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.flushed_released, 0), 1)
  END AS `Flushed Conversion (%)`,
  'From May 2025. Sales that started with under 10% of seats left, or never got that low, show no flushed fans. Covers US, CA, MX, AU and NZ only (other markets have no own-seat count for a queue).' AS `Note`
FROM
  sales s
    INNER JOIN `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup` l
      ON l.event_id_hex = s.event_id_hex
ORDER BY
  l.event_dt,
  s.queue_start_ts,
  s.queue_id

datasets.name: Tab3 Fans Waiting
datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    /* Batch 13 item 1 (Dan 2026-11-11): the Tour picker shows tour_picker_label (artist · onsale · tour name) */
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all') WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7) WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60) WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90) WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180) WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365) WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548) WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730) WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825) ELSE DATE '1900-01-01' END
        AND (:period_venue_types IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type))
        AND (:period_genres IS NULL OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0 OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group))
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-F0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): :tour_name is a picker label; the tour's dates come from the shared tour block */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* C1 (sign-off 2026-11-04): Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; Time Window does not (a tour keeps all its dates); a picked Event (branch below) is not narrowed */
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
event_info AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex,
    MAX(event_dt) AS event_dt,
    MAX(REGEXP_REPLACE(event_label, ' \\[[0-9A-Fa-f]+\\]$', '')) AS event_label
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
  GROUP BY
    event_id_hex
)
/* Batch 13 item 6 (Charlie item 1, Dan D5 2026-11-12): fans still in each sale's queue at the minute its own seats
   fell under 10% and stayed there (build 02/04 in_queue_at_ran_out, OMT from 2025-05-15, markets with a presale seat
   count). A sale with no ran-out point has no row. Phase is the recorded name (Dan D3). */
SELECT
  e.event_label AS `Event`,
  p.market AS `Market`,
  p.phase_name_canonical AS `Phase`,
  p.queue_own_seats AS `Presale Seats`,
  DATE_FORMAT(p.queue_start_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `Queue Start (UTC)`,
  DATE_FORMAT(p.seats_ran_out_ts, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') AS `Flushed (UTC)`,
  p.in_queue_at_ran_out AS `Fans Waiting`
FROM
  `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` p
    INNER JOIN event_info e
      ON e.event_id_hex = p.event_id_hex
WHERE
  p.event_id_hex IN (
    SELECT
      event_id_hex
    FROM
      active_events
  )
  AND p.in_queue_at_ran_out IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  e.event_dt ASC,
  e.event_label ASC,
  p.seats_ran_out_ts ASC,
  `Phase` ASC

datasets.sql:
WITH /* Shared Step 22 S6/C23 tour block (datasets pass, 2026-11-09). Copy verbatim into every dataset that picks a tour.
   :tour_name now carries a picker label (tour_display_label, unique among tour_in_picker tours, C23).
   Region All reads the 40-day global tour; Region picked reads the per-region tours that the picked tour's dates in
   that region belong to (S6 decision, SOT-D7: per-region anchor only when Region is on). */ picked_tour AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_global
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    tour_in_picker
    AND tour_picker_label = :tour_name
),
picked_tour_regions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    tour_id_region
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
    AND region = :region
    AND tour_id_global IN (
      SELECT
        tour_id_global
      FROM
        picked_tour
    )
),
tour_dates AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    event_kind = 'Main'
    AND (
      (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') = 'All'
        AND tour_id_global IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_global
          FROM
            picked_tour
        )
      )
      OR (
        COALESCE(:region, 'All') <> 'All'
        AND region = :region
        AND tour_id_region IN (
          SELECT
            tour_id_region
          FROM
            picked_tour_regions
        )
      )
      /* Period mode (Dan 2026-11-13): Tour = 'All tours in Time Window' loads every picker tour date whose onsale
         falls in the Time Window (not after today), in the picked period-only Venue Types and Genres (empty =
         all). False for every real tour, so tour mode is unchanged. Region, Market, Venue Type and queued-only
         still narrow these dates in active_events. */
      OR (
        COALESCE(:tour_name, '') = 'All tours in Time Window'
        AND tour_in_picker
        AND onsale_dt <= CURRENT_DATE()
        AND onsale_dt
          >= CASE COALESCE(:bench_window, 'all')
            WHEN '1wk' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 7)
            WHEN '1mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 30)
            WHEN '2mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 60)
            WHEN '3mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 90)
            WHEN '6mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 180)
            WHEN '12mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 365)
            WHEN '18mo' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 548)
            WHEN '2yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 730)
            WHEN '5yr' THEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), 1825)
            ELSE DATE '1900-01-01'
          END
        AND (
          :period_venue_types IS NULL
          OR SIZE(:period_venue_types) <= 0
          OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_venue_types, venue_type)
        )
        AND (
          :period_genres IS NULL
          OR SIZE(:period_genres) <= 0
          OR ARRAY_CONTAINS(:period_genres, genre_group)
        )
      )
    )
),
resolved_event AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(:event_id_hex, '\\[([A-Fa-f0-9]+)\\]$', 1), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(:event_id_hex), '')
    ) AS event_id_hex
),
active_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_artist_lookup`
  WHERE
    (
      NULLIF(:tour_name, '') IS NULL
      /* Step 22 (S6, C23): :tour_name is a picker label; the tour's dates come from the shared tour block */
      OR event_id_hex IN (
        SELECT
          event_id_hex
        FROM
          tour_dates
      )
    )
    AND event_kind = 'Main'
    /* C1 (sign-off 2026-11-04): Region, Market, Venue Type and the queued-events filter narrow the tour's own dates; Time Window does not (a tour keeps all its dates); a picked Event (branch below) is not narrowed */
    AND (
      :market IS NULL
      OR :market = 'All'
      OR market = :market
    )
    AND (
      :region IS NULL
      OR :region = 'All'
      OR region = :region
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:bench_venue_type, 'Auto') IN ('Auto', 'All')
      OR venue_type = :bench_venue_type
    )
    AND (
      COALESCE(:queue_filter, 'all') = 'all'
      OR has_queue
    )
    AND (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        resolved_event
    ) IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    event_id_hex
  FROM
    resolved_event
  WHERE
    event_id_hex IS NOT NULL
),
view_mode AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN
        (
          SELECT
            event_id_hex
          FROM
            resolved_event
        ) IS NULL
      THEN
        'Tour'
      ELSE 'Event'
    END AS view_mode
),
queue_flush AS (
  /* Batch 14 (Dan 2026-11-16 decision 8, definition approved 2026-11-17): one row per queue on the dates in view that
     has the minute record (omt_covered); flush_ts is the flush minute (build 02 seats_ran_out_ts), NULL if the queue
     never flushed */
  SELECT
    ps.event_id_hex,
    ps.queue_id,
    MAX(ps.queue_start_ts) AS start_ts,
    MAX(ps.seats_ran_out_ts) AS flush_ts,
    MAX(CAST(ps.omt_covered AS INT)) AS has_minute_record
  FROM
    `prod_shared_gold`.`central_analytics_crd`.`music_event_phase_summary` ps
  WHERE
    ps.event_id_hex IN (
      SELECT
        event_id_hex
      FROM
        active_events
    )
    AND ps.phase_name_canonical <> 'No queue'
    AND ps.queue_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    ps.event_id_hex,
    ps.queue_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(PERCENTILE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, start_ts, flush_ts), 0.5), 1) AS `Median Minutes to Flush`,
  /* "92 of 222 queues": flushed queues of all the tour's queues (the approved definition); blank when no queue on
     these dates has the minute record, so a tour from before May 15, 2025 shows blank, not "0 of N" */
  CASE
    WHEN
      MAX(has_minute_record) = 1
    THEN
      CONCAT(FORMAT_NUMBER(COUNT(flush_ts), 0), ' of ', FORMAT_NUMBER(COUNT(*), 0), ' queues')
  END AS `Queues Flushed`,
  COUNT(flush_ts) AS flushed_queues,
  COUNT(*) AS queues_total
FROM
  queue_flush
